english:
Khimni belongs to the lower Selenga and Dzhida country, where grassland, river valleys and forested hills connected Mongolia with the lands north of Lake Baikal. Herding, cultivation in suitable places and hunting supported communities whose routes crossed later imperial boundaries. Rivers supplied water and travel corridors, while pasture made seasonal movement central to the economy.

During the seventeenth century, Russian expansion into Transbaikalia encountered Mongol and Buryat communities linked to Khalkha political authority. Forts, tribute and trade altered the balance of power, while local groups could seek protection or negotiate between competing rulers. The Dzungar crisis and growing Qing influence changed the wider Mongolian world, followed by agreements regulating the Russian-Qing frontier. Border making did not end kinship and exchange across the region; livestock, furs, grain and imported goods continued to move through local networks.
simp_chinese:
希姆尼属于色楞格河下游和吉达河地区，草原、河谷与林木丘陵连接蒙古和贝加尔湖以北的土地。放牧、适地耕作和狩猎支撑着社群生活，其路线跨越后来划定的帝国边界。河流提供水源和交通通道，草场则使季节性迁徙成为经济的重要部分。

十七世纪，俄罗斯向外贝加尔扩张，与同喀尔喀政治势力相联系的蒙古和布里亚特社群接触。堡垒、贡赋与贸易改变了力量平衡，地方群体有时寻求保护，或在竞争的统治者之间协商。准噶尔危机与清朝影响的增长改变了更广阔的蒙古地区，随后双方协议规定了俄清边界。划界并未终结跨境的亲属联系和交换；牲畜、毛皮、粮食及进口货物继续沿地方网络流通。

english: Khimzha stands on the bank of the river Kimzha near its junction with the Mezen. Its wooden houses and church belong to the building traditions of the Russian North, where timber was the principal material of village life. The wooden Church of the Hodegetria was erected between 1700 and 1709 and consecrated in 1763. Its steep tented roof rises above the river settlement and the surrounding forest.
simp_chinese: 希姆扎位于基姆扎河畔，靠近它与梅津河的交汇处。木屋和教堂属于俄罗斯北方的建筑传统，在这里木材是乡村生活中最重要的建筑材料。木造圣母引路者教堂建于1700至1709年间，1763年祝圣；高耸的帐篷式屋顶俯瞰河畔聚落与周围森林。

english: Khirkhira is the site of a medieval Mongol settlement in the Argun country. Excavations have revealed a fortified centre, palace buildings and dwellings for craftspeople, evidence of a substantial town amid the steppe. The nearby inscription known as the Chinggis Stone honours Yisüngge, a nephew of Chinggis Khan, for his skill in archery. Scholars have connected the settlement and its surroundings with the lands of Jöchi Qasar and his descendants, though the precise identity of the occupants remains debated.
simp_chinese: 希尔希拉是额尔古纳河地区的一处蒙古时代聚落遗址。考古发现了设防中心、宫殿建筑和工匠住宅，显示草原上曾有一座规模可观的城镇。附近的“成吉思石”铭文称颂成吉思汗之侄也孙哥的射箭技艺。学者将该聚落及周围地区与拙赤合撒儿及其后代的领地联系起来，但城镇居民的确切身份仍有讨论。

english:
Khiva stands in the irrigated lands of Khwarazm south of the Oxus, at the edge of the desert road to Persia. Its inner town, Ichan Kala, is enclosed by high earthen walls and contains a dense arrangement of mosques, tombs, markets and madrasas. Caravans could rest here before crossing the desert, and the streets within its walls joined places of worship with the commercial life of the oasis. The city forms part of a much older oasis civilization, whose settlements depended upon channels drawn from the great river.

Khiva passed to Timur in the late fourteenth century and came under Uzbek rule in the early sixteenth. As the waterways of the lower Oxus changed and old Urgench declined, Khiva emerged as a leading seat of the khanate. Abu al-Ghazi Bahadur Khan, who ruled from 1643 to 1663, fought the Kalmyks and wrote histories of the Turks and Turkmen. The fortified residence of the khans, Kunya Ark, was strengthened in the later seventeenth century.

The eighteenth century brought warfare and the invasion of Nader Shah in 1740, followed by a revival under rulers of the Qungrat family. The Friday Mosque was rebuilt in 1788–89, its broad roof supported by a forest of wooden columns. In the early nineteenth century Muhammad Rahim Khan consolidated the khanate, while his successors added to the palaces and monuments within the old walls.
simp_chinese:
希瓦坐落在阿姆河南面的花剌子模灌溉地带，处于通往波斯的沙漠道路边缘。内城伊钦卡拉由高大的土墙环绕，城内密布清真寺、陵墓、集市和经学院。商队在横穿沙漠之前可在这里歇脚；城墙内的街道将宗教场所与绿洲的商业生活联系在一起。这座城属于古老的绿洲文明，其聚落依靠从大河引出的渠道维持。

希瓦于十四世纪末落入帖木儿之手，十六世纪初又归乌兹别克人统治。随着阿姆河下游水道变化、旧玉龙杰赤衰落，希瓦成为汗国的重要驻地。阿布勒加齐·巴哈杜尔汗于1643至1663年统治，在与卡尔梅克人作战之余，还撰写了突厥人和土库曼人的历史。汗的设防居所昆雅方舟在十七世纪后期得到加强。

十八世纪战事频仍，纳迪尔沙于1740年入侵，此后城市在弘吉剌家族统治者治下复兴。聚礼清真寺于1788—1789年重建，宽阔屋顶由如林的木柱支撑。十九世纪初，穆罕默德·拉希姆汗巩固了汗国；他的继承者又在旧城墙内增建宫殿和纪念建筑。

english: Khiyav stands below the northern slopes of Mount Sabalan, where streams from the mountain water the surrounding plain. Its old fortress overlooks the settlement, and a nearby Sasanian inscription records ancient building activity. The town also holds the shrine of Shaykh Haydar, father of Shah Ismail I and a leader of the Safavid order, linking it to the dynasty that later ruled Persia.
simp_chinese: 希亚夫坐落在萨巴兰山北坡下，山间溪流滋养周围平原。古堡俯瞰聚落，附近的萨珊铭文记载了古代营建活动。城中还有谢赫海达尔的陵墓，他是沙阿伊斯玛仪一世的父亲和萨法维教团领袖，使此地与后来统治波斯的王朝相联系。

english:
Khlepen stood on the Vazuza in the border country associated with the princes of Vyazma. By the later fifteenth century the town and its dependent districts belonged to Prince Mikhail Dmitrievich of Vyazma. Its position also drew competing claims from Moscow, which invoked the treaty of 1449 when arguing over the Khlepen lands.

During the frontier conflict of the late 1480s and early 1490s, forces serving Ivan the Young approached from Tver, plundered Khlepen and carried away captives. Nearby districts suffered burning and seizure of property. Lithuanian diplomatic complaints recorded these attacks, while subsequent disputes concerned occupation as well as raiding. Khlepen's history in this period therefore lay within a contested network of princely lands, where military action and negotiations over inherited rights worked together to shift the frontier between Lithuania and Moscow.
simp_chinese:
赫列片位于瓦祖扎河畔，属于与维亚济马诸王公相关的边地。十五世纪后期，城镇及其所属乡区归维亚济马的米哈伊尔·德米特里耶维奇王公所有。莫斯科也对赫列片土地提出权利要求，在交涉中援引1449年的条约。

1480年代末至1490年代初的边境冲突期间，效力于伊凡幼子的军队从特维尔方向前来，洗劫赫列片并掳走人口。附近乡区也遭焚烧与财物掠夺。立陶宛外交申诉记录了这些袭击，后续争端则涉及驻占土地，超出了临时劫掠。赫列片由此处于相互争夺的王公领地网络中，军事行动与围绕世袭权利展开的谈判交织，推动立陶宛和莫斯科之间的边界变化。

english:
Khmilnyk stands on the upper Southern Bug, close to the Black Way used by Tatar raiding parties. Its name is associated with the hops that grew on an island in the river. A town of the Podolian frontier, it gained Magdeburg rights in 1448 and became a place of crafts and trade.

To strengthen this exposed outpost, the Polish king had stone walls, towers and a castle built in 1534. Cossack forces took the town in the uprisings of 1594 and 1637, and Maksym Kryvonis captured its castle during the rising led by Bohdan Khmelnytsky. Repeated fighting brought devastation. The Ottomans held Khmilnyk from 1672 to 1699 and strengthened the castle before the town returned to Poland. Warfare damaged its commerce and reduced its population. It passed to Russia in 1793.
simp_chinese:
赫米利尼克坐落在南布格河上游，靠近鞑靼劫掠队常走的黑道。它的名字与河中岛上生长的啤酒花有关。这座波多利亚边境城镇于1448年获得马格德堡法权，成为手工业和贸易之地。

为加强这处暴露在外的前哨，波兰国王于1534年修建了石墙、塔楼和城堡。哥萨克军队在1594年和1637年的起义中攻占此城；博赫丹·赫梅利尼茨基领导起义时，马克西姆·克里沃尼斯夺取了城堡。反复交战使城镇遭到破坏。奥斯曼人于1672至1699年占领赫米利尼克，曾加强城堡防御；此后城镇重归波兰。战乱损害了贸易，也使人口减少。1793年，赫米利尼克转归俄国。

english:
Khoái Châu lies on the fertile plain beside the Red River, south of Thăng Long. Its riverbanks and landing places were important during the wars against the Yuan invasions. In 1285 Trần forces counterattacked at Hàm Tử, seeking to break the enemy's river defences and prevent their armies from joining together. The nearby Thiên Mạc bank also witnessed fighting during the same invasion.

The later city of Hưng Yên lies here.
simp_chinese:
快州位于升龙以南、红河畔的肥沃平原上。抗击元朝入侵的战争中，这里的河岸和渡口具有重要地位。1285年，陈朝军队在咸子展开反击，试图打破敌军的红河防线，阻止其各路军队会合。附近的天幕河滩也在同一次入侵期间经历了战斗。

后来的兴安市即位于此地。

english: The grasslands and dry basins north of the Yin Mountains formed part of Chahar Mongol country. In 1675, under the Qing, the region was organised into banners, including the Bordered Yellow Banner. Its pastoral households occupied a landscape between the northern steppe and the more settled lands south of the mountains.
simp_chinese: 阴山以北的草原与干旱盆地属于察哈尔蒙古人的活动地区。清康熙十四年（1675年），这一带被编入察哈尔镶黄旗。牧民生活在北方草原与山南定居区之间的高原上。

english:
Khoiniki belonged to the wooded country of Polesia. A privilege issued by King and Grand Duke Alexander on 3 June 1504 named Khoiniki together with Ostroglyady in a grant to Semyon Fyodorovich Polozovich for military service. The settlement lay within the Grand Duchy of Lithuania's Kyiv lands and later within the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth. Its ownership passed through several noble families, including the Kharlinskys, Shuiskys and Prozors.

By the last third of the seventeenth century, Khoiniki was described as a small town and the centre of an estate district. A wooden castle occupied the floodplain of the Kvesya River during the seventeenth and eighteenth centuries. Noble ownership, the castle and the surrounding dependent settlements gave the locality its place in Polesia's landed society. The second partition of the Commonwealth in 1793 brought Khoiniki into the Russian Empire. That change transferred sovereignty over an existing estate town whose earlier history was recorded through grants, family ownership and the river-side stronghold.
simp_chinese:
霍伊尼基位于波列西耶林地。1504年6月3日，国王兼大公亚历山大颁发的一份特许状，将霍伊尼基与奥斯特罗格利亚迪一同授予谢苗·费奥多罗维奇·波洛佐维奇，酬报其军役。聚落属于立陶宛大公国的基辅地区，后来进入波兰立陶宛联邦，先后归哈尔林斯基、舒伊斯基和普罗佐尔等贵族家族所有。

至十七世纪最后三分之一时期，霍伊尼基已被记作小镇和庄园辖区中心。十七至十八世纪，一座木堡坐落在克韦夏河泛滥平原。贵族领地、城堡与周围附属聚落，构成它在波列西耶庄园社会中的位置。1793年第二次瓜分联邦后，霍伊尼基并入俄罗斯帝国。主权虽已转移，当地在此以前的历史仍可从授地、家族所有权与河旁堡寨的记载中追寻。

english: Khoja-Idat Kala is a fortified archaeological site near Halach on the middle Oxus. Like other settlements along this reach, it developed beside the river that sustained agriculture and carried traffic through the desert. Its town and citadel belonged to a series of defended sites that had taken shape by the late Kushan period. Many were abandoned after the Mongol invasion, leaving their walls and mounds as traces of the old settled landscape along the Amu Darya.
simp_chinese: 霍加伊达特卡拉是阿姆河中游哈拉奇附近的一处设防遗址。与这一河段的其他聚落一样，它依河而兴，河水维持农业，也承载穿越沙漠的交通。城区与城堡属于一系列设防地点，到贵霜晚期已形成。许多聚落在蒙古入侵后废弃，城墙与土丘留下了阿姆河沿岸昔日定居景观的痕迹。

english: Kholm stands where the Kunya joins the Lovat, a river used in the old route linking the Baltic and Black Sea worlds. A Kholmovsky pogost belonging to Novgorod is recorded in 1471. In the Middle Ages the town was the seat of the Princes of Kholm, and it withstood repeated sieges by Lithuanians, Poles and Swedes. Kholm became an administrative town in 1777.
simp_chinese: 霍尔姆位于库尼亚河与洛瓦季河汇合处，洛瓦季河曾是连接波罗的海和黑海世界的古老路线的一部分。1471年文献记载了属于诺夫哥罗德的霍尔姆斯基波戈斯特。中世纪时，这里是霍尔姆诸公的驻地，曾多次抵御立陶宛人、波兰人和瑞典人的围攻。1777年，霍尔姆成为县级行政城镇。

english: Kholm was the centre of a small principality within the lands of Tver, near the Derzha east of Zubtsov. The town appears in the inheritance of the Tver princes in the early fourteenth century, and Vsevolod Alexandrovich later held it as his appanage. His claim to the throne of Tver drew Kholm into the struggles of the princely family. Nearby stood its outlying settlement of Novy Gorodok, later known as Pogoreloye Gorodishche. Kholm itself is associated with the site of the later village of Krasny Kholm.
simp_chinese: 霍尔姆是特维尔土地上一座小公国的中心，位于祖布佐夫以东、杰尔扎河附近。十四世纪初，它出现在特维尔诸公的继承安排中，后来成为弗谢沃洛德·亚历山德罗维奇的分封领地。他对特维尔大公位的争夺，使霍尔姆卷入王公家族内部的斗争。附近有其外围聚落新戈罗多克，后来称为波戈雷洛耶戈罗季谢。霍尔姆本身则与后来克拉斯内霍尔姆村的地点相联系。

english: Kholm lies in the wooded uplands northeast of Smolensk, between the upper Dnieper and Western Dvina watersheds. The village is recorded in 1708, during the reign of Peter I. Its name, meaning a hill, describes the rising ground among the forests and fields of the old Bely district. The surrounding country had formed part of the contested Smolensk borderlands before passing to Russian control in the seventeenth century.
simp_chinese: 霍尔姆位于斯摩棱斯克东北的林地高地，地处第聂伯河与西德维纳河上游分水岭之间。村庄见于彼得一世在位时的1708年记载。地名意为山丘，描述了旧别雷地区森林与田地之间的高地。在17世纪转归俄罗斯控制之前，周围地区曾是争夺中的斯摩棱斯克边地。

english:
Kholmogory stands on a branch of the Northern Dvina, amid the islands and channels of the great river's lower course. Known as Kolmogory in a fourteenth-century charter, it became an administrative and trading centre of the Russian North. The Dvina linked its merchants with inland towns, while the White Sea opened a route to distant shores.

In 1553 the English navigator Richard Chancellor reached the Dvina, opening a sea route between England and Russia. English merchants established a trading office and warehouses at Kholmogory, exchanging goods from the West for products of the northern forests and farms. The founding of Arkhangelsk nearer the sea later shifted foreign commerce downstream. Kholmogory nevertheless remained an ecclesiastical centre: a new diocese was established in 1682, and Archbishop Athanasius began the large Transfiguration Cathedral, built between 1685 and 1691.
simp_chinese:
霍尔莫戈雷坐落在北德维纳河的一条支汊上，周围是大河下游的岛屿与水道。十四世纪的文书称它为科尔莫戈雷，此地后来成为俄罗斯北方的行政和贸易中心。北德维纳河将商人与内陆城镇联系起来，白海则为他们打开通往远方海岸的航路。

1553年，英国航海家理查德·钱斯勒抵达北德维纳河，开辟了英俄之间的海上航线。英国商人在霍尔莫戈雷设立商馆和仓库，以西方商品换取北方森林与农田的产品。更靠近大海的阿尔汉格尔斯克建立后，对外贸易重心逐渐移向下游。霍尔莫戈雷仍是教会中心：1682年设立新的教区，大主教阿法纳西随后开始修建规模宏大的救世主显圣容主教座堂，工程于1685至1691年间完成。

english: Kholmyech lies near the Dnieper in the lowlands southeast of Rechytsa. Burial mounds attest to settlement in the surrounding country in the eleventh century. Written records describe the place in the sixteenth century as part of the Grand Duchy of Lithuania; by 1583 it was a privately owned town on the road between Babruysk and Chernihiv. A ferry crossing linked it to the far bank of the Dnieper.
simp_chinese: 霍尔梅奇位于列奇察东南方的低地，靠近第聂伯河。古墓丘说明周围地区在十一世纪便有人居住。十六世纪的文书记载它属于立陶宛大公国；到1583年，它已是鲍布鲁伊斯克与切尔尼戈夫之间道路上的一座私有集镇。渡船将这里与第聂伯河对岸相连。

english: Kholongsolokh lies in the country near the lower Sededema, a river that rises on the Alazeya Plateau and joins the Kolyma from the west. Beyond the plateau, the Alazeya itself flows north to the East Siberian Sea, between the great Indigirka and Kolyma basins.
simp_chinese: 霍隆索洛赫位于谢杰杰马河下游附近。谢杰杰马河发源于阿拉泽亚高原，从西面汇入科雷马河；高原另一侧的阿拉泽亚河则向北流，在因迪吉尔卡河与科雷马河之间注入东西伯利亚海。

english: Belaya Kholunitsa grew around the Novotroitsky Kholunitsa ironworks, founded in 1764 on the river of the same name. Its future owner Savva Yakovlev bought several hundred serf peasants in Novgorod and Vologda provinces to supply labor for construction. In September 1764 the river was dammed with a wooden structure, creating a pond for the works. The Belaya Kholunitsa flows to the Vyatka, placing the factory settlement within the waterways of the northern Vyatka country.
simp_chinese: 白霍卢尼察围绕1764年建于同名河流上的新三一霍卢尼察铁厂发展起来。未来厂主萨瓦·雅科夫列夫从诺夫哥罗德和沃洛格达省购买数百名农奴，为建设提供劳力。1764年9月，人们筑起木坝截断河流，形成供工厂使用的水塘。白霍卢尼察河流入维亚特卡河，使厂区聚落处于维亚特卡北部的水系之中。

english: The ǂKhomani are a San people of the southern Kalahari, a country of dunes and the dry beds of the Auob and Nossob rivers. Their ancestral landscape preserves traces of human life reaching back into the Stone Age. Hunting and gathering here required knowledge of animals, edible plants and scarce water, as well as ways of enduring drought. The ǂKhomani traditionally spoke Nǁng, a language of the Tuu family with a rich variety of click sounds.
simp_chinese: 科马尼是卡拉哈里南部的桑人，生活在沙丘以及奥奥布河、诺索布河干涸河床之间。他们的祖先之地保存着远至石器时代的人类活动遗迹。在这里狩猎采集，需要了解动物、可食植物和稀少的水源，也需要应对干旱的方法。科马尼人传统上使用恩恩语，这门图语系语言拥有丰富的搭嘴音。

english: Khomeyn lies in the upland country north of Golpayegan, among valleys and mountains of central western Iran. The surrounding district was historically part of the upper Taymara country and later known as Kamareh. Fields and orchards occupy the valley floor, while the hills beyond provide pasture for livestock. Khomeyn's setting joins the agricultural settlements of the interior to the mountain routes leading towards Golpayegan and the larger cities of the Iranian plateau.
simp_chinese: 霍梅因位于戈勒派耶甘以北的高地，坐落在伊朗中西部的山谷之间。周围地区历史上属于上泰马拉，后来称为卡马雷。田地与果园分布在谷底，远处丘陵则可供牲畜放牧。霍梅因的山谷将内陆农业聚落同通往戈勒派耶甘及伊朗高原大城的山路联系起来。

english: Khon Kaen lies in the Chi River basin on the Khorat Plateau. In the late eighteenth century Thao Sak led people from the Suwannaphum country to settle near Bueng Bon. In 1797 the Siamese king raised their settlement to the rank of a town and appointed him its first governor, with the title Phra Nakhon Si Borirak. Khon Kaen was one of the new towns formed as Lao-speaking communities spread across the plateau.
simp_chinese: 孔敬位于呵叻高原的奇河流域。十八世纪末，陶萨率领素万那普地区的居民迁至汶本附近定居。1797年，暹罗国王将这处聚落升为城镇，任命他为首任城主，并赐封号帕那空西博里叻。孔敬是老挝语社群在高原扩展过程中建立的新城之一。

english:
Khon San's early Rattanakosin history centres on settlers who came from Nakhon Thai in the Phitsanulok country during the late eighteenth century. Their leader, Phumi, brought followers into the area and established a community. Tribute presented to Rama I connected the settlement with the Bangkok court, and Phumi received official titles, eventually becoming its first governor as Luang Phichit Songkhram.

The local account associates this movement with beeswax, saltpetre and ivory, products that linked the surrounding country to royal demands. Municipal temple history also recalls the settlers encountering an abandoned Buddhist sanctuary with a large image, an old chedi and a sacred fig tree. Restoration joined the new settlement to an older religious landscape. Khon San therefore developed through the movement of people, the collection of valued materials and recognition from the court. These relationships gave the community a place within the early Bangkok kingdom while retaining a remembered connection to the Nakhon Thai homeland of its settlers.
simp_chinese:
空山的曼谷王朝初期历史，围绕十八世纪末从彭世洛地域那空泰迁来的居民展开。首领普米带领追随者在此定居，并向拉玛一世进贡，使聚落与曼谷宫廷建立联系。他获赐官衔，后来以銮披集颂堪之名成为首任地方长官。

地方记载把迁居与蜂蜡、硝石、象牙等物产相连，这些材料将周边地域连接到王室需求。市镇寺院史还称，移民遇见一处荒废佛寺，内有大佛、旧塔及菩提树，随后予以修复。新定居由此同较早宗教景观衔接。人口移动、贵重物产征集及宫廷承认，共同促成空山发展，使它进入早期曼谷王国，同时保存与移民故乡那空泰的记忆联系。

english: Khondab lies in the agricultural country between Hamadan and the central Iranian plateau. Its plain belongs to the wider basin of the Qareh Chay, whose watercourses gather the runoff of the surrounding highlands. Villages and fields occupy the valleys between ridges, with routes leading west towards Hamadan and east towards the interior. The neighbouring Darjazin country was known to medieval geographers as a district of settlements and cultivated land on the approaches to Hamadan.
simp_chinese: 洪达卜位于哈马丹与伊朗中部高原之间的农业地区。平原属于更广阔的卡拉恰伊河流域，河道汇集周围高地的径流。村庄与田地散布在山岭间的谷地，向西可通哈马丹，向东则通往内陆。中世纪地理学家知道邻近的达尔贾津是哈马丹附近一片有聚落和耕地的地区。

english:
Khor Fakkan was a prosperous port on Arabia's eastern coast when Albuquerque's Portuguese fleet attacked in 1507. His account describes wealthy merchants from India, stables holding horses for export, and fishing boats with nets in the harbour. Inland estates had fruit and vegetable trees and pools supplying irrigation. The port's maritime trade therefore rested beside a cultivated hinterland.

The attackers captured and burned the town, destroying buildings, taking women and children prisoner and killing inhabitants. Portuguese intervention brought armed demands for control into an established commercial landscape. A later fortress, commissioned around 1620, had a triangular plan with bastions at its corners; archaeological work has also documented a protected well. Khor Fakkan's early modern history joined local commerce and agriculture with the fortifications and violence of a wider struggle over maritime access.
simp_chinese:
1507年，阿尔布克尔克率葡萄牙舰队进攻时，霍尔费坎已是阿拉伯东岸的繁荣港口。他的记述提到来自印度的富商、供出口马匹使用的马厩，以及港中的渔船和渔网。内陆庄园种植果树和蔬菜，并以水池灌溉，海上贸易因而与耕作腹地相邻。

进攻者占领并焚毁城镇，破坏建筑，俘虏妇孺并杀害居民。葡萄牙的武装干预将控制航运的要求带入既有商业景观。约1620年奉命修建的后期堡垒采用三角形平面，转角设棱堡；考古工作也记录了受防护的水井。当地近世历史由此把商业、农业与堡垒营建、战争暴力联系起来，成为更广泛海上通道争夺的一部分。

english:
Khor Virap stands above the Ararat plain near the site of ancient Artashat. Armenian Christian tradition associates its dungeon with Gregory the Illuminator's imprisonment before the conversion of the kingdom. The monastery's later history added a fortified and scholarly institution to this revered place of pilgrimage.

During the sixteenth century the buildings suffered amid Armenia's political and economic difficulties. Under Davit II Virapetsi, abbot from 1660 to 1695, the community revived and the enclosure and buildings were reconstructed in 1666–1669. Work on the dungeon and the church above it followed, with the new Saint Gregory church consecrated in 1670. The earthquake of 1679 again damaged the complex, requiring further restoration. Reconstruction of the principal church of the Mother of God was completed in 1703, and Catholicos Simeon of Yerevan sponsored repairs in 1765. Khor Virap's early modern fabric thus records repeated rebuilding, joining devotion to a foundational sacred narrative with the continuing work needed to sustain a walled monastic community.
simp_chinese:
霍尔维拉普立于阿拉拉特平原上方、古阿尔塔沙特遗址附近。亚美尼亚基督教传统将这里的地牢，同王国皈依基督教以前启蒙者格里高利被囚的经历联系起来。此后，设防修道院与学术活动又为这处朝圣圣地增添新的层次。

十六世纪，建筑在政治经济困境中受损。1660至1695年任院长的达维特二世·维拉佩齐推动社群复兴，于1666至1669年重建围墙与院内建筑，随后整修地牢及上方教堂；新圣格里高利堂于1670年祝圣。1679年地震再度破坏建筑，修道院必须继续恢复。圣母主教堂的重建于1703年完成，埃里温的西缅宗主教又在1765年资助维修。霍尔维拉普的近世建筑因此记录着多次重建，将对基督教起源叙事的敬奉，同维持设防僧团所需的持续劳动连接起来。

english: The mountains of Khorasan rise above the plains around Nishapur and Mashhad. The Binalud range runs northwest to southeast between these two regions, forming a high barrier within northeastern Iran. Its slopes collect water that descends towards the neighbouring valleys, contrasting with the drier land below. The ranges of northern Khorasan form a link between the mountains of Central Asia and the Alborz farther west.
simp_chinese: 呼罗珊山地耸立于内沙布尔和马什哈德周围平原之上。比纳鲁德山脉在两地之间由西北向东南延伸，形成伊朗东北部的高峻屏障。山坡汇集的水流下邻近河谷，与较干燥的低地形成对比。呼罗珊北部山脉连接中亚山区和更西面的厄尔布尔士山脉。

english: South of the Nishapur plain, the Khorasan uplands rise into the rugged country of Kuh Sorkh. Ridges and high valleys stretch between Nishapur, Kashmar and Torbat-e Heydarieh, with conical volcanic peaks and mineral springs among the heights. The red colour of the soil gives the region its name, meaning “Red Mountain”. Its cooler mountain valleys stand above the dry plains to the south.
simp_chinese: 内沙布尔平原以南，呼罗珊高地升起，形成崎岖的库赫索尔赫山地。山脊和高谷延伸于内沙布尔、卡什马尔与托尔巴特海达里耶之间，高处可见圆锥形火山峰和矿泉。当地土壤呈红色，因而得名“红山”；较为凉爽的山谷俯瞰着南方干旱的平原。

english:
Khorat's early modern city was established on a new site during the reign of King Narai of Ayutthaya,1656–1688. Older centres at Khorakapura and Sema lay farther west beside the Lam Takhong. Their names were combined in the formal designation Nakhon Ratchasima, while Khorat remained the common name. The new centre therefore carried earlier place identities into a changed urban location.

Under Rama I, the city was raised to first-class status and its governor held the rank of Chao Phraya. These arrangements made the plateau centre part of the kingdom's hierarchy of provincial authority. During Rama III's reign, Anuwong of Vientiane attacked Khorat and took inhabitants away as captives. The town's history thus involved both royal organisation and armed competition over people and territory, connecting a local urban centre with the political world beyond the plateau.
simp_chinese:
呵叻的近世新城在大城王朝纳莱王统治期间，即1656—1688年间建立。较早的呵叻迦布罗与西玛位于更西面的兰达空河旁，两者名称组合为新城正式名称“那空叻差是玛”，民间仍称呵叻。新中心由此在迁换城市位置的同时，继承了较早地名。

拉玛一世时期，呵叻升为一等城，地方统治者具有昭披耶等级，使高原中心进入王国的省级权力秩序。拉玛三世在位时，万象的阿努旺进攻呵叻，并将居民掳作俘虏。当地历史因此既涉及王室行政安排，也涉及争夺人口与领土的战争，将一处高原城市同区域之外更广阔的政治世界联系起来。

english: The Khorbusuonka joins the lower Olenyok from the right, in the far northern country between that river and the Lena. The Olenyok receives several tributaries here before spreading into its delta on the Laptev Sea. Ice covers the northern rivers for much of the year, and some of their smaller tributaries freeze through in winter. The brief summer brings running water back to the valleys and tundra.
simp_chinese: 霍尔布苏翁卡河从右岸注入厄列尼奥克河下游，流经该河与勒拿河之间的极北地区。厄列尼奥克河在此接纳多条支流，随后在拉普捷夫海边展开三角洲。北方河流一年大部分时间为冰覆盖，较小的支流有些会在冬季完全冻结。短暂夏季使河谷和苔原间的水流重新畅通。

english: Khordong lies in Nyarong, a historical region of eastern Kham centred on the middle Yalong River. Narrow valleys and mountains made travel difficult, and limited level ground constrained farming. Much of Nyarong was historically divided among local communities rather than ruled by a single authority. Its relative isolation also meant that it was often removed from the principal trade routes of Tibet.
simp_chinese: 柯洛洞位于康区娘绒。娘绒是以雅砻江中游为中心的历史地区，狭窄河谷和山脉使交通困难，平地有限也制约耕作。历史上，娘绒长期由不同地方社群分治，并非始终处于单一政权之下。相对隔绝的位置也使这里往往远离西藏主要商路。

english: Khormoj lies in the Dashti country inland from the Persian Gulf, north of the mouth of the Mand River. It stands between the hot coastal plain and the mountains of Fars, in a district where fields and date palms grow amid dry hills. Medieval geographical works mention a place called Khurmuk in this region, though its exact identification has been debated. The town later became known for its scholars and poets, as well as for its position in the country between Bushehr and the southern coast.
simp_chinese: 霍尔莫杰位于波斯湾内陆的达什蒂地区，在曼德河口以北。城镇处于炎热海岸平原与法尔斯山地之间，田地和椰枣树分布在干旱丘陵之中。中世纪地理著作曾记述这一地区名叫胡尔穆克的地方，但确切对应关系仍有争议。此地后来以学者和诗人闻名，也处在布什尔与南方海岸之间的通道上。

english: Khornabuji crowns an isolated rocky height above the plains of eastern Kakheti. Its walls follow the contours of the cliff, commanding views over the approaches to the Alazani and Iori valleys. A fortified town and episcopal centre stood here in early Georgian history, and the castle remained associated with the defence of the eastern frontier. Later tradition called it the fortress of Queen Tamar, recalling the great age of the medieval Georgian kingdom.
simp_chinese: 霍尔纳布吉高踞卡赫季东部平原上一处孤立岩峰，城墙依悬崖地势而筑，俯瞰通往阿拉扎尼和约里河谷的道路。格鲁吉亚早期历史上，这里曾有设防城镇和主教驻地，堡垒长期与东部边疆防御相联系。后来的传说称其为塔玛尔女王堡，令人想起中世纪格鲁吉亚王国的鼎盛时代。

english: Xoro lies on the left bank of the Vilyuy, in the broad river country of central Yakutia. Local tradition associates the place with the Khorin people, who are said to have come here from the Lena basin. In 1634 Russian Cossacks established a winter quarters at the mouth of the Tyukyan, where it meets the Vilyuy; it served as an administrative centre for several decades.
simp_chinese: 霍罗位于维柳伊河左岸，地处雅库特中部开阔的河谷地带。当地传说将此地与霍林人联系起来，称他们从勒拿河流域迁来。1634年，俄国哥萨克在秋坎河注入维柳伊河的河口建起冬营地，数十年间这里一直是行政中心。

english:
Khorostkiv lay on the Taina River in Galician Podolia. It was recorded in 1565 as a private town of Jakub and Jerzy Strus and received limited Magdeburg rights in 1578. Its later development drew on the surrounding estates and their agricultural produce. During the eighteenth century the landowner Siamianski encouraged Jewish artisans and merchants from other Podolian towns to settle, offering rights intended to sustain their livelihoods and communal life.

The community's growth left unusually specific records. A census of 1765 counted forty-two Jewish poll-tax payers and two infants. At first the settlers depended on neighbouring congregations for religious authority and burial. A large synagogue was subsequently built with the landowner's help. In 1785, under Austrian rule, the authorities challenged its construction because it lacked a government licence. The town's history thus includes both the encouragement offered by an estate owner seeking a commercial centre and the regulations imposed by a new administration.
simp_chinese:
霍罗斯特基夫位于加利西亚波多利亚的泰纳河畔。1565年的记录称它是雅库布和耶日·斯特鲁斯的私人城镇，1578年获得有限的马格德堡权利。后来的发展与周边庄园及其农产密切相关。十八世纪，地主夏米安斯基鼓励波多利亚其他城镇的犹太工匠和商人迁来，给予维持生计与社群生活所需的权利。

社群发展的具体记录留存下来：1765年调查列有四十二名犹太人头税缴纳者和两名婴儿。起初，当地居民在宗教管理与安葬方面依附邻近社群，后来在地主协助下建起大型会堂。奥地利统治时期，官府于1785年追究会堂未取得政府营建许可的问题。这段历史既反映地主希望建立庄园商业中心的举措，也反映新行政体系施加的规制。

english:
Khorramabad lies in a valley of the Zagros, where the river of the same name flows beneath the great citadel of Falak al-Aflak. Built on a rocky height, the fortress with its towers and deep well was the seat of the atabegs of Luristan. Below it, a bazaar served the surrounding mountain communities, while bridges carried travellers across the river.

Shah Abbas I captured the formidable citadel in 1597 as the Safavids brought Luristan under their authority. In the early nineteenth century Mohammad Ali Mirza, son of Fath Ali Shah and governor of the region, built a palace within the old fortress. Its commanding position continued to make Khorramabad a centre of power among the valleys and pastoral lands of the western Zagros.
simp_chinese:
霍拉马巴德坐落在扎格罗斯山谷中，同名河流从法拉克阿夫拉克大堡垒下流过。这座筑于岩石高地的要塞设有塔楼和深井，曾是卢里斯坦阿塔贝格的驻地。下方的市场服务于周围山区社群，桥梁则供旅人渡河。

1597年，沙阿阿拔斯一世攻取这座险固堡垒，萨法维王朝将卢里斯坦纳入统治。十九世纪初，法特赫阿里沙之子、当地总督穆罕默德·阿里米尔扎在旧堡内修建宫殿。凭借险要地势，霍拉马巴德继续成为扎格罗斯西部山谷与牧地之间的权力中心。

english: East of the lower Volga, the Ashuluk branches through the floodplain before entering the delta. This was part of the country of the Khoshut Kalmyks, whose name survives in Khosheutovo. Their communities moved between pastures on the steppe and the river's meadowlands. In the early nineteenth century Prince Serebdzhab Tyumen sponsored the construction of the Khosheutovsky Buddhist temple nearby, commemorating Kalmyk service in the war against Napoleon. It was one of the early permanent temples of the Kalmyk steppe.
simp_chinese: 伏尔加河下游以东，阿舒卢克河分成支流，穿过泛滥平原后进入三角洲。这里曾是和硕特卡尔梅克人的活动地区，霍舍乌托沃之名便保留了他们的名称。当地社群往来于草原牧场和河畔草甸之间。十九世纪初，谢列布扎布·秋明亲王资助在附近建造霍舍乌特佛寺，纪念卡尔梅克人在对拿破仑战争中的服役。这是卡尔梅克草原早期固定寺院之一。

english: Khost lies in the high country of the Safed Koh, south of the Kabul River. Mount Sikaram rises along the range, which divides the drainage of the Kabul and Kurram rivers. Near Sikaram, the Peiwar Pass leads between the Kurram valley and the Aryob valley. Snow lies on the highest parts of the mountains above the valleys.
simp_chinese: 霍斯特位于喀布尔河以南的萨费德科高地。锡卡拉姆峰耸立在这条山脉上，山脉分隔喀布尔河与库拉姆河水系。锡卡拉姆附近的佩瓦尔山口连接库拉姆谷地和阿里奥卜谷地，山脉最高处积雪覆盖，俯瞰下方河谷。

english:
Khotan is an oasis on the southern edge of the Tarim Basin, fed by two rivers from the Kunlun Mountains, the Yurungkash and the Karakash, whose names mean White Jade and Black Jade. It lay at the junction of the southern Silk Road and the passes toward India and Tibet, and was for centuries a Buddhist kingdom. Around 1006 the Karakhanid prince Yusuf Qadir Khan of Kashgar took the city, ending its local independence and turning Khotan into a Muslim Turkic oasis.

Under the Mongols, the Yuan court kept a pacification commissioner at the city, which the Chinese wrote as Woduan. Marco Polo, who passed through in the 1270s, noted its cotton, its vineyards and orchards, and a people who lived by trade and craft. After the Chagatai khanate broke up, Khotan was one of the western Tarim towns held by the Dughlat amirs, and later it belonged to the Yarkand khanate of Sultan Said Khan and his heirs. The Dzungars dominated the oases in the late 17th century, until Qing armies defeated them and in 1759 set up an imperial resident at Khotan to govern the southern oases.
simp_chinese:
于阗是塔里木盆地南缘的绿洲，昆仑山流下的玉龙喀什河与喀拉喀什河滋养着它，两条河名分别意为“白玉河”和“墨玉河”。它位于丝绸之路南道与通往印度、西藏的山口交会处，数百年间是一个佛教王国。1006年前后，喀什噶尔的喀喇汗王朝王子优素福·卡迪尔汗攻取此城，于阗从此失去地方自主，成为伊斯兰化的突厥绿洲。

蒙古统治时期，元廷在此设宣慰使司元帅府，汉文称其为斡端。13世纪70年代路过的马可·波罗记下了这里的棉花、葡萄园和果园，以及靠贸易与手工业为生的居民。察合台汗国瓦解后，于阗是杜格拉特异密所掌的塔里木西部城镇之一，后来归速檀·赛义德汗及其继承者的叶尔羌汗国所有。17世纪末准噶尔控制了各绿洲，直到清军将其击败，并于1759年在于阗设办事大臣，管辖南疆诸城。

english:
Khotchino, later known as Gatchina, was recorded in a Novgorodian land register in 1500 as a village by a small lake of the same name. It belonged to the Vodskaya division of Novgorod's territory. During the war of 1610–1617 Swedish forces occupied the surrounding lands, and the Treaty of Stolbovo placed them under Sweden. From 1624 Khotchino formed part of the Skvoritsa estate of the Oxenstierna family; Finnish-speaking settlers came to Ingria as part of the Swedish administration's settlement policy.

Russia regained the region during the Great Northern War. In the eighteenth century the Gatchina estate passed through several hands before Catherine II gave it to Count Grigory Orlov in 1765. Work began the following year on a palace designed by Antonio Rinaldi and a landscaped park. Catherine subsequently acquired the estate for her son Paul. Under his rule Gatchina received town status in 1796, transforming the former village into an imperial residence and town.
simp_chinese:
霍奇诺后来称为加特契纳。1500年的诺夫哥罗德土地登记簿记载，这座村庄位于同名小湖边，属于诺夫哥罗德领地的沃德斯卡亚区。1610至1617年战争中，瑞典军队占领周围土地；斯托尔博沃条约将其划归瑞典。1624年起，霍奇诺成为奥克森谢纳家族斯科沃里齐庄园的一部分；瑞典当局推行移民政策，讲芬兰语族语言的移民也来到英格里亚。

大北方战争期间，俄罗斯重新取得这一地区。十八世纪，加特契纳庄园几经易手，1765年叶卡捷琳娜二世将其赐给格里戈里·奥尔洛夫伯爵。次年，安东尼奥·里纳尔迪设计的宫殿和风景式园林开始修建。叶卡捷琳娜后来为儿子保罗买下庄园。保罗在位期间，加特契纳于1796年获得城镇地位，昔日村庄发展为皇室驻地和城镇。

english:
Khotiml occupied a fortified site among the forests of the upper Oka country. Its inner enclosure had at least two gates and an unusual advantage: a spring inside the defences filled a pond, whose excess water drained into a nearby stream. The earthworks belong to one of the substantial strongholds of the Karachev lands, a region of wooded river valleys and many small neighbouring princely possessions.

In 1499 the Lithuanian grand prince Alexander granted the Khotiml district to Prince Simeon of Mozhaysk, who entered Moscow’s service with his lands the following year. In the sixteenth and seventeenth centuries Khotiml remained the centre of a district of Karachev. The old fortification could still offer local people refuge when raiders threatened the countryside.
simp_chinese:
霍季姆利占据奥卡河上游森林中的一处设防地点。内城至少有两座城门，还有一个不同寻常的优势：城防内的泉水汇成池塘，多余的水经沟渠流入附近溪流。这些土垒属于卡拉切夫土地上一座规模可观的要塞；这里的森林河谷间分布着诸侯的小领地。

1499年，立陶宛大公亚历山大将霍季姆利辖区赐给莫扎伊斯克的西缅亲王；次年，西缅携领地转投莫斯科。十六至十七世纪，霍季姆利仍是卡拉切夫所属的辖区中心。当袭击者威胁乡村时，旧堡垒仍可为当地居民提供避难处。

english:
Khotmyzh stood on the Vorskla, a place named in late-medieval lists before a new Muscovite fortress revived it in 1640. The rebuilt town belonged to the Belgorod defensive line. In June that year, the commander Vasily Tolstoy reported that he had erected a stockade, towers, firing positions and a ditch, together with a state storehouse and a concealed access passage. A wooden Resurrection church formed part of the same construction effort.

Haste left weaknesses. When Fyodor Pushkin took command in March 1641, he criticised the quality of the work; Moscow excused Tolstoy because of the speed required. By 1650 a major rebuilding was necessary. The commander Kirill Arsenyev altered the plan, increasing the number of towers from seven to ten while reducing the gates from three to two. Fortress, church and garrison gave Khotmyzh a renewed role in the settlement and defence of the forest-steppe frontier.
simp_chinese:
霍特梅日在沃尔斯克拉河畔，中世纪后期地名录中已有记载；1640年新建莫斯科国家堡垒后，聚落再度兴起。新城属于别尔哥罗德防线。当年六月，统领瓦西里·托尔斯泰报告，木栅、城塔、射击位置与壕沟已经建成，另有官库及隐蔽通道。木结构复活教堂也属于同一轮营建。

仓促施工留下隐患。1641年三月，费奥多尔·普希金接任时批评工程质量；莫斯科考虑到工期紧迫，未追究托尔斯泰。至1650年，堡垒已须大修。统领基里尔·阿尔谢尼耶夫调整布局，将城塔由七座增为十座，城门却由三座减为两座。堡垒、教堂与驻军，使霍特梅日重新参与森林草原边地的定居与防御。

english: Khotoshino lies on the upper Volga northwest of Selizharovo, where the young river passes through a country of lakes and forests. Local historical tradition associates the place with Khotshin, a town of the Smolensk principality mentioned in the twelfth century. A church dedicated to the Exaltation of the Cross served the surrounding villages; its surviving parish records begin in 1802. Fields spread over the low hill on which the church stood above the river.
simp_chinese: 霍托希诺位于谢利扎罗沃西北方的伏尔加河上游，年轻的河流从湖泊与森林之间流过。地方史传统将这里与十二世纪斯摩棱斯克公国的霍特欣城联系起来。奉献给圣十字升举的教堂服务于周围村庄，其保存下来的教区记录始于1802年。教堂坐落在河上方低缓山丘上，四周是田野。

english: Khotsimsk lies on the Besed River in the eastern part of the old Mstsislaw lands. Mentioned as a village in 1398, it had a church, an inn and a mill by 1714. Across the river a town called Radzivilov was established, with a church and synagogue among its buildings. Following the first partition of the Commonwealth in 1772, Radzivilov took the name Khotsimsk and became part of the Krychaw estate held by Potemkin.
simp_chinese: 霍齐姆斯克位于别谢德河畔，处在古姆斯季斯拉夫地区东部。它作为村庄见于1398年的记载；到1714年，这里已有教堂、客栈和磨坊。河对岸建立了名为拉齐维洛夫的城镇，其中有教堂和犹太会堂。1772年联邦第一次被瓜分后，拉齐维洛夫改称霍齐姆斯克，成为波将金所持克雷乔夫领地的一部分。

english: Khotsy lies in the wooded country south of the Syas, in the old Obonezhskaya lands of Novgorod. The countryside was divided into church districts, or pogosts, which gathered scattered villages around a place of worship. A survey of the region’s districts names the Resurrection pogost on the Lipna and St George’s at Nebolchi among its neighbours. These rural centres survived the absorption of Novgorod by Moscow in the late fifteenth century.
simp_chinese: 霍齐位于夏西河以南的森林地带，属于诺夫哥罗德古老的奥博涅日地区。乡村分为若干教堂辖区，散布的村庄围绕礼拜中心组织起来。当地教堂辖区的记载提到附近利普纳河上的复活教堂村和涅博尔奇的圣乔治教堂村。十五世纪末诺夫哥罗德被莫斯科吞并后，这些乡村中心依然延续。

english:
Khovd stands at the foot of the Altai Mountains, near the Buyant River and the great expanse of Khar-Us Lake. Its cold desert climate brings long, dry winters and short, warm summers, with little rain outside the summer months. The town grew in the country between the mountains and the lakes of western Mongolia.

Galdan Boshugtu Khan of the Dzungars established Khovd in 1685 on the Khovd River. Captives from Central Asia brought cultivation skills, and gardens were developed around the settlement. After the destruction of the Dzungar Khanate in the 1750s, the Qing authorities moved the town to the Buyant River. It became an administrative centre in a region inhabited by several Mongol communities, linking the lands of the Altai with the basin to the east.
simp_chinese:
科布多位于阿尔泰山麓，靠近布彦特河与广阔的哈尔乌斯湖。当地属于寒冷荒漠气候，冬季漫长干燥，夏季短暂温暖，降水主要集中在夏季。城镇兴起于蒙古西部山脉与湖泊之间。

准噶尔汗国的噶尔丹博硕克图汗于1685年在科布多河畔建立科布多。来自中亚的俘虏带来耕作经验，聚落周围发展出园圃。准噶尔汗国于十八世纪五十年代灭亡后，清朝当局将城镇迁至布彦特河畔，使其成为多个蒙古族群居住地区的行政中心，联系阿尔泰山地与东方盆地。

english: Khowesen belongs to the dry southern Namibian country near the Karas ranges and the western margins of the Kalahari. Sparse rainfall, scattered water, and seasonal grazing shape the possibilities of settlement and movement. Pastoral households can use resources spread across broad areas, while hunting and gathering provide additional foods and materials. Knowledge of springs, routes, and changing conditions is essential in a landscape whose productive places may be widely separated. In the wider southern Namibian region, Nama pastoral communities organized life around livestock and relationships of kinship and access to resources. From the late eighteenth century, Oorlam groups moved north from the Cape across the Orange River, bringing new connections and political pressures to Nama country.
simp_chinese: 科韦森属于纳米比亚南部干燥地区，邻近卡拉斯山地与卡拉哈里西缘。降雨稀疏、水源分散和季节草场，决定居住与移动条件。牧业家庭能够利用分布广泛的资源，狩猎采集提供额外食物和材料。熟悉泉水、道路及环境变化十分重要，因为能够支持生产的地点可能相距遥远。在更广阔的纳米比亚南部地区，纳马牧业社区的生活围绕牲畜、亲属关系与资源使用展开。18世纪末起，奥尔拉姆人群从开普向北跨过奥兰治河，给纳马地区带来新的联系与政治压力。

english:
Khoy stands on a fertile plain north of Lake Urmia, enclosed by high mountains. Its position between Azarbaijan, Armenia and Anatolia made it a stopping place on the caravan road west from Tabriz. Travellers and merchants crossed its plain on journeys between the Iranian plateau and the lands beyond the mountains.

In 1478 rival Aq Qoyunlu princes fought a decisive battle near Khoy, opening the road to Tabriz to Yaqub. Shah Ismail I later gathered his forces here before the campaign that ended at Chaldiran in 1514. Ottoman and Safavid armies repeatedly contested the town, while the Kurdish Donboli emerged as its leading local family and served as frontier guardians. Khoy was destroyed in 1636–37 and revived after peace was made three years later.
simp_chinese:
霍伊位于乌尔米耶湖北方的肥沃平原上，四周群山环绕。它处在阿塞拜疆、亚美尼亚和安纳托利亚之间，是从大不里士向西的商队道路上的歇脚地。旅人和商队穿过这片平原，往来于伊朗高原与山外诸地。

1478年，争夺王位的白羊王朝诸王子在霍伊附近决战，胜者雅古卜得以进军大不里士。后来，沙阿伊斯玛仪一世在此集结军队，展开以1514年查尔迪兰之战告终的远征。奥斯曼与萨法维军队反复争夺这座城镇，而库尔德敦布利家族成为当地主要势力，并守卫边疆。霍伊于1636—1637年被毁，三年后和平达成，城市才得以复兴。

english: ǃKhuai is remembered as a San language of the southern African interior, recorded among the languages once spoken in the wider Vaal and Orange River country. Across the Karoo to the south, San hunting communities followed paths through dry plains and broken hills. Rock engravings and paintings bear witness to the people who knew these landscapes before colonial livestock farms advanced into the interior. Their languages belonged to a varied world of local communities rather than a single speech shared across the region.
simp_chinese: 库艾是南部非洲内陆的一门桑人语言，曾被记载于瓦尔河与奥兰治河周边的广大地区。南面的卡鲁遍布干燥平原和起伏丘陵，桑人狩猎社群沿小径穿行其间。岩刻与岩画见证了殖民牧场向内陆扩张之前熟悉这些土地的人们。他们的语言各具特色，并非整个地区共享的一种言语。

english:
Khuchni belongs to southern Dagestan, where steep valleys and mountain ridges supported communities with distinct languages and local institutions. Farming occupied terraces and suitable valley ground, while livestock used seasonal pasture. Stone-built villages concentrated homes and defensive features within terrain that could limit movement. Paths connected settlements with lower markets and routes toward the Caspian, allowing agricultural goods, animals and crafts to circulate between different environments.

Until the middle of the seventeenth century Khuchni was the residence of the Tabasaran maisum, a local ruler, and later of the Tabasaran qadi. It lay on routes between upper and lower Tabasaran and towards Derbent. The wider Dagestani region also faced the interests of Iranian, Ottoman and later Russian powers. Mountain communities maintained varied local institutions, while commerce and conflict connected them to the plains and Caspian routes.
simp_chinese:
胡奇尼属于达吉斯坦南部，陡峭河谷和山脊支撑语言、地方制度各异的社群。耕作利用梯田与适宜谷地，牲畜则使用季节草场。石筑村落在限制移动的地形中集中住房与防御设施，小路把聚落同低地市场及通向里海的路线连接起来，让农产品、牲畜和工艺品在不同环境间流动。地方经验是安全旅行的重要条件。

十七世纪中叶以前，胡奇尼是塔巴萨兰地方统治者迈苏姆的驻地，后来又成为当地卡迪的驻地。这里处在连接塔巴萨兰上下地区以及通往杰尔宾特的道路上。更广大达吉斯坦地区也受到伊朗、奥斯曼及后来俄国势力的影响。山地社群保有多样的地方制度，商业与冲突则使其同平原及里海路线相连。

english: Khudan takes its name from a river of the uplands east of Lake Baikal. The Khudan rises near the junction of the Khudan and Tsagan-Khurtei ranges, not far from the mountain that shares its name. Flowing generally west-northwest, it joins the Uda, whose waters in turn reach the Selenga. The river's long winter freeze typically lasts from autumn until April or May.
simp_chinese: 胡丹得名于贝加尔湖以东高地的一条河流。胡丹河发源于胡丹山脉与察干呼尔特山脉交会处，距同名山峰不远。河水大致向西北偏西流入乌达河，再随之汇入色楞格河。漫长的冰冻期通常从秋季持续到次年四月或五月。

english:
Khujand stands on the Syr Darya near the entrance to the Fergana Valley. In the fourteenth century it served as a seat of the Jalayir, one of the powerful groups of the Chaghatay realm. Factional struggles brought changes of control before the city became a separate district of the Timurid state. Babur later used it as a base during his attempts to obtain Samarkand, praising its pomegranates while also recording poverty and an unhealthy climate.

Muhammad Shaybani captured Khujand in 1503. The city subsequently passed among competing rulers, retaining local autonomy at times. The Jungar raid of 1723 drove Kazakh, Karakalpak and Uzbek migrants into the surrounding country. During the eighteenth and early nineteenth centuries, Bukhara and Kokand contested the city for its strategic position and economic strength. Its governor relied on local religious scholars in administering justice. Khujand thus combined a productive urban society with a contested gateway, where political changes repeatedly altered the relationship between local authority and outside rulers.
simp_chinese:
苦盏位于锡尔河旁、费尔干纳谷地入口附近。十四世纪，它曾是察合台地域强大集团札剌亦儿的驻地；派系斗争引发控制权变化，随后城市成为帖木儿国家的独立行政辖区。巴布尔争夺撒马尔罕时也曾以此为基地，称赞当地石榴，同时记述贫困和不健康的气候。

穆罕默德·昔班尼于1503年夺取苦盏。此后城市在不同统治者之间转移，有时保留地方自主。1723年准噶尔袭击迫使哈萨克、卡拉卡尔帕克与乌兹别克移民进入周围地区。十八至十九世纪初，布哈拉和浩罕因战略位置与经济实力争夺该城，地方长官依靠宗教学者处理司法事务。苦盏的城市社会与交通门户地位相连，政权变化反复改变地方权威和外来统治者的关系。

english: In the Camdeboo country of the Great Karoo, a bend of the Sundays River shelters the settlement later known as Graaff-Reinet. Mountains rise beyond the river and the dry plains around it. The Dutch East India Company established an administrative centre here in 1786, naming it after the Cape governor Van de Graaff and his wife Reinet. In 1795 dissatisfied settlers expelled the Company's magistrate and proclaimed a republic. The experiment was short-lived: British occupation of the Cape brought a new authority to the district.
simp_chinese: 在大卡鲁的卡姆德布地区，松德斯河的弯道环抱着后来称为格拉夫—里内特的聚落。河流和周围干燥平原之外，群山拔地而起。1786年，荷兰东印度公司在此建立行政中心，以开普总督范德格拉夫及其妻里内特命名。1795年，不满公司统治的殖民者驱逐了地方长官并宣布成立共和国。这次尝试转瞬即逝：英国占领开普后，新的权力进入了这一地区。

english:
Khukhan lies on the southern Khorat Plateau, north of the Dangrek Mountains. Its local history connects the founding of the later town with Kuy leaders skilled in capturing wild elephants. When a white elephant escaped from Ayutthaya, hunters from the region helped recover it and were rewarded by the Siamese court. One of them, Ta Kacha, became the first ruler of Khukhan when his settlement was raised to the rank of a town.

The later city of Sisaket lies here.
simp_chinese:
库坎位于呵叻高原南部、扁担山脉以北。地方史将后来的城镇建立与擅长捕捉野象的库伊人首领联系起来。一头白象从大城逃走后，当地猎人协助寻回，受到暹罗王廷赏赐。其中一人塔卡差的聚落后来被提升为库坎城，他本人也获得官衔，成为这座新城的首任城主。

后来的四色菊即位于此地。

english:
Khukhragarh was a fortified capital of the Nagvanshi rulers of Chota Nagpur. Its site lies among the hills west of Ranchi, where mounds preserve traces of the old settlement. Tradition attributes the move here to the ruler Bhim Karn. The kingdom was known to the Mughals as Khukhra and attracted their attention for its diamonds as well as its strategic position.

In 1615 the Mughal governor of Bihar, Ibrahim Khan, marched against the Nagvanshi ruler Durjan Shah. The emperor Jahangir sought both submission and access to diamonds found in the rivers of the region. Durjan Shah was captured and carried away; after his release he established a new fortified seat at Navratangarh. Khukhragarh remained associated with the earlier royal house, while the move marked a new chapter in the history of the plateau kingdom.
simp_chinese:
库克拉加尔是乔塔纳格普尔纳格万希统治者的一座设防都城。遗址位于兰契以西丘陵间，土丘保存着旧聚落的痕迹。传统认为统治者比姆·卡恩曾将都城迁至此地。莫卧儿人称这一王国为库克拉，钻石及其战略位置吸引了他们的注意。

1615年，莫卧儿比哈尔总督易卜拉欣汗进攻纳格万希统治者杜尔詹沙。皇帝贾汉吉尔既希望其臣服，也希望取得当地河床出产的钻石。杜尔詹沙被俘带走，获释后在纳夫拉特安加尔建立新的设防驻地。库克拉加尔仍与早期王室相联系，迁都则开启了高原王国历史的新篇章。

english:
Khulays was a group of settlements and cultivated ground on the pilgrimage road north of Mecca. Visiting in January 1815, Johann Ludwig Burckhardt described scattered hamlets on a broad plain, with date palms and fields of sorghum, millet and okra. The largest settlement, Es-Souk, contained about fifty low mud houses and a street of shops. Pilgrimage caravans camped near this market, where provisions included dates, grain, rice, onions and spices.

Water gave the settlement its fertility and its vulnerability. A warm spring fed a pool and irrigation channels, but Burckhardt found the pool damaged and heard complaints that drought was harming the plantations. He also recorded an older account attributing the pool and a travellers' shelter to the Egyptian sultan Qaitbay around 1480. Khulays was a centre of the Zubayd branch of Harb, whose cultivators could also spend part of the year under tents with their livestock. Agriculture, pastoral movement and caravan provisioning met in the same small oasis economy.
simp_chinese:
胡莱斯是麦加以北朝觐道路上的一组聚落与农地。1815年1月到访的约翰·路德维希·布尔克哈特记载，宽阔平原上散布着村落、椰枣园，以及种植高粱、黍类和秋葵的田地。最大的聚落苏格有约五十座低矮土屋，主街两侧设有商店。朝觐队伍在市场附近扎营，旅客可购买椰枣、谷物、稻米、洋葱与香料。

水源赋予聚落生机，也使它容易受旱情影响。温泉水流入蓄水池，再经渠道灌田；布尔克哈特见到水池已经损坏，并听见居民抱怨久旱伤害种植园。他还引述旧说，称水池与旅人歇息处由埃及苏丹盖特贝约于1480年修建。胡莱斯也是哈卜部落祖拜德支系的中心，一部分耕作者每年仍会携牲畜住入荒野帐篷。耕作、放牧与朝觐补给在这片绿洲交汇。

english:
Khulm lay east of Balkh, where an irrigated oasis met routes through the Hindu Kush. Its older settlement and the nearby town of Tashqurghan belonged to the same local political world, but their histories were not identical. During the later eighteenth and early nineteenth centuries, Mir Qilich Ali Beg made Tashqurghan his capital. By 1824 the older Khulm settlement was largely abandoned as activity shifted to the newer centre.

From Tashqurghan, Qilich Ali exercised power over neighbouring territories including Aibak, Ghori, Saighan and Kahmard. His position depended on troops, local chiefs and relationships extending across northern Afghanistan. After his death, his sons Mir Baba and Mir Wali competed for control, while the rulers of Kunduz sought influence in the same country. The movement of the capital therefore joined local urban change to struggles among regional powers. Khulm's historical name survived even as settlement, commerce and political authority became concentrated at Tashqurghan.
simp_chinese:
霍勒姆位于巴尔赫以东，灌溉绿洲与通往兴都库什山的道路在此相接。旧聚落与附近的塔什库尔干属于同一个地方政治世界，却有不同的发展经历。十八世纪后期至十九世纪初，米尔·齐利奇·阿里贝格将首府设在塔什库尔干；至1824年，旧霍勒姆已大体荒废，活动转移到新的中心。

齐利奇·阿里从塔什库尔干控制艾巴克、戈里、赛甘和卡赫马尔德等邻近地区，权力依赖军队、地方首领，以及横跨阿富汗北部的关系。他去世以后，儿子米尔·巴巴与米尔·瓦利争夺统治，昆都士的统治者也在同一地区扩展影响。首府迁移因而将地方城镇变迁与区域政权竞争连接起来。霍勒姆之名继续存在，聚落、商业与权威则逐渐集中到塔什库尔干。

sources.title: 1972 Bazaar-e-Tashqurghan--ethnographical studies in an Afghan bazaar by Charpentier s.pdf

english:
Khulna began as a small riverside settlement on the edge of the Sundarbans. Boats carrying wood, honey and salt from the forest stopped here, making it a local trading place amid the channels of the lower Ganges delta. The waterways themselves changed over time: the Rupsha grew from a small navigable channel into a major river beside the settlement.

In the fifteenth century Khan Jahan Ali received lands in the wider Khulna region from the Bengal Sultanate. He is associated with the foundation of Khalifatabad, where mosques, roads and excavated tanks supported settlement on the forested delta frontier. Khulna lay within a landscape increasingly connected by these waterways and by the movement of people and goods between the forest and cultivated country.
simp_chinese:
库尔纳最初是孙德尔本斯边缘的一个小型河畔聚落。船只从森林运来木材、蜂蜜和盐，在此停泊，使它成为恒河下游三角洲水道间的地方贸易点。水道本身也随时间变化：鲁普沙河从一条可供船只通行的小水道逐渐发展为聚落旁的大河。

十五世纪，汗·贾汗·阿里从孟加拉苏丹国获得广阔库尔纳地区的土地。他与哈里发塔巴德的创建相联系，那里的清真寺、道路和开凿的水池支持了森林三角洲边缘的聚落发展。库尔纳所处的地区，因水路以及森林与耕地之间的人货往来而日益紧密相连。

english: Khumar overlooks the upper Kuban from a rocky plateau defended by steep slopes and ravines on three sides. Here stood a substantial early medieval fortress, active during the age of the Khazar Khaganate. Its builders strengthened the natural defenses with a ditch, stone walls, towers and guarded gates; a citadel occupied the interior, and ceramic pipes carried water towards a well. The stronghold watched routes through the northern Caucasus, but ceased to function in the tenth century as Khazar power declined.
simp_chinese: 胡马尔俯瞰库班河上游，位于一处岩石高台上，三面受陡坡与沟谷保护。这里曾有一座规模可观的中世纪早期堡垒，在可萨汗国时代发挥作用。建造者以壕沟、石墙、塔楼和设防城门强化天然屏障；内侧有堡中堡，陶管将水引向井口。堡垒守望着穿越北高加索的道路，但随着可萨势力衰落，于十世纪停止使用。

english: The Khun Tan Range runs through the northern Thai highlands between the Ping and Wang river basins. Its wooded ridges divide the valleys around Lamphun and Lampang, two old centres of the northern country. Streams descend from the mountains towards both rivers, and routes between the neighbouring valleys must cross the forested heights or find their way through gaps in the range.
simp_chinese: 坤丹山脉横贯泰北高地，位于宾河与旺河流域之间。林木覆盖的山脊分隔了南奔和南邦周围的谷地，这两处都是北方地区古老的中心。溪流从群山分别流向两条河流，往来邻近谷地的道路则需翻越森林茂密的高地，或穿行于山脉间的缺口。

english:
This place lies in the Gareja country of eastern Georgia, in the Kakheti region, on the half-desert slopes of Mount Gareja at the edge of the Iori Plateau. Rock faces here were hollowed out into hundreds of cells, churches, chapels and refectories, the dwellings of monks who settled in the caves.

The complex was founded in the sixth century by David of Gareji, one of thirteen Assyrian monks who arrived in the country together. His disciples Dodo and Luciane enlarged the original lavra and founded two more monasteries, and in the ninth century Hilarion the Iberian guided further growth. Georgian royal and noble families patronized the monasteries, which at certain periods owned extensive farmland and many villages. In the twelfth century King Demetre I chose the complex as his place of confinement after abdicating the throne.
simp_chinese:
此地位于格鲁吉亚东部卡赫季地区的伽雷贾一带，处在伊奥里高原边缘、伽雷贾山的半荒漠坡地上。岩壁被凿空，形成数百间僧房、教堂、礼拜堂和食堂，是在洞穴中定居的僧人的住所。

这一修道院群始建于六世纪，由十三位同时抵达格鲁吉亚的亚述僧人之一、伽雷贾的大卫创立。其门徒多多与卢奇亚内扩建了原有的修道院，又另建两座修道院；九世纪时，伊比利亚人伊拉里翁推动其进一步发展。格鲁吉亚王室与贵族资助修道院，某些时期修道院拥有广阔田地和许多村庄。十二世纪，国王德梅特雷一世退位后选择此处作为幽居之所。

english:
Khunj lies in southern Fars on the routes joining the inland towns to the Persian Gulf. In the fourteenth century Ibn Battuta stopped at Khunju Pal, the Khunj and Fal district, and visited the tomb of the revered Shaikh Daniyal, over which a ruler of Hormuz had raised a large dome.

He also stayed at a religious lodge whose ascetics followed the Shafi'i school and shared a meal with their visitors. Sufi teachers, pilgrim hospitality and the patronage of the Hormuzi rulers shaped the place, and the roads through Lar carried travellers from this inland district down to the Gulf ports.
simp_chinese:
洪杰位于法尔斯南部，处在内陆城镇通往波斯湾的道路上。十四世纪，伊本·白图泰来到洪朱帕尔，即洪杰与法勒地区，拜谒了受尊崇的谢赫达尼亚尔之墓，霍尔木兹统治者曾在墓上建造大穹顶。

他还在一所修道场所投宿，那里的苦修者遵循沙斐仪学派，并与来客共餐。苏菲教师、朝访接待和霍尔木兹统治者的庇护塑造了这个地方，经拉尔的道路又把旅人从这片内陆地区带往海湾港口。

english:
Khunwana lies among the low rocky hills of the southern African interior. The surrounding land formed part of the country of the Barolong, a Tswana people whose territory extended between the Molopo and the Vaal. By the beginning of the nineteenth century, Khunwana and Maquassie were counted among their principal centres. Cultivation and cattle keeping supported communities in a region where most rain falls during the summer months.

The later city of Mafikeng lies here.
simp_chinese:
库纳瓦纳坐落在非洲南部内陆低矮的岩石丘陵之间。周围土地属于巴罗隆人地区的一部分；这个茨瓦纳族群的领地横跨莫洛波河与瓦尔河之间。到19世纪初，库纳瓦纳和马夸西已是他们的重要中心。这里的降雨多集中在夏季，居民以耕种和养牛维持生计。

后来的梅富根即位于此地。

english:
Khunzakh stands on a high plateau in the mountains of Dagestan. It was the seat of the rulers of Avaria, whose authority extended over a mountainous country of deep valleys and independent communities. From the early thirteenth century the settlement served as the capital of the Avar khanate, a political center among the diverse peoples of the eastern Caucasus.

In the early nineteenth century the khanate became caught between Russian expansion and the religious and political movement led by the imams of Dagestan. In 1830 Ghazi Muhammad attacked Khunzakh but failed to take it. Four years later his successor Hamzat Bek captured the town and had members of the ruling family killed. His victory was brief: later that year opponents seeking revenge assassinated him in the mosque at Khunzakh.
simp_chinese:
洪扎赫位于达吉斯坦山区的一处高原，是阿瓦里亚统治者的驻地。他们的权力伸展于深谷纵横、分布着独立社群的山地之间。自十三世纪初起，这座聚落成为阿瓦尔汗国的都城，是东高加索众多民族中的一个政治中心。

十九世纪初，汗国被卷入俄国扩张与达吉斯坦伊玛目领导的宗教政治运动之间。1830年，伽齐·穆罕默德进攻洪扎赫，却未能攻下。四年后，他的继任者哈姆扎特贝克占领城镇，杀害了统治家族成员。他的胜利十分短暂：同年晚些时候，寻求复仇的敌手在洪扎赫清真寺内将他刺杀。

english: Khupati lies on the eastern Black Sea coast in the country of the Laz, where steep wooded mountains approach the sea. Georgian sources of the eleventh and twelfth centuries use this name for the place later known as Hopa. An old tradition recalls a fortress of Khupati as a boundary point between neighbouring powers. Its coastal position placed the settlement along the narrow route between Trebizond and the lands of the eastern Black Sea.
simp_chinese: 胡帕蒂位于东黑海沿岸的拉兹地区，陡峭林木山岭逼近大海。十一和十二世纪的格鲁吉亚文献用这一名称指称后来叫霍帕的地方。古老传统记载，胡帕蒂堡垒曾是相邻势力间的边界地点。滨海位置使聚落处在特拉比松与黑海东部地区之间狭窄的道路上。

english: Khurays lies in the dry interior west of al-Ahsa, where the red sands of ad-Dahna meet stony ground. To the northeast stretches the Suman plateau, whose shallow depressions collect rainwater. After rain, places such as Umm Sidr can turn green with pasture, while the surrounding plateau remains a landscape of rock, sand and intermittent water.
simp_chinese: 胡赖斯位于哈萨以西的干旱内陆，代赫纳红沙在这里与石质地面相接。东北方延伸着苏曼高原，浅洼地汇集雨水。雨后乌姆西德尔等洼地会长出牧草，周围高原则仍是岩石、沙地和间歇性水源构成的景观。

english: The Khurbe, or Kurba, is a river of the wooded country east of Lake Baikal. Its upper waters descend from the southern slopes of the Ulan-Burgasy range, and the river flows onward to join the Uda, itself a tributary of the Selenga. Forested mountains surround its valley, while the river bends across the wider lowlands near its mouth. In Buryat tradition its name is associated with the hero Babzha-Baras Bator.
simp_chinese: 呼尔贝河又称库尔巴河，流经贝加尔湖以东的有林地区。上游河水从乌兰布尔加瑟山脉南坡流下，最终汇入色楞格河支流乌达河。河谷为森林山地环绕，接近河口处，河流在较宽阔的低地上蜿蜒。布里亚特人的传说将这条河的名字与英雄巴布扎巴拉斯巴托尔联系在一起。

english:
Khurda was the seat of the Gajapati kings of Odisha after the fall of the older kingdom centred on Cuttack. Its rulers claimed a special relationship with Jagannath at Puri as guardians of the great temple. The paikas, cultivators who also rendered military service, formed an important part of their armed following.

The East India Company occupied coastal Odisha in 1803. Resistance led by Jai Rajguru on behalf of the young king Mukunda Deva was defeated, and the kingdom lost its independence. Company revenue measures, the resumption of service lands and the salt duty created further grievances. In March 1817 Kandha fighters from Ghumusar entered Khurda and joined the paikas under their former commander Bakshi Jagabandhu. They attacked Company offices and the treasury; the rising spread to Puri and other parts of Odisha before being suppressed. Jagabandhu and other rebels continued to evade Company forces in the forests for years afterwards.
simp_chinese:
库尔达是奥里萨旧王国在克塔克的政权覆灭后，伽阇钵底诸王的驻地。统治者以普里的贾甘纳特大神庙守护者自居，与神祇保持特殊关系。平时耕种、战时服兵役的派卡人，是其武装力量的重要组成部分。

1803年，东印度公司占领奥里萨沿海。贾伊·拉杰古鲁代表年幼的穆昆达·德奥王领导抵抗，最终失败，王国失去独立。公司的税收措施、收回服役土地和盐税带来更多不满。1817年3月，来自古穆萨尔的孔达战士进入库尔达，与前指挥官巴克希·贾甘班杜领导的派卡人会合。他们袭击公司官署和金库；起义扩展至普里及奥里萨其他地区，随后被镇压。贾甘班杜等起义者此后多年仍在森林中躲避公司军队。

english: Khurgan lies in the high lake country of the Mongolian Altai. Khurgan Lake is linked to neighbouring Khoton Lake by a short channel, and their waters help feed the Khovd River. Mountain streams bring water down to the lakes from the surrounding ranges. The shores and valleys form a striking contrast with the drier basins downstream, through which the Khovd continues toward the Great Lakes of western Mongolia.
simp_chinese: 呼尔干位于蒙古阿尔泰山的高山湖泊地带。呼尔干湖与邻近的霍通湖由一条短水道相连，两湖的水共同汇入科布多河。山间溪流从周围山岭流向湖泊；湖岸和河谷与下游较为干燥的盆地形成鲜明对照。科布多河继续穿过盆地，流向蒙古西部的大湖地区。

sources.title: khar lake khovd mngt plan brief final eng.pdf

english: Khurgancha lies in the lower Amu Darya country near the Kokdarya channel and Akpetki. Lakes, reed beds and sandy ground meet in this part of the delta, where waterbirds gather among the shallows. Great crested grebes and Dalmatian pelicans have been recorded at Ashchikul, a lake beside the Kokdarya, in the wider Akpetki wetlands.
simp_chinese: 胡尔干察位于阿姆河下游，靠近科克达里亚水道和阿克佩特基地区。三角洲的这一带湖泊、芦苇丛和沙地相接，水鸟聚集在浅水间。阿克佩特基湿地中，科克达里亚旁的阿什奇库尔湖有凤头鸊鷉和卷羽鹈鹕出没。

english: Khusf lies west of Birjand in the dry country of Quhistan. The village was the home of the fifteenth-century poet Ibn Husam Khusfi, a farmer and learned Shiite who wrote in praise of figures revered in Islam. In 1426–27 he completed the Khavaran-nama, a Persian religious epic recounting an imagined journey and exploits of Ali. His work joined the language of heroic poetry to devotion, giving this small oasis a place in Persian literary history.
simp_chinese: 胡斯夫位于比尔詹德以西、库希斯坦的干旱地区。十五世纪诗人伊本·胡萨姆·胡斯菲居住于此，他以耕作为生，是一位博学的什叶派信徒，诗作赞颂伊斯兰教中受尊崇的人物。1426至1427年，他完成波斯宗教史诗《哈瓦兰书》，叙述想象中阿里的旅程与功绩。作品将英雄诗歌的语言与宗教信仰结合，使这座小绿洲在波斯文学史中占有一席之地。

english: Khushab stands on the Jhelum River in western Punjab. Its name combines Persian words for “sweet” and “water,” recalling the water found beside the river. During the reign of the Mughal emperor Muhammad Shah, Khushab was managed by Nawab Ahmadyar Khan. After his death it passed to Raja Salamat Rai, who also administered nearby Bhera.
simp_chinese: 库沙布坐落在旁遮普西部的杰赫勒姆河畔。城名结合波斯语中“甘甜”与“水”两个词，让人想起河边的水源。莫卧儿皇帝穆罕默德沙在位时，库沙布由纳瓦布艾哈迈德亚尔汗管理。他去世后，此地转由萨拉马特·拉伊王掌管；附近的佩拉也在这位国王的治理之下。

english:
Khust stands where the Rika joins the upper Tisza, beneath a castle on a volcanic hill. The fortress guarded the route to the salt mines of Solotvyno and the entrance to the Maramureș basin. Its position made it an important stronghold in the mountain lands between Hungary and Transylvania.

In the sixteenth and seventeenth centuries Habsburg and Transylvanian rulers fought for Khust, while Ottoman and Tatar forces attacked the region. During the rising of Francis II Rákóczi, the castle garrison joined his supporters, and a Transylvanian diet met here in 1709. Lightning struck the fortress in 1766, causing a fire that destroyed its defences. The ruins on the hill recall the salt road and the wars once watched over from its walls.
simp_chinese:
赫斯特位于里卡河汇入蒂萨河上游之处，火山丘上的城堡俯瞰城镇。堡垒守卫通往索洛特维诺盐矿的道路和马拉穆列什盆地的入口，其位置使之成为匈牙利与特兰西瓦尼亚之间山地的重要据点。

16至17世纪，哈布斯堡与特兰西瓦尼亚统治者争夺赫斯特，奥斯曼和鞑靼军队也袭击这一地区。拉科齐·费伦茨二世起义期间，城堡守军加入其支持者，1709年特兰西瓦尼亚议会在此召开。1766年雷击堡垒，引发大火并毁坏防御工事。山丘上的废墟仍使人想起城墙曾守望的盐道和战争。

english: The Khute are among the peoples of the central Kalahari, a broad country of sand and sparse surface water. Their neighbours include the Gǀwi and Gǁana, whose languages belong to the Khoe family. In the dry Kalahari, people have drawn moisture from wild melons, roots and tubers as well as from animals. Knowledge of waterholes and seasonal plant foods helped hunters and their families travel between places across this thirsty interior.
simp_chinese: 库特人是卡拉哈里中部的人群之一，这片广阔的沙地缺少地表水。他们的邻居包括说科伊语系语言的格威人和格哈纳人。在干旱的卡拉哈里，人们除了从猎物身上获取水分，也利用野生瓜果、根和块茎。对水坑和季节性植物食物的了解，帮助猎人及其家人在这片干渴的内陆往来。

sources.title: 368845524 LOSING TO THE WORLD IN THE KALAHARI -SOME ASPECTS OF THE HISTORY OF THE GHANZI DISTRICT AND CKGR TO 1990 By

english: Khuuchid is the country of the Khuuchid Mongols, whose pastures extended along the lower Xilin River. Once associated with the Chahar, they came under Qing rule in the seventeenth century. The Qing established a left banner in 1646 and a right banner in 1653. Both later joined the Xilingol League, where the leaders of several neighbouring Mongol banners met to settle common affairs.
simp_chinese: 浩齐特是浩齐特蒙古人的地区，牧地沿锡林河下游延伸。他们曾属于察哈尔，十七世纪归附清朝。清廷于1646年设浩齐特左翼旗，1653年又设右翼旗。两旗后来同属锡林郭勒盟，邻近蒙古旗的首领在会盟时处理共同事务。

english:
Khuzdar occupies a narrow upland valley in the Jhalawan country of Balochistan. Its incorporation into the expanding state of Kalat belonged to the reign of Mir Ahmad, who took power in 1666–1667. The district gazetteer records Khuzdar among his conquests, together with Baghwana, Karkh and Chaku. These acquisitions helped join southern districts to the Ahmadzai dynasty's political centre at Kalat.

The eighteenth-century khanate was itself drawn into larger contests of power. Nader Shah's campaigns and, after his assassination in 1747, the ascendancy of Ahmad Shah Abdali placed Kalat's rulers within an Iranian-Afghan political arena. Mir Nasir Khan's long rule enlarged the khanate, while his death in 1795 opened a period of decline. Khuzdar's early modern setting was thus the formation and changing fortunes of Kalat's southern territory, where a local valley settlement became part of a wider khanate rather than a separate provincial capital of those larger empires.
simp_chinese:
胡兹达尔位于俾路支斯坦贾拉万地区的一条狭窄山谷中。它被纳入扩张中的卡拉特政权，发生在1666至1667年即位的米尔·艾哈迈德统治时期。地方志将胡兹达尔与巴格瓦纳、卡尔赫、查库一同列为他的征服之地。这些扩张把南部地区与艾哈迈德扎伊王朝在卡拉特的政治中心连接起来。

十八世纪，汗国又卷入更大的权力竞争。纳迪尔沙的军事活动，以及他1747年遇刺后艾哈迈德·沙阿·阿卜达里的崛起，使卡拉特统治者置身伊朗与阿富汗的政治格局之中。米尔·纳西尔汗长期在位时扩大了汗国，1795年去世后，政权则开始衰落。胡兹达尔的近代早期背景，因而主要是卡拉特南部疆域的形成与变动：山谷聚落成为汗国的一部分，并非这些大帝国在当地另设的省级首府。

english:
Kuzhupai was an East River settlement in the Huizhou region of eastern Guangdong, associated with present-day Guzhu. The river linked inland communities with Huizhou and the coast, while cultivated valleys and wooded slopes supplied local households. A station existed here under the Yuan, and a water-post was established at Kuzhupai market in the early Ming.

The settlement remained a point of transfer between water and land routes. In 1687 the scholar Qu Dajun travelled upriver from Huizhou to Kuzhupai before continuing inland. Its history shows the importance of river transport to local markets and to journeys across the hills of eastern Guangdong.
simp_chinese:
苦竹派是广东东部惠州地区的东江沿岸聚落，与今古竹镇相联系。河流将内陆社区同惠州及海岸连接起来，河谷耕地和林坡则供给地方家庭。元代这里设有苦竹派站，明初又在苦竹派市设水驿。

此地长期是水陆路线转换之处。康熙二十六年（1687年），学者屈大均从惠州沿东江乘船到苦竹派，再登岸向内陆行进。它的历史显示，河运对地方市场和穿越粤东丘陵的旅程都具有重要作用。

english:
Khvastovichi appears in the diplomatic negotiations between Moscow and Lithuania in January 1494. The settlement was listed among territories held by Prince Dmitry Vorotynsky whose status was contested as the Upper Oka princes changed allegiance. This surviving mention places the village within a frontier of competing dynastic claims; it does not establish when the settlement was founded.

Ivan III's testament of 1504 assigned Khvastovichi with the Kozelsk districts to his son Semyon. From 1505 it formed part of Semyon's Kaluga appanage, then returned to the grand prince Vasily III after Semyon's death in 1518. The village lay on the road from Kozelsk toward Karachev beside the Velya, a tributary of the Resseta. Its early history was thus tied to the division and reunion of princely lands along an important wooded corridor west of the Oka.
simp_chinese:
赫瓦斯托维奇出现在1494年1月莫斯科与立陶宛的外交交涉记录中。它被列为德米特里·沃罗滕斯基公爵掌握的领地之一。奥卡河上游诸公爵改变效忠对象时，这些地方的地位也成为争议问题。这份记载将村落置于王朝权利竞争的边疆，却不能据此确定其建村时间。

伊凡三世1504年的遗嘱，将赫瓦斯托维奇及科泽利斯克各区分给儿子谢苗。1505年起，这里属于谢苗的卡卢加封地；1518年谢苗死后，又归大公瓦西里三世。村落位于科泽利斯克通向卡拉切夫的道路旁，临列谢塔河支流韦利亚河。它的早期历史，因此与奥卡河以西森林通道上公国领地的分合紧密相连。

english:
Khvor, also written Khur, lies in the Khusf country west of Birjand in southern Khorasan. Its historical castle is attributed to the Safavid period, placing a fortified landmark within this village landscape of eastern Iran. The settlement belongs to the wider country of Quhistan, where cultivated places are separated by dry ground and mountain ranges. Water and the connections between habitable valleys gave this regional setting its distinctive character.

Fourteenth-century accounts of neighbouring Birjand describe a provincial centre whose dependencies produced saffron and some grain, with grapes and other fruit grown in surrounding villages. Qāʾen farther north remained another major centre of Quhistan. These places provided a broader network of markets and authority around the smaller settlements of the Khusf district. By the eighteenth and early nineteenth centuries, Birjand, Qāʾen and Qāʾenāt were associated with the local rulers of the Alam family. Khvor's Safavid-period fort belongs to this longer landscape of local strongholds and regional centres. It stands within a country where village life and cultivation continued alongside the changing political importance of the towns of southern Khorasan.
simp_chinese:
赫沃尔亦写作Khur，位于比尔詹德以西、呼罗珊南部的胡斯夫地区。当地古堡被断代为萨法维时期，为伊朗东部的村庄景观留下了一处防御建筑。聚落属于更广阔的库希斯坦地域，耕作地带之间隔着旱地与山岭。水源以及可居住河谷之间的联系，构成这一地区的鲜明条件。

十四世纪有关邻近比尔詹德的记载，将它描述为拥有若干属地的地方中心，出产藏红花及少量粮食，周边村庄还种葡萄等果品。更北的卡因也是库希斯坦的重要中心。这些城镇构成胡斯夫地区小聚落周围更广阔的市场与权力网络。十八世纪至十九世纪前期，比尔詹德、卡因和卡因纳特的地方统治与阿拉姆家族相联系。赫沃尔的萨法维时期古堡，属于地方堡垒和区域中心长期并存的景观；村庄生活与耕作，则伴随呼罗珊南部城镇政治地位的变化延续。

english: Khvorostyanka lies on the Chagra, east of the Volga, amid the open country south of Samara. Its foundation is traditionally dated to 1749, when settlement expanded across the river's steppe basin. Landowners acquired estates here, including Vasily Samarin, while fields spread across the fertile ground. Before this expansion, the landscape was a rolling plain with woodland, reed-filled lakes and grassland used by the peoples of the steppe.
simp_chinese: 赫沃罗斯江卡位于伏尔加河以东的恰格拉河畔，地处萨马拉以南的开阔地带。传统将村庄的建立定于1749年，当时定居区正在向河流所在的草原流域扩展。瓦西里·萨马林等地主在此取得庄园，田地逐渐遍布肥沃的土地。在此之前，这里是起伏的平原，林地、芦苇湖泊与草原民族使用的牧地交错。

english:
Khwānsār occupied a spring-fed mountain valley on a major route between Isfahan, Borujerd and Arāk. Its name itself was associated with springs, and its settlements maintained close connections with neighbouring Golpāyagān. The road crossed this watered enclave before continuing into the uplands of central Iran.

Safavid patronage left a more tangible religious landscape. The Maryam Begom madrasa was attributed to a daughter of Shah Ṣafi, while the shrine of Bābā Pir at Vānešān acquired a distinctive tall polygonal dome in the seventeenth century. The district also contained a Jewish community. The Armenian historian Aṙakʿel of Tabriz reported that Jews of Khwānsār and Golpāyagān avoided conversion through bribery, flight or resistance. Roads, religious endowments and the precarious position of minority communities thus shaped the town's early modern history.
simp_chinese:
霍万萨尔位于泉水充沛的山谷，处在连接伊斯法罕、博鲁杰尔德与阿拉克的重要道路上。地名本身便与泉源有关，各聚落也长期同邻近的戈勒派耶甘保持联系。道路穿过这一有水之地，再进入伊朗中部高地。

萨法维时代的赞助留下了更具体的宗教景观。玛丽亚姆·贝古姆经学院被认为由沙阿萨菲的一位女儿创建；瓦内尚的巴巴皮尔圣祠，则在十七世纪形成了高耸的多边形穹顶。地区内也有犹太社群。大不里士的亚美尼亚史家阿拉克尔记述，霍万萨尔和戈勒派耶甘的犹太人通过贿赂、逃离或抵抗避免改宗。道路、宗教捐产，以及少数社群的不安处境，共同塑造了当地的近世历史。

english: Khwar lies at the edge of the central Iranian salt desert, where the Hablarud descends from the Alborz into a cultivated plain. Rivers, canals and underground qanats supported fields and fodder in this dry country east of Varamin. Under the Safavids a road crossed the desert south of Khwar, linking Isfahan with the route towards Mazandaran. A stone causeway laid across the salt marshes, together with caravanserais and a small palace, helped travellers pass this difficult stretch of the plateau.
simp_chinese: 赫瓦尔位于伊朗中部盐漠边缘，哈布拉河从厄尔布尔士山流下，进入耕作平原。河流、渠道和地下坎儿井在瓦拉明以东的干旱地区滋养田地与牧草。萨法维时期，一条道路穿过赫瓦尔以南的荒漠，将伊斯法罕与通往马赞德兰的路线相连。横跨盐沼的石铺道以及商队旅舍、小型宫殿，帮助旅人渡过高原上这一艰难地段。

english: The Okavango spreads into a vast inland delta, where channels, islands and floodplains interrupt the dry Kalahari. Among its peoples are the Bugakhwe and ǁanikhwe, whose livelihoods include fishing, hunting and gathering wild plants. The Bugakhwe use resources of both woodland and river, while the ǁanikhwe are particularly associated with the waterways. Floodwaters from the Angolan highlands spread through the delta before sinking into the sands.
simp_chinese: 奥卡万戈河在卡拉哈里干旱地区展开为广阔的内陆三角洲，水道、岛屿与泛滥平原交织。这里的居民包括布加奎人与阿尼奎人，他们捕鱼、狩猎并采集野生植物。布加奎人利用林地和河流两种环境，阿尼奎人则尤其依赖水道。安哥拉高地的洪水在三角洲漫开，最终渗入沙地。

english:
Khyargas Nuur lies in western Mongolia's Great Lakes basin. In the eighteenth century, the country around the lake became part of the resettlement of Bayad and Dorbet communities during the collapse of the Dzungar state. One Bayad banner was led by Sevden, a noble who followed the three Tserens into Qing allegiance in 1753. The Qing court recognised his hereditary authority over his followers the following year.

These communities did not reach their later homeland in a single movement. After staying around Zag and Baidrag, Sevden's followers returned toward the Irtysh, then fled renewed warfare and travelled through Khovd to the Ulaangom country in 1758. Their banner occupied the southeastern part of the Bayad territory around Khyargas Lake, adjoining the Sartsuul banner to the south. Sevden had died in 1756, and his son Baasan inherited his office. The lake's eighteenth-century setting thus included displaced communities, hereditary leaders and new banner boundaries established amid war and migration.
simp_chinese:
哈尔嘎斯海位于蒙古西部大湖盆地。十八世纪，准噶尔国家瓦解，湖周地域进入巴雅特与杜尔伯特社群迁徙安置的历史。巴雅特一旗由贵族色布登率领，他于1753年追随三位策凌归附清朝，次年获得朝廷承认，世袭管领所属人口。

这些社群并未一次抵达后来驻地。色布登属民先居扎格、拜达里一带，随后返回额尔齐斯河地域，又因战乱折返，经科布多于1758年抵达乌兰固木。他们的旗地位于巴雅特地域东南、环绕哈尔嘎斯湖，南邻萨尔图勒旗。色布登1756年已去世，其子巴桑继承职任。湖区的十八世纪历史因而也包含流离社群、世袭首领，以及战争迁徙中形成的新旗界。

english: Khyunglung lies in the upper Sutlej valley of western Tibet, where cave dwellings and ruins occupy the steep, dry slopes above the river. Bön tradition associates the place with the Silver Castle of Khyunglung and the ancient kingdom of Zhang Zhung. The valley lies to the west of Mount Kailash, in a landscape of high desert cut by the river and its tributaries. Its remains bear witness to a long history of settlement in western Tibet.
simp_chinese: 穹隆位于藏西象泉河上游河谷，河边干燥陡峭的山坡上留有洞穴居所和遗址。苯教传统将这里与穹隆银城及古代象雄王国联系在一起。河谷位于冈仁波齐峰以西，象泉河及其支流切开高寒荒漠；当地遗存见证了藏西悠久的定居历史，也使这片河谷在苯教的地方传说中占有重要地位。

english: Kialegak is a long, stony sand spit on the eastern coast of St. Lawrence Island in the Bering Sea. Reefs extend from its shore, where the remains of an Indigenous village mark an old place of habitation. In 1816 the expedition of Otto von Kotzebue visited the island; its account records that the inhabitants called the eastern part Kialegak and the western part Sevuokok. Farther offshore lie the Punuk Islands, separated from one another by a narrow channel.
simp_chinese: 基亚莱加克是白令海圣劳伦斯岛东岸一条布满岩石的狭长沙嘴。海礁从岸边向外延伸，原住民村落的遗迹则留下了往昔定居的痕迹。1816年，奥托·冯·科策布的探险队来到岛上；其记述称，居民把岛屿东部称为基亚莱加克，西部称为塞武奥科克。更远的海面上是普努克群岛，岛屿之间隔着狭窄水道。

english: The Kiamichi River rises in the forested Ouachita country and flows southwest to the Red River. Its valley provides a passage between the mountains and the lowlands, with tributaries descending from wooded ridges. Caddo communities used the river corridor, and a mound center stood across the Red River near its mouth. Early French visitors knew the waterway, and in 1805 John Sibley recorded its name while describing the upper Red River.
simp_chinese: 基亚米奇河发源于森林覆盖的瓦希托地区，向西南流入红河。河谷是山地与低地之间的通道，支流从林木茂密的山脊流下。卡多社群利用这一河流通道，河口对岸的红河边还有一处土丘中心。早期法国来访者知道这条水道；1805年，约翰·西布利描述红河上游时记下了它的名字。

english: The Kiamika River winds through the forests and lakes of the Laurentian country before joining the Lièvre, a tributary of the Ottawa River. Its Algonquin name has been interpreted in more than one way, but the river itself was part of a landscape long known to Indigenous hunters and fishers. Along the Lièvre, beaver, bear, otter and mink were among the animals sought for their fur. The river also served as a route of exchange between the people of the interior and other Indigenous nations of the Ottawa Valley.
simp_chinese: 基亚米卡河蜿蜒穿过劳伦提亚地区的森林与湖泊，汇入渥太华河的支流列弗尔河。这条河的阿尔冈昆语名称有不止一种解释，但它所在的土地早已为原住民猎人和渔民所熟知。列弗尔河一带的猎物包括海狸、熊、水獭和水貂，人们捕取它们的皮毛。河流也是内陆居民与渥太华河谷其他原住民民族进行交换的通道。

english:
Kiawah was the country of an Indigenous people living near the Ashley River and the harbour that would become Charleston. Rivers, tidal creeks and barrier islands open here onto the Atlantic. In 1670 a Kiawah chief invited English newcomers to settle near his people, and they established Charles Town on the western bank of the Ashley. A decade later the colonial government moved the town across the river to Oyster Point, on the peninsula between the Ashley and Cooper.

Charles Town grew into a major Atlantic port. Merchants traded deerskins from the interior and exported rice and indigo grown on surrounding plantations. The colony's prosperity rested heavily on the labour of enslaved Africans and their descendants; ships brought increasing numbers of captive people directly from West and Central Africa. The port's wealth and its trade were inseparable from that forced labour.

During the American Revolution, defenders repelled a British attack on the harbour in 1776. The British returned in 1780, surrounded the city and compelled General Benjamin Lincoln to surrender its garrison after a siege. His surrender on 12 May included thousands of Continental soldiers and militia, a severe blow to the American cause in the South. British forces occupied Charleston until 1782, and the town adopted the shorter name Charleston in 1783. In 1786 the state assembly voted to move South Carolina's capital inland to Columbia, reflecting the growing influence of the backcountry.

The later city of Charleston lies here.
simp_chinese:
基亚瓦是居住在阿什利河与后来查尔斯顿港附近的原住民的土地。河流、潮汐溪流与障壁岛在此通向大西洋。1670年，一位基亚瓦首领邀请英国新来者在其族人附近定居，殖民者于是于阿什利河西岸建立查尔斯镇。十年后，殖民政府将城镇迁至河对岸的牡蛎角，即阿什利河与库珀河之间的半岛。

查尔斯镇逐渐成为大西洋重要港口。商人交易内陆运来的鹿皮，并出口周围种植园生产的稻米和靛蓝。殖民地的富裕在很大程度上依靠被奴役的非洲人及其后代的劳动；越来越多被掳者由船只直接从西非和中非运抵港口。港口的财富与贸易，同这种强制劳动密不可分。

美国独立战争期间，守军于1776年击退了英军对港口的进攻。1780年英军再度返回，包围城镇，围城后迫使本杰明·林肯将军率守军投降。5月12日投降的包括数千名大陆军士兵和民兵，这对南方的美国独立事业是一次沉重打击。英军占领查尔斯顿直到1782年，城镇则于1783年采用较短的名称 Charleston。1786年，州议会决定将南卡罗来纳首府迁往内陆的哥伦比亚，反映了腹地日益增长的影响力。

后来的查尔斯顿即位于此地。

english:
Kibanga belongs to the eastern Congo interior, where forest, rivers and upland paths connect communities across a varied landscape. Cultivated clearings and woodland resources supported local livelihoods, while paths linked settlements with their neighbours.

Across the wider Great Lakes and forest region, communities maintained connections through kinship and exchange. Local authorities and larger kingdoms represented different forms of political organization. Trade passed through networks of African intermediaries, linking people and goods across the region long before the expansion of nineteenth-century commerce.
simp_chinese:
基班加属于刚果东部内陆，森林、河流和高地小径连接着不同社群。耕作清地和林地资源支持地方生计，道路则使聚落与邻人保持往来。

在更广阔的大湖和森林地区，社群通过亲属与交换保持联系，地方首领和较大的王国体现出不同的政治组织。十九世纪商业扩张之前，非洲中间人的贸易网络已将地区内的人群与货物联系起来。

english:
Kibango, also written Kibangu, became one of the royal centres that emerged during Kongo's civil wars after the battle of Mbwila in 1665. Pedro IV based his claim to kingship here while rival dynasties competed over the divided kingdom. In 1698 a Capuchin observer saw him accompanied at a ceremony by knights wearing white tunics marked with the cross of the Order of Christ.

The prophet Dona Beatriz Kimpa Vita was born near Kibangu around 1684. Her later Antonian movement demanded the restoration of the abandoned capital, São Salvador. That religious campaign challenged rulers and missionaries alike. Pedro eventually left his mountain base and defeated the forces occupying São Salvador on 15 February 1709. Kibangu's history thus belonged directly to the struggle over where royal authority should reside and how a fractured Christian kingdom could be reunited.
simp_chinese:
基班戈又写作基班古，是1665年姆布维拉战役之后刚果内战中兴起的王室中心之一。佩德罗四世在此建立王位诉求，其他王族则争夺分裂的王国。1698年，一名嘉布遣会观察者看到，身穿白袍、饰有基督骑士团十字标记的骑士陪同他参加仪式。

女先知多娜·贝阿特丽斯·金帕·维塔约于1684年出生在基班古附近。她后来领导的安东尼派运动，要求恢复已被弃置的都城圣萨尔瓦多，既挑战统治者，也挑战传教士。佩德罗最终离开山地据点，于1709年2月15日击败占据圣萨尔瓦多的力量。基班古因此直接处在王权应驻何地、一个分裂的基督教王国应如何重新统一的斗争之中。

english: Kibau lies near Luena and Camanongue in the eastern Angolan highlands. The nearby country is covered by miombo woodland, with Brachystegia and Julbernardia trees interspersed with open grassland. Eastwards the Luena River flows towards the upper Zambezi, one of several rivers draining the plateau.
simp_chinese: 基巴乌靠近卢埃纳和卡马农盖，位于安哥拉东部高地。附近地区生长着米翁博林地，短荚树与朱伯豆树之间夹杂着开阔草地。东面的卢埃纳河流向赞比西河上游，是排泄高原水流的河流之一。

english: Kibengo is one of western Uganda's great earthwork settlements, with extensive ditches surrounding an inhabited area. Pottery and animal remains speak of life within the enclosure from the late thirteenth to the mid-seventeenth century. The ditches were probably dug in the fifteenth or sixteenth century, in an undertaking that required substantial labour. Among Kibengo's remains are pottery decorated with roulette patterns and many fish bones. Like Bigo and Munsa, it belonged to a landscape of substantial local centres enclosed by earthworks, though the lives and resources of their inhabitants differed. Its broad ditches remain a striking trace of the people who shaped this country before the rise of later kingdoms.
simp_chinese: 基本戈是乌干达西部规模较大的土筑围壕聚落之一，广阔居住区被壕沟环绕。陶器和动物遗存记录了围壕内从十三世纪后期至十七世纪中叶的生活。壕沟可能筑于十五或十六世纪，如此规模的工程需要投入可观劳力。基本戈的遗存包括滚印纹陶器和大量鱼骨。与比戈、蒙萨一样，它是这一带筑有围壕的重要地方中心，居民的生活和资源却各有不同。宽阔壕沟至今仍是后来诸王国兴起以前，人们塑造这片土地的醒目痕迹。

english:
Kibi, also called Kyebi, is the traditional capital of Akyem Abuakwa, an Akan state in the forest country of the Birim basin. Here stands the Ofori Panin stool, the seat of the Okyenhene, ruler of the state. The nearby Atewa hills and the river valley formed part of a country known for gold and the routes that carried it through the forests.

The origins of Akyem Abuakwa are traced to Adanse in the seventeenth century. Under Ofori Panin, its people established themselves at Banso beyond the Atewa hills; after 1727 the capital was moved to Kyebi in the Birim valley. Control of gold-producing districts and trade routes helped the kingdom grow wealthy and powerful, while its position brought it into the changing politics of the neighboring Akan states.
simp_chinese:
基比又称基耶比，是阿肯邦国阿基姆阿布阿夸的传统都城，坐落在比里姆河流域的森林地带。象征统治者奥基恩亨权位的奥福里·帕宁凳设于此处。附近的阿特瓦丘陵与河谷盛产黄金，穿行森林的道路将黄金运往各地。

阿基姆阿布阿夸的起源可追溯到十七世纪的阿丹西。在奥福里·帕宁统治下，其民众在阿特瓦丘陵另一侧的班索立足；1727年之后，都城迁至比里姆河谷的基耶比。对产金地区和贸易道路的控制使王国日益富强，其位置也使它卷入邻近阿肯邦国不断变化的政治局势。

english:
Between Lake Albert and the steep wall of the western rift, Kibiro is known for salt drawn from the earth. Women spread dry soil over saline ground, collect it after it has absorbed salt, and wash it to produce brine. Boiling the brine leaves crystals, while the earth can be spread again. The narrow lakeshore offers little farmland, so salt and fish have been exchanged for food grown on the plateau above.

Archaeological remains suggest that salt-making here goes back many centuries. Deep deposits of broken pottery preserve traces of vessels used in the work, alongside ornaments and burials. These include iron bracelets and beads made from freshwater shell. Kibiro's salt formed part of the wealth of Bunyoro-Kitara, connecting the lakeshore to communities and rulers inland.
simp_chinese:
