simp_chinese: 科伊留存的教堂为十八世纪至十九世纪初的地方营建提供了具体记录。村中心的大型圣三一教堂建于1717至1731年，主要工程集中在1724至1731年，成为聚落最醒目的建筑。另一座奉献给神学家圣约翰的教堂建于1833年，位于远离中心的村庄墓地；从松科沃方向进入时，它构成入口附近独立的地标。两座建筑分别对应中心教区空间与外围安葬之地，显示在十九世纪中叶之前，村落宗教生活的不同场所已各自形成具有规模的教堂建筑。

english:
Koiali country lies in the forested mountains behind the southern coast of New Guinea, along the Owen Stanley Range. Mountain Koiali is a Papuan language of this rugged interior, where steep ridges and rivers separate valleys from the coastal plain. The mountain communities were neighbours of peoples living nearer the coast around the Gulf of Papua.

The later city of Port Moresby lies nearby.
simp_chinese:
科亚利地区位于新几内亚南岸后方的森林山地，属于欧文斯坦利山脉。山地科亚利语是崎岖内陆的一种巴布亚语言，陡峭山脊和河流将河谷与沿海平原分隔。山地社群与巴布亚湾附近沿岸居民毗邻而居。

后来的莫尔斯比港位于此地附近。

english:
Koidanova stands in the hilly country south-west of Minsk. The name is recorded in the fifteenth century, when Grand Duke Casimir granted the settlement to his brother Michael. Through inheritance and marriage it passed to the Gasztołd family, and its history was later closely connected with the Radziwiłł magnates. Its churches included a Calvinist temple and a Uniate church.

Crimean Tatars burned Koidanova in 1502 and again in 1503. During the Russo-Polish War, Cossack troops plundered and burned the town in 1655. After the Commonwealth's second partition it came under Russian rule in 1793; in 1800 it remained an estate of Dominik Radziwiłł. French troops occupied it in 1812 and used it for food stores, before fighting in November opened the way to Minsk for Russian forces.
simp_chinese:
科伊达诺沃位于明斯克西南的丘陵地带。这个名称见于15世纪的记载，当时大公卡齐米日将聚落赐给了兄弟米哈伊尔。此地通过继承和婚姻转入加什托尔德家族，后来又与拉齐维乌大贵族家族紧密相连。镇上的教堂包括一座加尔文宗教堂和一座联合教会教堂。

克里米亚鞑靼人于1502和1503年两度焚毁科伊达诺沃。俄波战争期间，哥萨克军队于1655年劫掠并焚烧城镇。联邦第二次被瓜分后，此地于1793年归入俄罗斯；1800年它仍是多米尼克·拉齐维乌的庄园。1812年法军占领此地并设立粮食仓库，11月的战斗随后为俄军打开了通往明斯克的道路。

english: Koilkonda is a hill fort in the Telangana country southwest of Golconda. Its stone walls and gateways occupy a rugged height overlooking the surrounding plateau. A Telugu inscription at the fort records an important episode in the succession of the Qutb Shahi rulers. In 1550, commanders gathered at Koilkonda and invited Prince Ibrahim, then at Vijayanagara, to return and claim the throne. He came to the fort before travelling on to Golconda as its new ruler.
simp_chinese: 科伊尔孔达是戈尔孔达西南特伦甘纳地区的一座山堡。石墙和门楼占据崎岖高地，俯瞰周围高原。堡内一方泰卢固语铭文记载了库特布沙阿王位继承中的重要事件。1550年，将领在科伊尔孔达聚集，邀请当时身在毗奢耶那伽罗的易卜拉欣王子返回继位。他先来到堡垒，随后前往戈尔孔达成为新统治者。

english: Koitere is a lake in the forest country of eastern Karelia, with hundreds of islands scattered across its waters. Sandy beaches edge parts of its long shores. The Koitajoki flows out of the lake and joins the Pielisjoki, carrying water onward through the lake and river country of North Karelia.
simp_chinese: 科伊泰雷湖位于卡累利阿东部的森林地带，湖中散布着数百座岛屿，漫长湖岸的部分地段有沙滩。科伊塔约基河从湖中流出，汇入皮耶利斯约基河，将湖水继续送往北卡累利阿的河湖水系。

english: Kojur occupied the Alborz uplands between the Caspian coastal plain and the mountain interior of Rostamdar. Between 1340 and 1346, the Baduspanid ruler Jalal al-Dawla Eskandar rebuilt the town and its fort and made it his capital. This gave Kojur a specific political importance during the fragmentation of Ilkhanid power. In the mid-fifteenth century, the Baduspanid domain divided between rival family branches. Kojur, together with Larijan, first belonged to the branch of Eskandar, but in 1504 it was captured by the branch of Kavus ruling from Nur. The paired names Nur and Kojur thereafter became familiar in administrative accounts. Shah Abbas I ended Baduspanid rule near the close of the sixteenth century, and Safavid sources often treated Nur and Kojur as one unit. The district’s history therefore concerns both a fortified dynastic capital and changing control over an enclosed mountain region.
simp_chinese: 科朱尔位于厄尔布尔士山地，在里海沿岸平原与鲁斯塔姆达尔山区之间。1340至1346年，巴杜斯潘王朝统治者贾拉勒·道莱·伊斯坎达尔重建城镇及堡垒，并将这里作为首府。伊儿汗国权力瓦解之际，科朱尔因此获得了具体的政治地位。十五世纪中叶，巴杜斯潘领地分裂为相互竞争的家族支系。科朱尔与拉里詹起初属于伊斯坎达尔支系，1504年则被以努尔为中心的卡乌斯支系夺取。此后，努尔与科朱尔经常在行政记述中并称。十六世纪末，阿拔斯一世结束巴杜斯潘统治，萨法维文献又常将努尔和科朱尔作为一个行政单位。当地历史因而同时涉及设防的王朝首府，以及封闭山地地域控制权的变化。

english: Köke Usn, “blue water” in Kalmyk, is a shallow lake in the dry lowlands west of the Caspian. It belongs to the Sostinsk lakes, a chain of basins amid the steppe and sandy ground. The lake has no natural outlet and can dry out; salt gathers as its waters recede. Tamarisk grows on sandy ridges around it, breaking the open horizon of a landscape where water levels change greatly with the seasons.
simp_chinese: 科克乌斯恩在卡尔梅克语中意为“蓝水”，是里海以西干燥低地中的浅湖。它属于索斯廷湖群，这些洼地散布于草原和沙地之间。湖泊没有天然出水口，可能干涸；湖水退去时盐分聚集。周围沙脊上生长着柽柳，为开阔的地平线增添了色彩，这片地貌中的水位随季节大幅变化。

english:
Kokand lies in the western Fergana Valley, where roads from the Syr Darya approach the fertile oases enclosed by mountains. Its markets and workshops served the towns and farming lands of the valley, while routes led west toward Khujand and north across the mountains. Though the neighbourhood had older settlements, Kokand's rise to political prominence came with the emergence of a new Uzbek dynasty in the eighteenth century.

In 1709 Shahrukh Biy, a chief of the Ming tribe, established a fortress near Kokand and laid the foundations of a principality in Fergana. His successors extended their authority over the valley, and the town grew into the capital of a khanate with its own court and religious institutions. In the early nineteenth century its rulers pushed north and west; Tashkent fell to Kokand in 1809–10. Markets linked the new state with merchants from the steppe, China and other parts of Central Asia.

Umar Khan, who ruled from about 1810 to 1822, patronised literature as well as building. He was himself a poet, and his court became associated with writers including his wife Nodira. The congregational mosque and madrasas expressed the city's growing importance as a religious and cultural centre. Under his son Muhammad Ali, known as Madali Khan, the khanate reached across a wide area beyond its Fergana heartland.
simp_chinese:
浩罕位于费尔干纳谷地西部，从锡尔河来的道路在此通向群山环抱的肥沃绿洲。市场和作坊服务于谷地的城镇与农田，道路则向西通往苦盏，向北翻越山脉。虽然周边早有聚落，浩罕的政治兴起却与十八世纪一个新的乌兹别克王朝有关。

1709年，明部首领沙赫鲁赫比在浩罕附近建立堡垒，为费尔干纳的一个地方政权奠基。继承者扩大对谷地的统治，城镇发展为拥有宫廷和宗教机构的汗国首府。十九世纪初，其统治者向北和向西扩张，塔什干于1809—1810年落入浩罕之手。市场将新政权与草原、中国及中亚其他地区的商人联系起来。

约1810至1822年统治的乌马尔汗既资助建筑，也扶持文学。他本人是诗人，宫廷还汇聚了包括妻子纳迪拉在内的作家。聚礼清真寺和经学院显示城市作为宗教文化中心的日益重要。他的儿子穆罕默德·阿里汗，又称马达里汗，统治下的汗国延伸至费尔干纳腹地之外的广大地区。

english: Kóke metcheskó lähä, the High-Beaked Moccasin band, was one of the Lipan Apache groups of southern Texas. Lipan bands consisted of local communities whose leaders directed movements and maintained relations with their neighbours. Their country stretched across rivers, grasslands and the margins of the mountains, where hunting and gathering supported families travelling through a wide territory. The Green Mountain band later became part of the High-Beaked Moccasin group.
simp_chinese: 科克梅切斯科拉哈，即“高喙软皮鞋”支群，是得克萨斯南部利潘阿帕奇人的一支。利潘各支由地方社区组成，领袖指导迁移并维持与邻族的关系。其地域横跨河流、草原和山地边缘，狩猎与采集供养着在广阔土地上旅行的家庭。绿山支群后来加入了高喙软皮鞋支群。

english:
Koki, in the Ndiambour country of Senegal, became known for a daara founded by the Muslim scholar Matar Ndoumbé Diop. The school taught Islamic law and Arabic learning and came to be remembered as the University of Koki. Its reputation made the settlement a centre of religious authority within the wider political world of Cayor.

In the early nineteenth century, Ndiaga Isseu Diop revived his grandfather's school and held the title Serigne Koki. His influence rested on both religious standing and ties to ruling families: he received political responsibilities from the damel of Cayor and formed several marriage alliances. Relations with the ruler nevertheless broke down. In 1827 he rebelled, was defeated by the damel's forces, and withdrew toward Waalo. Between 1827 and 1829 he gathered supporters there. Koki's history consequently joins the transmission of scholarship to struggles over authority among the Wolof kingdoms.

The later city of Louga lies nearby.
simp_chinese:
科基位于塞内加尔的恩迪昂布尔地区，以穆斯林学者马塔尔·恩杜姆贝·迪奥普创办的经学院闻名。学校教授伊斯兰法与阿拉伯学问，后世称之为“科基大学”。凭借教学声望，这个聚落成为卡约尔政治世界中的宗教权威中心。

十九世纪初，恩迪亚加·伊瑟·迪奥普重振祖父的学校，继承“塞里涅·科基”称号。他的影响既来自宗教地位，也来自统治家族的联系：卡约尔的达梅尔授予他政治职务，他又缔结多重婚姻联盟。不过，双方关系最终破裂。1827年，他起兵反叛，被达梅尔军队击败，退向瓦洛边境；此后至1829年间又在那里招集支持者。科基的历史因此同时涉及学问传承，以及沃洛夫诸王国之间与内部的权力争夺。

后来的卢加位于此地附近。

english: Waw Giwulk, known in English as Baboquivari Peak, rises above the desert of the Tohono O’odham homeland. Its distinctive narrow summit is a sacred place and a centre of O’odham cosmology. In traditional accounts it is the home of I’itoi, Elder Brother, a creator figure associated with the making of the world and its people. The mountain stands as a landmark visible across the surrounding valleys.
simp_chinese: 瓦夫吉乌尔克，即巴博基瓦里峰，耸立在托霍诺奥德汉人故土的沙漠之上。形状独特的狭窄山峰是圣地，也是奥德汉宇宙观的中心。按照传统叙述，这里是“长兄”伊伊托伊的居所；他是一位与世界和人类创造相关的神灵。山峰也是周围谷地远远可见的地标。

english: Koknar is the name of an Aboriginal language of Cape York Peninsula in northern Queensland. Its country lies in the broader Gulf of Carpentaria region, where the western peninsula's rivers run towards the sea. Wet-season floods and dry-season waterholes mark a landscape long occupied by Aboriginal communities.
simp_chinese: 科克纳是昆士兰北部约克角半岛的一种原住民语言名称。其土地位于更广阔的卡奔塔利亚湾地区，半岛西部河流在这里流向大海。雨季洪水和旱季水潭构成这一景观的特色；原住民社群长期在此生活。

english:
Koknese stands where the Pērse meets the Daugava, on a site once occupied by the Latgalian and Selonian settlement of Kukenois. A stone castle replaced its wooden stronghold in the early thirteenth century, and the bishops of Riga later made it a residence. The town, called Kokenhusen in German, received privileges in 1277 and prospered as a Hanseatic trading centre on the river.

The castle was disputed for generations between the archbishops and the Tiesenhausen family, until Archbishop John V restored it to the church in 1397. War returned to the Daugava in the sixteenth and seventeenth centuries. In 1601 Polish cavalry defeated a larger Swedish force near Koknese, but Sweden later acquired and refortified the town. Russian forces took it in 1656 and built vessels here for the siege of Riga. During the Great Northern War Saxon troops captured the castle, then destroyed it in 1701 as they retreated before the Swedes.
simp_chinese:
科克内塞位于佩尔塞河与道加瓦河交汇处，原先是拉特加尔人和塞洛尼亚人的库肯诺伊斯聚落。十三世纪初，石造城堡取代木寨，里加主教后来将其作为驻地。城镇的德语名为科肯胡森，1277年获得特权，作为河上的汉萨贸易中心逐渐繁荣。

数代人之间，总主教与蒂森豪森家族反复争夺城堡，直到1397年约翰五世总主教将其归还教会。十六至十七世纪，战火再次来到道加瓦河。1601年，波兰骑兵在科克内塞附近击败人数更多的瑞典军队，但瑞典后来取得城镇并重新加固。1656年俄军占领此地，为围攻里加在此建造船只。大北方战争期间，萨克森军队攻占城堡，又于1701年在瑞典军前撤退时将其毁坏。

english: Koko lies in the Kebbi country near Gwandu, a centre that emerged during the wars of Usman dan Fodio. After taking Birnin Kebbi in 1805, his followers moved to Gwandu, where they faced a coalition of neighbouring forces. Abdullahi dan Fodio, Usman's brother and a scholar in his own right, later made Gwandu the seat of his authority over the western territories of the Sokoto state. The struggles around Gwandu changed the balance of power in the old kingdom of Kebbi.
simp_chinese: 科科位于凯比地区，靠近关都。关都是在奥斯曼·丹·福迪奥发动的战争中兴起的中心。1805年，他的追随者攻下比尔宁凯比后迁至关都，在那里迎战邻近势力的联军。奥斯曼的兄弟阿卜杜拉希·丹·福迪奥也是一位学者，后来以关都为治所，统辖索科托政权的西部领地。关都周围的战事改变了古老凯比王国的权力格局。

english: Koko Bera, also recorded as Kokobera, is associated with Aboriginal people of western Cape York Peninsula. Their country lies in the Gulf of Carpentaria drainage, among rivers, open woodland and seasonally flooded plains. The wet and dry seasons bring marked changes to the waters and vegetation of this part of northern Queensland.
simp_chinese: 科科贝拉亦记作科科贝拉，与约克角半岛西部的原住民有关。其土地位于卡奔塔利亚湾流域，河流、开阔林地与季节性淹没的平原交错。昆士兰北部这一地区的水域和植被随干湿季发生显著变化。

english: South of New Caledonia's Grande Terre lies the Isle of Pines, known to its inhabitants as Kunie. James Cook saw the island in 1774 and named it for the tall native araucaria trees. In June 1792 the ships of d'Entrecasteaux's expedition came into sight of the island; Espérance nearly ran aground on its reefs as the expedition charted the southern coast.
simp_chinese: 新喀里多尼亚大地岛以南是松树岛，岛民称其为库涅。詹姆斯·库克于1774年望见此岛，以岛上高大的南洋杉为其命名。1792年6月，当特尔卡斯托的探险船队看见该岛；探险队测绘南岸时，“希望”号险些在岛旁礁石上搁浅。

english: Kokokachi lies along the upper Saint-Maurice, within the forest homeland of the Atikamekw. The name, also written Coucoucache, comes from a word for the owl. One account links it to a hill whose shape recalled the bird; another tells of a battle in which the victors imitated its call. A lake on the river bore the same name, and by 1823 the Hudson's Bay Company maintained a trading post on its shore.
simp_chinese: 科科卡奇位于圣莫里斯河上游的阿蒂卡梅克人森林家园。这个名称也写作库库卡什，源自“猫头鹰”一词。一种说法将名字与一座形似猫头鹰的小山联系起来；另一种说法则讲述一场战斗，胜者曾模仿猫头鹰的叫声。河上一座湖泊也使用这个名字，到1823年，哈得孙湾公司已在湖岸设有贸易站。

english: Kokomini is the name of an Aboriginal people and language of Cape York Peninsula. Their country lies between the Mitchell and Palmer rivers in northern Queensland, west of the peninsula's eastern coast. The rivers and surrounding country belong to a network of neighbouring Aboriginal homelands with distinct languages.
simp_chinese: 科科米尼是约克角半岛原住民人群和语言的名称。其土地位于昆士兰北部米切尔河与帕尔默河之间，处在半岛东海岸以西。河流及周围地区属于相邻原住民家园的网络，各地有各自的语言。

english: Kokorou lies in the Liptako country west of the Niger, near a complex of seasonal ponds known as Kokorou and Namga. These waters gather runoff during the rains and provide habitat for fish and waterbirds in the dry Sahel. Farmers cultivate surrounding land, while herders bring animals to the water and pasture. The ponds stand out among the open plains, their extent changing with the seasons and the amount of rain that reaches the basin.
simp_chinese: 科科鲁位于尼日尔河以西的利普塔科地区，靠近科科鲁与南加两处季节性水塘组成的湿地。雨季汇集的水为干燥萨赫勒中的鱼类与水鸟提供栖息地。农民耕种周边土地，牧民带牲畜前来饮水和吃草。水塘在开阔平原中十分醒目，其范围随季节和流域降雨量变化。

english: The Kokosing, a name translated from Lenape as “river of little owls,” flows through the wooded country of central Ohio. Rising in the hills to the west, it turns east and joins the Mohican to form the Walhonding River. Their waters continue through the Muskingum to the Ohio and Mississippi. The Kokosing was also known as Owl Creek and the Vernon River.
simp_chinese: 科科辛河流过俄亥俄中部的林地，名称从莱纳佩语译来，大致意为“小猫头鹰之河”。它发源于西方丘陵，转向东流，与莫希干河汇合形成沃洪丁河，水流再经马斯金格姆河和俄亥俄河进入密西西比河。科科辛河也曾被称为猫头鹰溪和弗农河。

english: Kokowarra country lies in eastern Cape York Peninsula, among the Kennedy, Normanby and Hann rivers. Kokowarra is an Aboriginal language and people of this river country, near the coast of northern Queensland. The waterways and plains change with the seasonal rains that feed the rivers flowing north towards Princess Charlotte Bay.
simp_chinese: 科科瓦拉人的土地位于约克角半岛东部的肯尼迪河、诺曼比河和汉河之间。科科瓦拉是昆士兰北部近海河流地区的原住民语言和人群名称。季节性降雨使水道与平原变化，也为向北流往夏洛特公主湾的河流补水。

english: Kokpekty lies in eastern Kazakhstan between the steppe and the mountain country of the Altai and Tarbagatai. Its position brought it into the contested frontier between Russian and Qing interests. Sources differ on the early settlement date, but Russian troops were recorded building at Kokpekty in 1830, and a Cossack post was established there by 1836.
simp_chinese: 科克佩克特位于哈萨克斯坦东部，处在草原与阿尔泰、塔尔巴哈台山地之间。这一位置使它处于俄国和清朝势力竞争的边疆。关于早期聚落日期资料不一，但记录显示俄军于1830年在科克佩克特建造房屋，到1836年已建立哥萨克据点。

english: Kokrajhar lies north of the Brahmaputra in the eastern Duars, the low country at the foot of the Bhutan hills. The region stretches between the Sankosh and Manas rivers, where streams descend from the mountains onto the floodplain. From the early seventeenth century the Bhutanese kingdom exercised authority over parts of these passes and plains. The Duars linked the hill country with the markets and settlements of the Brahmaputra valley.
simp_chinese: 科克拉贾尔位于布拉姆普特拉河以北的东杜阿尔，是不丹山地脚下的低地。地区位于桑科什河与马纳斯河之间，溪流从山中流向泛滥平原。十七世纪初起，不丹王国对部分山口和低地施加统治。杜阿尔将山地与布拉姆普特拉河谷的市场及聚落连接起来。

english: Koksala is a river of the northern Balkhash country and a tributary of the Bakanas. It runs through the open upland steppe, where watercourses flow unevenly across a dry basin. The Bakanas drains towards the Ayaguz but reaches it only in unusually wet years. Beyond these river valleys lies Lake Balkhash, the great inland lake at the southern edge of the steppe.
simp_chinese: 阔克萨拉河位于巴尔喀什湖以北，是巴卡纳斯河的支流。它流经开阔的高地草原，干燥盆地中的水道流量并不稳定。巴卡纳斯河朝阿亚古兹河方向流去，但只有特别湿润的年份才能与之汇合。河谷之外便是巴尔喀什湖，这座巨大的内陆湖位于草原南缘。

english: Koksar lies high in Lahaul on the right bank of the Chandra River, below the route over Rohtang Pass. The pass separates the Chandra valley from Kullu to the south, and snow can close it for much of the year. Above the village, barren cliffs and mountain slopes descend toward the river. Farther downstream the Chandra joins the Bhaga at Tandi, forming the river known as the Chenab.
simp_chinese: 科克萨尔位于拉豪尔高地的旃陀罗河右岸，罗唐山口道路从上方经过。山口将旃陀罗河谷与南方的库卢分隔开来，积雪使其一年中许多时间难以通行。村庄上方，荒凉峭壁和山坡一直降至河边。旃陀罗河在下游坦迪与巴加河汇合，形成杰纳布河。

english:
Kotelnich stands on the Vyatka, where a later tradition placed the Mari town of Koksharov before the arrival of Novgorodian settlers. Archaeological evidence instead identifies an early Russian settlement nearby, and in the fourteenth century the town was moved downriver and fortified. It first appears in a Russian chronicle in 1459, when a Muscovite army took it; another campaign in 1489 brought the Vyatka towns under Moscow.

The Alexeyevskaya fair, established in 1647, became important to trade between regions. Stone churches followed, beginning with the Trinity Cathedral in 1705. A fire destroyed the town and its churches in 1686, and further fires struck in later years. In 1780 Kotelnich became an uyezd town, and its coat of arms displayed a gold cauldron on green ground. A regular town plan was adopted in 1784.
simp_chinese:
科捷利尼奇位于维亚特卡河畔。后来的传说认为，诺夫哥罗德移民到来之前，这里曾有马里人的科克沙罗夫城；考古证据则在附近发现了早期俄罗斯聚落。十四世纪，城镇迁至下游并修筑防御工事。1459年，俄罗斯编年史首次在莫斯科军队攻取此城的记载中提到它；1489年的另一次远征使维亚特卡诸城归于莫斯科。

1647年设立的阿列克谢耶夫斯卡亚集市成为跨地区贸易的重要场所。此后城中修建石教堂，首座为1705年动工的三一主教堂。1686年大火摧毁城镇及其教堂，后来又多次发生火灾。1780年，科捷利尼奇成为县城，城徽在绿色底面上绘有金色锅炉；1784年，城镇采用了规则规划。

english:
Kokshetau lies among the hills and lakes of northern Kazakhstan, on the southern shore of Lake Kopa. The wooded hills rise above the surrounding steppe, giving the region its name, often rendered as “blue mountain.” The town grew from a Russian administrative post established farther south, near the foot of Mount Kokshe.

In 1824 a district administration was opened near Lake Ulken Shabakty at the camp of Khan Wali. Local people opposed its chosen location, and in 1827 the administration moved to the southern shore of Lake Kopa, beneath Bukpa Hill. A defensive picket was established there, and a new settlement grew around the district office. The move placed the Russian post within a landscape long inhabited and used by Kazakh communities.
simp_chinese:
科克舍套位于哈萨克北部的丘陵和湖泊之间，坐落在科帕湖南岸。林木覆盖的山丘高出周围草原，这片地区的名称常译作“蓝色的山”。城镇源自一处俄国行政据点，该据点最初设在更南方的科克舍山脚下。

1824年，区行政机关在乌尔肯沙巴克特湖附近、瓦利汗的营地开设。当地居民反对选定的位置，1827年行政机关迁到布克帕山下的科帕湖南岸。那里建立了防御哨所，新聚落在区署周围发展起来。俄国据点因此进入了哈萨克社群长期居住和利用的地域。

english: Koktal lies in the upper Ili country west of Zharkent, between the river and the mountains of Zhetysu. Remains of a medieval settlement near the village recall the chain of towns that stood along the routes through the Ili valley. Merchants and travellers passed this way between the foothill settlements and Almaliq to the east, while the river and its tributaries watered the surrounding plain.
simp_chinese: 科克塔尔位于扎尔肯特以西的伊犁河上游地区，坐落在河流与七河群山之间。村庄附近的中世纪聚落遗址，使人想起伊犁河谷沿线曾经存在的一系列城镇。商人和旅人经过这里，往来于山麓聚落与东面的阿力麻里；伊犁河及其支流则滋养周围平原。

english:
Koktuma is associated with the lake and steppe country around Alakol. Southeast of the lake, the passage known as the Dzungarian Gate connects the Alakol basin with the country around Ebinur, providing a route through the mountains between Zhetysu and Dzungaria.

In the eighteenth century, the wider region was affected by conflict among Kazakh groups, the Dzungar state and the Qing. The destruction of the Dzungar state in the 1750s changed the balance of power, and Qing and Kazakh leaders entered into new diplomatic relations. Pastoral movement and access to grazing remained important across these frontier lands.
simp_chinese:
科克图马与阿拉湖周围的湖泊和草原地带相联系。湖的东南方向有一处后来称为准噶尔门的通道，穿越山地，将阿拉湖盆地与艾比湖一带连接起来，也沟通七河与准噶尔地区。

18世纪，更广阔的地区受到哈萨克各群体、准噶尔国家与清朝之间冲突的影响。1750年代准噶尔国家覆亡后，区域力量格局改变，清朝与哈萨克首领展开新的外交往来。牧群迁移与草场利用仍是这些边地的重要生活方式。

english:
Kol, later known as Aligarh, was a fortified town in the Doab between the Ganges and the Yamuna. Its name appears in written sources from the twelfth century, when the surrounding country was held by Dor Rajputs. Qutb al-Din Aibak captured the region in 1194, and the chronicler Hasan Nizami counted Kol among the notable fortresses of Hindustan.

Under the Delhi Sultanate, Kol became an important economic centre, known among other things for distilled wine. The future sultan Balban erected a minaret there in the thirteenth century. Its fort was substantially rebuilt in the sixteenth century, and the town acquired several new names before becoming known as Aligarh in the eighteenth. During the Second Anglo-Maratha War, British forces captured the fort in 1803.
simp_chinese:
拘罗后来称为阿利格尔，是恒河与亚穆纳河之间河间地的一座设防城镇。十二世纪的文字记载已提到这个名字，当时周围地区由多尔拉杰普特人控制。1194年，库特布丁·艾伊拜克征服这一地区；编年史家哈桑·尼扎米将拘罗列为印度斯坦著名的堡垒之一。

德里苏丹国时期，拘罗成为重要的经济中心，其出产包括蒸馏酒。十三世纪，后来的苏丹巴尔班曾在此修建宣礼塔。堡垒在十六世纪大规模重建，城镇也几度易名，十八世纪才称为阿利格尔。第二次英马战争期间，英国军队于1803年攻占这座堡垒。

english: The Kó’l kukä, or Prairie Men, were a Lipan Apache band whose range included the upper Colorado and Pecos river country. Spanish sources knew them as Llaneros, or plains people, in the late eighteenth century. They belonged to a wider network of Lipan bands that moved across the southern Plains and Texas hill country. Bison hunting and the use of horses linked their lives to the open grasslands and river valleys of the region.
simp_chinese: 科尔库卡人或称草原人，是利潘阿帕奇人的一个群体，活动范围包括科罗拉多河上游与佩科斯河地区。十八世纪末，西班牙文献称他们为亚内罗斯，即平原人。他们属于更广泛的利潘群体网络，在南部平原与得克萨斯丘陵之间迁徙。野牛狩猎和马匹的使用，使他们的生活与当地开阔草原及河谷密切相连。

english: Kol is a Papuan language of New Britain, spoken in the island’s forested interior. Mountains and river valleys separate communities on the island from its northern and southern shores. Kol is distinct from the Austronesian languages spoken by many coastal neighbors in the Bismarck Archipelago.
simp_chinese: 科尔语是新不列颠岛森林内陆的一种巴布亚语言。山脉和河谷将岛上社群与南北海岸分隔开来。科尔语不同于俾斯麦群岛许多沿海邻居使用的南岛语。

english:
Kola developed where the Kola and Tuloma rivers met the inlet leading to the Barents Sea. Written testimony names the settlement in 1556. In 1583–1584 a fortified stockade transformed it into a northern outpost of the Muscovite state, and by the early seventeenth century it was the administrative centre of Kola district.

Its importance combined defence with overseas commerce. Peter I ordered a stronger wooden fortress built in 1700–1706, reinforcing Russia's position in the far north. Yet the gains on the Baltic confirmed by the Peace of Nystad changed the country's commercial geography, diminishing Kola's role in foreign trade. The town nevertheless remained a regional centre: its river-mouth position and fortifications had gathered military and administrative authority in a place linking the peninsula's interior with the northern seas.
simp_chinese:
科拉在科拉河与图洛马河汇入通往巴伦支海的海湾处发展起来。1556年的文字证词已提及这一聚落。1583至1584年修建的木栅堡垒，使它成为莫斯科国家在北方的据点；到十七世纪初，它已是科拉县的行政中心。

其重要性结合了防御与海外贸易。彼得一世命人在1700至1706年修建更坚固的木制要塞，加强俄罗斯在极北地区的地位。但尼斯塔德和约确认的波罗的海领土收益，改变了国家的商业地理，科拉在对外贸易中的作用随之减弱。城镇仍保持区域中心的职能：河口位置与防御工事将军事、行政权力集中在此，把半岛内陆与北方海域连接起来。

english:
The Kola taiga forms part of the northern forest country between inland lakes and the Arctic coast. Short summers and long winters shaped the produce available to Sami communities and their neighbors. Fishing, hunting, gathering, and reindeer-related livelihoods used different parts of the landscape, while seasonal routes connected camps, waters, and grazing places.

Rivers and frozen surfaces could serve as roads in a region where overland movement was otherwise difficult. During the medieval and early modern centuries, the wider Kola region became connected to tribute and trade networks extending toward Novgorod, Muscovy, and northern Scandinavia. Furs, fish, and other products attracted merchants and officials, while overlapping claims could burden local populations with competing demands.

Orthodox monasteries and Russian coastal settlements added new institutions to an older northern world. Yet successful travel and produce use still depended on local knowledge. The taiga's historical setting therefore combines enduring seasonal lifeways with the gradual extension of state and religious authority, where forest distances and severe weather limited how closely distant centers could govern everyday life.
simp_chinese:
科拉针叶林属于内陆湖泊与北极海岸之间的北方森林地带。短夏长冬决定萨米社群及邻人能够利用的资源。捕鱼、狩猎、采集和与驯鹿有关的生计使用不同景观，季节道路联结营地、水域与牧场。

河流和冻结地面可充当道路，其他陆上移动则较为困难。中世纪至近世，更广阔科拉地区接入通向诺夫哥罗德、莫斯科及斯堪的纳维亚北方的贡赋贸易网络。毛皮、鱼和其他产品吸引商人与官员，交错领土主张也可能使地方人口承受竞争性要求。东正教修道院和俄罗斯沿岸聚落，为更古老北方世界增加新机构。

不过成功旅行和资源利用仍依靠地方知识。针叶林的历史背景因此结合延续的季节生活，以及国家和宗教权威逐步扩展。森林距离与严酷天气限制远方中心对日常生活的紧密管理，地方社群也持续通过知识、合作及移动安排应对外部变化。

english:
Kolar's temples preserve the town's place in the political and religious landscape of southern Karnataka before the great modern mining ventures. Someshwara, dedicated to Shiva, acquired its elaborate form under Vijayanagara patronage in the fourteenth century. Nearby Kolaramma, devoted to the goddess, also received renovations under Vijayanagara rulers in the fifteenth century, building upon an older sacred centre.

At Someshwara, a tall brick-and-stucco gateway led into a complex of carved stone halls and shrines. Granite pillars in the marriage hall and figures of riders on mythical yali creatures displayed the work of sculptors supported by temple patronage. A stepped tank provided another setting for ritual use. Fifteenth-century inscriptions in the sacrificial hall belong to the same long history of maintenance and worship. These buildings gave Kolar an enduring religious centre through changing dynasties, joining older foundations to the architectural ambitions of the Vijayanagara age.
simp_chinese:
在近代大规模采矿事业兴起以前，果拉尔的寺庙已体现这座城镇在卡纳塔克南部政治与宗教环境中的地位。供奉湿婆的索梅什瓦拉寺，在十四世纪毗奢耶那伽罗的资助下形成精美形制。邻近供奉女神的科拉拉马寺，也在十五世纪获该王朝修缮，延续更早的圣地传统。

索梅什瓦拉寺的砖与灰泥高门，引向雕刻石厅和神殿。婚礼厅的花岗岩柱，以及骑乘神兽雅利的人物，展示了寺院资助下雕刻匠人的技艺。阶梯水池为仪式提供另一处空间，祭祀厅内的十五世纪铭文则属于长期维护与礼拜历史。王朝更替之中，这些建筑使果拉尔维持宗教中心地位，将古老基础与毗奢耶那伽罗时代的建筑追求连接起来。

english: Kolasar was a village in the sandy country of northern Rajasthan, on the site later occupied by Ratangarh. Local accounts remember it as a settlement of the Bikaner state before the later town was laid out. Its surroundings form part of the transition between the desert and Shekhawati, where villages, wells and grazing land supported communities living with uncertain rainfall.
simp_chinese: 科拉萨尔曾是拉贾斯坦北部沙地中的村庄，后来拉特讷格尔在其所在地发展起来。地方记载将它视为后来的城镇规划之前比卡内尔邦的一处聚落。周围地区处在沙漠与舍卡瓦蒂之间的过渡地带，村庄、水井和牧场支持着适应不稳定降雨的社群。

english: Kolayat is a place of pilgrimage in the arid country west of Bikaner. Temples, pavilions and bathing steps surround its sacred lake, which is associated with the sage Kapila. Tradition holds that Kapila performed austerities here beneath a peepul tree. Pilgrims gather at the lake for the annual fair on the full moon of Kartik, bathing in its waters as part of the observance. In the desert landscape, the lake and its shrines form a distinctive religious centre.
simp_chinese: 科拉亚特是比卡内尔以西干旱地区的一处朝圣地。神庙、亭阁和沐浴台阶环绕圣湖，湖泊与圣贤迦毗罗相联系。传说迦毗罗曾在此地一棵菩提树下修行。每年迦提月圆日，朝圣者聚集湖畔参加集会，在湖中沐浴。沙漠景观中的湖泊和神庙共同构成独特的宗教中心。

english: The Colchagua valley lies in central Chile, where the Tinguiririca and Cachapoal rivers descend from the Andes towards the coastal range. Before Spanish conquest, Picunche communities inhabited the district, including groups whom the Spaniards called Promaucaes. Each community had its own chief. In the sixteenth century the conquerors granted indigenous people and lands in the valleys to settlers under the encomienda system, beginning a long transformation of the rural landscape.
simp_chinese: 科尔查瓜河谷位于智利中部，廷吉里里卡河和卡查波阿尔河从安第斯山脉向海岸山脉流去。西班牙征服之前，皮昆切社群居住于此，其中一些被西班牙人称为普罗毛考人，各社群有自己的首领。十六世纪，征服者通过监护领地制度，将河谷中的原住民和土地授予殖民者，开始了乡村景观的长期变化。

sources.title: HISTORIA DE ALMAHUE S XVI AL XX VINIFERA 2020.pdf

english: Kolchugino stands on the Inya River in the Kuznetsk basin. It began as a small Russian settlement and was recorded among the villages of the region in the eighteenth century. A count made in 1763 listed 89 inhabitants. The village lay away from the main Tomsk–Kuznetsk road, amid the river valleys and wooded country of southern Siberia.
simp_chinese: 科尔丘吉诺位于库兹涅茨克盆地的因亚河畔，最初是一处小型俄罗斯移民聚落，十八世纪已列入当地村庄名册。1763年的统计记载村中有89名居民。村庄远离托木斯克至库兹涅茨克的主要道路，四周是西伯利亚南部的河谷与林地。

english:
Kolding lies at the head of a fjord in southeastern Jutland. Above the town stands Koldinghus, founded in the thirteenth century as a royal fortress against the dukes of Schleswig. Its position near the frontier made it both a residence for Danish kings and a place of war and negotiation.

Holstein forces and Jutish rebels besieged the castle in 1341 and again in 1368–1369. Later kings enlarged it: Christopher of Bavaria built the northern wing, Christian I the western wing, and Christian III the southern range and courtyard towers. During the Torstenson War Danish and Swedish forces fought at Kolding in January 1644, and a Danish expedition retook the town in May. In December 1658 a Polish and Danish force under Stefan Czarniecki defeated the Swedes nearby.
simp_chinese:
科灵位于日德兰东南部一处峡湾的尽头。城镇上方的科灵胡斯始建于十三世纪，是丹麦王室防御石勒苏益格公爵的堡垒。靠近边界的位置使它既是国王的居所，也是战争与谈判之地。

荷尔斯泰因军队和日德兰叛军于1341年及1368至1369年围攻城堡。后来的国王加以扩建：巴伐利亚的克里斯托弗建造北翼，克里斯蒂安一世建造西翼，克里斯蒂安三世则增建南翼和庭院塔楼。托尔斯滕松战争中，丹麦与瑞典军队于1644年1月在科灵交战，丹麦远征军于5月收复城镇。1658年12月，斯特凡·恰尔涅茨基率波兰和丹麦军队在附近击败瑞典人。

english:
Koleeu recalls the ko'lew, or Kiliwa, of northern Baja California. Their historical country reached from the coast around San Felipe and Ometepec into the San Pedro Mártir mountains and neighbouring valleys. Small family bands followed seasonal rounds of gathering, hunting and fishing, sharing particular territories with other bands of the same clan.

Mission expansion challenged this pattern of life in the late eighteenth century. The Dominicans founded Santa Catalina in 1797, building an adobe chapel and stone irrigation channels, growing wheat and maize and raising livestock. Kiliwa communities east of the mission resisted the pressure to enter mission settlements. Alongside neighbouring Indigenous peoples, they repeatedly opposed missionary control. By the early nineteenth century the country around the sierras remained a contested meeting ground between mobile communities and religious establishments seeking to concentrate people, labour and production.
simp_chinese:
科莱乌这一名称对应下加利福尼亚北部的 ko'lew，即基利瓦人。他们历史上的土地从圣费利佩与奥梅特佩克附近的海岸伸入圣佩德罗马尔蒂尔山地及邻近河谷。小型家庭群体随季节采集、狩猎和捕鱼，并与同一氏族的其他群体共享特定地域。

十八世纪末，传教扩张冲击了这种生活方式。多明我会于1797年建立圣卡塔利纳传教站，修筑土坯礼拜堂与石砌灌溉渠道，种植小麦、玉米并饲养牲畜。传教站以东的基利瓦社群抵抗被集中到传教聚落的压力，与邻近原住民一道，多次反对传教士的控制。到十九世纪初，山地周围仍是双方争夺的接触地带：一边是保持流动生活的社群，另一边则是试图集中人口、劳力与生产的宗教机构。

english: Kolguyev lies in the southeastern Barents Sea, northeast of the Kanin Peninsula. Its low tundra and shores have long been used by Nenets people as a base for fishing and hunting seals and reindeer. In August 1594 the Dutch navigator Willem Barentsz briefly explored the waters around the island during his search for a northern route toward Asia.
simp_chinese: 科尔古耶夫岛位于巴伦支海东南部，在卡宁半岛东北方。涅涅茨人长期以岛上的低平苔原与海岸为基地，捕鱼并猎取海豹和驯鹿。1594年8月，荷兰航海家威廉·巴伦支在寻找通往亚洲的北方航路时，曾短暂探察岛屿周围水域。

english:
Kolhapur lies on the Panchganga River in the southern Deccan, below the Western Ghats. Its temple of Mahalakshmi, known as Ambabai, has drawn pilgrims for centuries, and the town is sometimes called the Kashi of the south. Twenty kilometres to the north-west the fort of Panhala guards a pass through the Ghats that carried the trade route from Bijapur to the coast.

Panhala was held by the Bahmanis and then the Adil Shahis of Bijapur, who added ramparts and gateways in the sixteenth century. In 1659, after the death of Afzal Khan, Shivaji took the fort. Siddi Johar's army besieged it in 1660, and Shivaji escaped by night through the monsoon, while Baji Prabhu Deshpande held the pass of Pavan Khind to the death so that he could reach Vishalgad. After Rajaram died in 1700, his widow Tarabai ruled from Panhala for her young son Shivaji II and led the Maratha fight against the Mughals. Rival claims in the Bhonsle family then split the Maratha crown between Satara and Kolhapur.

The Treaty of Warna of 1731 ended the war between Sambhaji II of Kolhapur and Satara, and in 1782 the line moved its seat from Panhala to Kolhapur. Sambhaji II reigned until 1760, followed by Shivaji III, whose rule lasted until 1812, then Shambhu until 1821 and Shahaji until 1837. The town grew around the palace and the Mahalakshmi temple as a lasting political centre of the southern Deccan.
simp_chinese:
戈尔哈布尔位于南德干的潘奇甘加河畔，西高止山脚下。城中的摩诃拉克什米神庙又称安巴拜，数百年来吸引着朝圣者，这座城也被称为南方的迦尸。西北二十公里处的潘哈拉堡守着穿过高止山的一处山口，比贾布尔通往海岸的商路由此经过。

潘哈拉先后由巴赫曼尼人和比贾布尔的阿迪勒沙希诸王占有，后者在16世纪加筑了城墙和城门。1659年阿夫扎尔汗死后，西瓦吉夺取了这座堡垒。1660年西迪·乔哈尔的军队围攻堡垒，西瓦吉在雨夜突围，而巴吉·普拉布·德什潘德在帕万金德山口战死守住隘道，使他得以抵达维沙尔加德。1700年拉贾拉姆去世后，其遗孀塔拉拜为年幼的儿子西瓦吉二世在潘哈拉执政，领导马拉塔人抗击莫卧儿。随后，邦斯勒家族内部的互相争位把马拉塔王冠分给了萨塔拉与戈尔哈布尔两支。

1731年的《瓦尔纳条约》结束了戈尔哈布尔的桑巴吉二世与萨塔拉之间的战争，1782年这一支把驻地从潘哈拉迁到戈尔哈布尔。桑巴吉二世在位至1760年，之后是在位到1812年的西瓦吉三世，再后是在位至1821年的香布，以及在位至1837年的沙哈吉。城镇围绕王宫和摩诃拉克什米神庙成长，成为南德干长久的政治中心。

english: Koliaganeq belongs to the upper Nushagak River country, the homeland of Yup’ik people known as Iilgayarmiut, the people of the Nushagak. Koliganek, or Qalirneq, means the village farthest upriver. An older village stood near the mouth of the Nuyakuk River, which drains the Tikchik lakes into the Nushagak. Families used places along the river for fishing, hunting, trapping and gathering, moving between settlements and camps. Salmon returning from Bristol Bay were among the resources that sustained this riverine world.
simp_chinese: 科利亚加内克位于努沙加克河上游地区，是尤皮克人伊尔盖亚尔缪特的家园，他们的名称意为努沙加克河的人们。科利加内克的尤皮克语名称卡利尔内克意为最上游的村庄。旧村位于努亚库克河口附近，这条河将蒂克奇克湖群的水注入努沙加克河。家庭在沿河各处捕鱼、狩猎、捕兽和采集，往返聚落与营地之间；从布里斯托尔湾洄游的鲑鱼是维系河流生活的重要资源。

english: Koliskoj lies in the northern forest country near the Tuntsayoki. Rising among forests to the west, the river flows east and receives the Vatsimanyoki before joining the waters of the Tumcha. The Tumcha belongs to the Kovda river system, whose waters make their way across the southern Kola region toward the White Sea.
simp_chinese: 科利斯科伊位于通察约基河附近的北方林地。河流发源于西方森林，向东流去，接纳瓦齐曼约基河后汇入图姆恰河。图姆恰河属于科夫达水系，水流穿过科拉地区南部，最终奔向白海。

english: Kolla country lies among the barren volcanic mountains and high basins of the southern Andes. Salt flats and scattered wetlands punctuate the dry puna, where herders and their animals move between places with water and pasture. Indigenous communities have long crossed the mountain ranges and valleys of this region, sustaining relationships between the high plateau and lands on either side of the Andes.
simp_chinese: 科利亚地区位于南安第斯荒凉的火山群与高原盆地之间。盐沼和零散湿地点缀干燥的普纳，牧民与牲畜往来于有水源和牧草的地方。原住民社群长期穿越这里的山脉与河谷，维系高原与安第斯两侧土地之间的联系。

english:
Kollam, called Quilon by European merchants, is an old port on the southern Malabar coast, between Ashtamudi Lake and the sea. The rulers of Venad drew their strength from its harbour and its trade in pepper and ginger. Muslim merchants and Saint Thomas Christians lived side by side in the town, and Chinese ships called at its roadstead. Ibn Battuta, who visited in 1342, noted the Chinese merchants who traded there.

In 1329 the pope appointed Jordanus Catalani bishop of Quilon, and a Christian community was the object of European attention long before the Portuguese came. The Portuguese opened a trading post in 1502 to buy pepper from a port beyond Calicut's reach, but relations with local Muslim merchants broke down and violence destroyed the post and a church. They then built the fortified position of St Thomas at Tangasseri in 1517. In 1578 the first book printed in an Indian language, the Tamil Thambiran Vanakkam, came off a press at Kollam. In 1661 a Dutch fleet under Rijkloff van Goens took the fort, and the port joined the sphere of the Dutch East India Company.

In the eighteenth century the rising kingdom of Travancore took Kollam, and Marthanda Varma's victory over the Dutch at Colachel in 1741 ended Dutch ambitions on the coast. In 1795 the British took the Dutch holdings, and in 1809 a Travancore force under Velu Thampi Dalawa fought the East India Company's troops at Quilon and lost.
simp_chinese:
奎隆是马拉巴尔海岸南端的古港，被欧洲商人称为奎隆，位于阿什塔穆迪湖与大海之间。韦纳德的统治者靠这里的港口以及胡椒和生姜贸易积蓄力量。穆斯林商人与圣多马基督徒在城中比邻而居，中国船只也停靠在锚地。1342年到访的伊本·白图泰记下了在这里经商的中国商人。

1329年，教宗任命约尔达努斯·卡塔拉尼为奎隆主教，这里的基督徒群体在葡萄牙人到来之前很久就受到欧洲的关注。葡萄牙人1502年设立商站，想从卡利卡特势力够不到的港口买胡椒，但同本地穆斯林商人的关系破裂，暴力毁掉了商站和一座教堂。他们随后在1517年于坦加塞里建起设防的圣多马据点。1578年，第一本以印度语言印刷的书，泰米尔语的《坦比兰·瓦纳卡姆》，在奎隆印行。1661年，里克洛夫·范·霍恩斯率领的荷兰舰队攻占堡垒，港口进入荷兰东印度公司的势力范围。

18世纪，崛起的特拉凡哥尔王国取得奎隆，1741年马坦达·瓦尔马在科拉切尔战胜荷兰人，终结了荷兰在海岸的野心。1795年英国人接管荷兰的据点，1809年，维卢·坦皮·达拉瓦率领的特拉凡哥尔军队在奎隆同东印度公司军队交战并失败。

english: Kolmården is a belt of forest and rugged ground between Södermanland and Östergötland. In medieval accounts it marked a boundary between neighbouring lands, and its woods posed a formidable obstacle to travel by land. Routes nevertheless crossed the forest, linking the districts around Lake Mälaren with those to the south. In the early Middle Ages travellers also relied heavily on the Baltic coast, where sea routes offered an alternative to the difficult passage through the wooded interior.
simp_chinese: 科尔莫登是南曼兰与东约特兰之间的一片森林和崎岖地带。中世纪记述将它视为相邻地区的边界，林地也构成陆路旅行的重大障碍。道路仍穿过森林，将梅拉伦湖周围地区与南方相连。中世纪早期，旅客还大量利用波罗的海沿岸，海路为艰难穿越内陆森林提供了另一选择。

english: Kolno developed from an early stronghold in the lands of the Masovian Piasts. First mentioned in 1222, it received town rights from Duke Janusz of Mazovia in 1425. Trade and crafts expanded in the sixteenth century, when Kolno was a royal town and county seat. Fire destroyed it during the Kościuszko Uprising in 1794. The next year's partition placed the town under Prussian rule; it later belonged to the Duchy of Warsaw and, after 1815, Congress Poland.
simp_chinese: 科尔诺由马佐夫舍皮雅斯特家族领地内的一处早期据点发展而来。它最早见于1222年的记载，1425年获马佐夫舍公爵亚努什授予城市权利。十六世纪，科尔诺作为王室城镇和县治，贸易与手工业不断发展。1794年科希丘什科起义期间，大火摧毁了城镇。次年的瓜分使它归入普鲁士，后来又先后属于华沙公国和1815年建立的波兰会议王国。

english:
Koło stands on the Warta, where Casimir the Great granted it town rights in 1362. The settlement occupied an island between branches of the river near a royal castle; it had gates but no town walls. Its markets and craftsmen made it a regional centre, known for metalwork, textiles and pottery.

In 1410 the nobility of Greater Poland gathered here before the war against the Teutonic Order. For much of the early modern period Koło hosted the region's general assembly, bringing together representatives from several voivodeships. The town was devastated by Lisowski's troops in 1622 and by the Swedes in 1655; its economy recovered only towards the end of the seventeenth century. Prussia annexed Koło in 1793; it later passed to the Duchy of Warsaw and Congress Poland.
simp_chinese:
科沃位于瓦尔塔河畔，卡齐米日大帝于1362年授予它城市权利。城镇建在河道分支之间的岛上，靠近一座王室城堡；它有城门，却没有城墙。市场和工匠使科沃成为地区中心，以金属制品、纺织品和陶器闻名。

1410年，大波兰贵族在对条顿骑士团开战前于此集会。近世的大部分时期，科沃还举办地区总议会，来自多个省的代表在此聚集。1622年利索夫斯基军队和1655年瑞典军先后摧毁城镇，其经济直到十七世纪末才恢复。1793年，普鲁士吞并科沃；城镇后来又归属华沙公国和波兰会议王国。

english:
Kołobrzeg, known in German as Kolberg, lies at the mouth of the Parsęta on the Baltic coast. An early Pomeranian stronghold grew near salt springs, and in 1000 a bishopric was established here under the Polish ruler Bolesław the Brave. The diocese was short-lived, but the town remained an important coastal centre. A new settlement founded farther north received Lübeck law in 1255 and eventually eclipsed the older stronghold.

The bishops of Kamień became rulers of the town and made it their residence in the thirteenth century. Kołobrzeg joined the Hanseatic League in 1361. Its merchants sent salt, beer and other goods to ports including Amsterdam and those of Scotland and Scandinavia. The Reformation changed the government of the bishops' lands, while imperial and Swedish troops occupied the town in succession during the Thirty Years' War. Kołobrzeg later became a Brandenburg-Prussian fortress. In 1807 its defenders held out against a French and Polish siege during the Napoleonic Wars. The old port's history had thus been shaped by salt, Baltic commerce and the rival powers of Pomerania.
simp_chinese:
科沃布热格，德语称科尔贝格，位于波罗的海沿岸帕尔森塔河口。波美拉尼亚人早期的堡垒兴起于盐泉附近；1000年，波兰统治者勇敢者博莱斯瓦夫在此设立主教区。主教区存在时间短暂，但城镇仍是重要的海岸中心。稍北的新聚落于1255年获得吕贝克城市法，后来逐渐取代旧堡垒。

卡缅主教于十三世纪成为城市的统治者，并将此地作为驻地。科沃布热格于1361年加入汉萨同盟，商人将盐、啤酒等货物运往阿姆斯特丹以及苏格兰和斯堪的纳维亚的港口。宗教改革改变了主教领地的统治；三十年战争期间，帝国军和瑞典军先后占领此城。科沃布热格后来成为勃兰登堡—普鲁士的要塞。1807年拿破仑战争期间，守军抵御了法国和波兰军队的围攻。盐业、波罗的海贸易和波美拉尼亚各方势力共同塑造了这座古老港口的历史。

english:
Kologriv’s history involved a move along the Unzha River. Its earlier wooden fortress stood about forty kilometres upstream, on the opposite bank, and dated from the early sixteenth century. In 1727 the voivode Ivan Rogozin transferred the administration and garrison to Kichino without first securing higher approval. The new place offered a more convenient position on the New Vyatka trade route.

Offices, soldiers’ houses, a jail and salt stores accompanied the move, but official recognition came much later. In 1778 Catherine II’s provincial reorganisation made Kichino a town under the name Kologriv. A regular town plan followed. The Church of the Dormition, built in 1805–1807 above the town, added a new landmark to the settlement whose administrative origins still lay in that contested eighteenth-century relocation.
simp_chinese:
科洛格里夫的历史包含一次沿温扎河的迁移。早期木堡位于上游约四十公里、河流对岸，始建于十六世纪初。1727年，地方长官伊万·罗戈津未经上级事先批准，将行政机构与驻军迁往基奇诺。新地点位于新维亚特卡商路上，位置更为便利。

办公室、士兵住宅、监牢与盐仓随迁移而建，正式认可却迟得多。1778年叶卡捷琳娜二世调整地方行政时，基奇诺正式以科洛格里夫之名取得城市地位，随后制定规则的城市规划。1805—1807年修建的圣母安息教堂又成为城镇上方的新地标，其行政起源仍与十八世纪那次有争议的迁址相连。

english: The country around Kolokani belongs to Kaarta, west of the upper Niger and near Diéma. Here the Massassi dynasty established a Bambara kingdom that competed with its eastern neighbour, Segu. The fortunes of Kaarta rose and fell with its struggles against Segu and other powers; under Bodian Moriba in the early nineteenth century, its rulers recovered territory and moved their capital to Nioro. The documented town of Kolokani itself lies farther southeast, towards the Bélédougou country.
simp_chinese: 科洛卡尼一带属于尼日尔河上游以西的卡尔塔地区，靠近杰马。马萨西王朝在这里建立班巴拉王国，与东面的塞古争雄。卡尔塔在与塞古及其他势力的交战中屡经兴衰；十九世纪初，博迪安·莫里巴统治时期，王国收复部分领土，并将都城迁至尼奥罗。史籍中同名的科洛卡尼镇则位于更东南方，靠近贝莱杜古地区。

english:
Koloma, also rendered Cullumah, was a Nisenan village in the valley of the South Fork American River in California's Sierra Nevada foothills. The name is associated with the valley's beauty. River water, oak-covered slopes and nearby higher country offered different resources within reach of the settlement. Bedrock mortars at the village site preserve the work of Nisenan women who processed acorns into food.

Acorns were gathered, dried and stored, then pounded into meal and leached to remove bitterness. Fish, particularly salmon and lamprey, also mattered to the wider Nisenan economy. Exchange linked foothill and valley communities: upland groups supplied black-oak acorns, pine nuts, dried meat and hides, while lower-river groups provided fish and other lowland products. Seasonal movement and stored harvests sustained village life through the winter. These connections gave Koloma an established place in an Indigenous social landscape long before outside settlement. Its earlier history rests in the river, food-processing places and relationships between elevations that supported a permanent community and its seasonal journeys.
simp_chinese:
科洛马又写作Cullumah，是加利福尼亚内华达山麓、美国河南支谷地的一处尼塞南人村落，地名同美丽的河谷相联系。河水、橡树林坡地及附近较高山地，提供彼此补充的资源。遗址保留的基岩研磨穴，见证尼塞南妇女将橡实加工为食物的劳动。

橡实采回后晾干储藏，需要时捣成粉，再以水浸洗去除苦味。鱼类，尤其鲑鱼与七鳃鳗，也在更广泛的尼塞南人生计中占有重要位置。交换连接山麓和谷地社群：高处居民提供黑橡橡实、松子、干肉与兽皮，下游居民则提供鱼和其他低地产品。季节性出行与储藏的收获支持居民度过冬季。早在大规模外来定居之前，科洛马就已经嵌入这种原住民社会联系。河流、食物加工场所及不同海拔之间的关系，共同维系着常住村落及其向周边地区展开的季节活动。

english:
Kolomak is associated with a decisive Cossack council held beside the Kolomak River in 1687. At the time, the river marked the boundary of the Hetman state. Muscovite troops under Prince Vasilii Golitsyn surrounded the gathering, which deposed and arrested Ivan Samoilovych and elected Ivan Mazepa as hetman. The council then accepted the agreement known as the Kolomak Articles.

Its twenty-two articles preserved a registered Cossack force of thirty thousand and reaffirmed existing rights, but imposed substantial restrictions. Changes to high offices required the tsar’s approval; the hetman could not maintain independent foreign relations; and Muscovite troops were to be stationed at Baturyn. The riverside gathering thus joined an election of leadership to a settlement that narrowed the Hetmanate’s political and military freedom.
simp_chinese:
科洛马克与1687年在科洛马克河畔召开的一次关键哥萨克会议相连。当时，这条河标志着赫特曼国的边界。瓦西里·戈利岑亲王统率的莫斯科军队包围会场，会议废黜并逮捕伊万·萨莫伊洛维奇，选举伊万·马泽帕为赫特曼，随后接受了《科洛马克条款》。

协议共有二十二条，保留三万名注册哥萨克并重申既有权利，同时施加重大限制：高级职位的变动须获沙皇批准，赫特曼不得独立开展外交，莫斯科军队还将驻扎巴图林。这场河畔会议既更换了领袖，也通过新的约定收紧了赫特曼国的政治与军事自主空间。

english: Kolombangara is a volcanic island in the western Solomon Islands. Its steep forested cone rises above the straits and lagoons separating it from New Georgia and neighbouring islands. The surrounding sea forms part of the maritime world of the western Solomons, where communities travelled and exchanged goods by canoe.
simp_chinese: 科隆班加拉是所罗门群岛西部的一座火山岛。森林覆盖的陡峭火山锥耸立在海峡与潟湖上方，这些水域将它与新乔治亚及邻近岛屿分开。周围海洋属于所罗门群岛西部的海洋世界，社群乘独木舟往来并交换物品。

english:
Kolomna stands near the meeting of the Moskva and Oka rivers, a position that made it both a trading town and a stronghold on Moscow’s southern approaches. Once a prize in the struggles of Moscow and Ryazan, it became a gathering place for armies going toward the steppe. Its kremlin and monasteries recall centuries in which river traffic and defence shaped the city together.

In 1380 Dmitry of Moscow reviewed his assembled forces near Kolomna before their march to the Don and victory on Kulikovo Field. The town remained exposed to attack: Prince Oleg of Ryazan seized it in 1385, and the Oka frontier continued to draw armies in later decades. Ivan III gathered forces along the river in 1472 against an invasion from the Golden Horde. Ivan IV likewise brought troops to Kolomna for campaigns toward Kazan.

Under Vasily III a new brick and stone kremlin rose between 1525 and 1531, replacing earlier defences. Its walls enclosed a large area and were strengthened by sixteen towers. At the confluence downstream, the Staro-Golutvin monastery had been founded in the late fourteenth century as another landmark of the southern approach. As the frontier moved south in the seventeenth century, Kolomna’s military role diminished, while its merchants and craftsmen gained importance in exchanges between Moscow and the regions beyond the Oka.
simp_chinese:
科洛姆纳位于莫斯科河与奥卡河汇合处附近，既是商贸城镇，也是莫斯科南方门户的要塞。它曾是莫斯科与梁赞争夺的目标，后来成为军队向草原进发前的集结地。克里姆林和修道院令人想起河运与防御共同塑造这座城市的岁月。

1380年，莫斯科的德米特里在科洛姆纳附近检阅集结的军队，随后进军顿河，并在库利科沃原野获胜。城镇仍不断遭受攻击：1385年梁赞的奥列格亲王占领了这里，往后数十年奥卡河边界依然引来军队。1472年，伊凡三世沿河集结兵力，抵御金帐汗国的入侵。伊凡四世也曾将军队带到科洛姆纳，准备向喀山进军。

瓦西里三世统治时，新的砖石克里姆林于1525至1531年建成，取代了早期城防。城墙围住广阔区域，以十六座塔楼加固。下游两河汇合处的旧戈卢特文修道院建于十四世纪末，是南方门户的另一处地标。随着边境在十七世纪向南推进，科洛姆纳的军事作用减弱，商人和匠人在莫斯科与奥卡河以南地区的贸易中则越来越重要。

english:
Kolomyia stands on the Prut in the heart of Pokuttia, between the Carpathians and the Dniester lands. Mentioned in chronicles in the thirteenth century, it became known for salt and for trade across the frontier with Moldavia. Ukrainians, Poles, Armenians, Jews and Hungarians settled in the town.

Its Magdeburg rights were confirmed in 1405. Later privileges allowed its burghers to trade salt and required passing merchants to offer their goods in the local market. In 1485 Stephen the Great of Moldavia came to Kolomyia to pay homage to the Polish king, seeking support against the Ottomans. Pokuttia was subsequently contested between Poland and Moldavia, and Tatar and Ottoman attacks damaged the town. After it was burned in 1626, it was rebuilt farther from the Prut. During the Khmelnytsky uprising, unrest spread through the district under the leadership of Semen Vysochan.
simp_chinese:
科洛梅亚坐落在普鲁特河畔的波库季亚腹地，处于喀尔巴阡山与德涅斯特河诸地之间。它在十三世纪编年史中已有记载，因盐业和与摩尔达维亚的跨境贸易而闻名。乌克兰人、波兰人、亚美尼亚人、犹太人及匈牙利人在此定居。

城镇的马格德堡法权于1405年得到确认。后来的特权允许市民经营盐业，并要求过路商人在当地市场出售货物。1485年，摩尔达维亚的斯特凡大公来到科洛梅亚向波兰国王称臣，寻求对抗奥斯曼帝国的支持。此后波兰和摩尔达维亚争夺波库季亚，鞑靼和奥斯曼人的进攻也使城镇受损。1626年城镇被焚毁后，在离普鲁特河较远处重建。赫梅利尼茨基起义期间，谢缅·维索昌领导的动乱在这一地区蔓延。

english: Kolonbelle is an old rendering of the name of the Catumbela River, which flows west from Angola's highlands to the Atlantic. Its valley cuts through the country behind Benguela before reaching the coast. At the river mouth, the Ndombe lived under the leader Quitumbela, while communities on the opposite bank cultivated land and exchanged salt. The river links the mountainous interior with the coastal plain.
simp_chinese: 科隆贝莱是卡通贝拉河名称的一种旧译。这条河发源于安哥拉高地，向西流入大西洋；河谷穿过本格拉后方的内陆，抵达海岸。河口一带的恩东贝人居于首领基通贝拉治下，对岸的社群则耕作并交换食盐。河流将山地内陆与沿海平原连接起来。

english: Koloshma lies in the wooded hills west of White Lake, on the river of the same name. The Koloshma flows from the Vepsian uplands through a rolling landscape, with steep banks in parts of its upper course. It joins another stream to form the Suda, whose waters continue towards the Sheksna and the Volga. Small settlements along the river are separated by forest and marsh.
simp_chinese: 科洛什马位于白湖以西的林木丘陵，坐落在同名河流畔。科洛什马河从维普斯高地流经起伏的土地，上游部分河岸陡峭。它与另一条河汇合形成苏达河，河水继续流向舍克斯纳河和伏尔加河。沿河的小聚落之间分布着森林和沼泽。

english: Kolosovka lies on the Osha River, a tributary of the Irtysh in the forest country north of Omsk. Two settlements, Lower and Upper Kolosovskoye, once stood along the river. Some of the peasants who settled the lower village came from the Izyuk district farther west. The river connected these communities with the larger Irtysh basin across the flat western Siberian plain.
simp_chinese: 科洛索夫卡位于鄂木斯克以北林地中的奥沙河畔，奥沙河是额尔齐斯河的支流。沿河曾有下科洛索夫斯科耶和上科洛索夫斯科耶两处聚落；定居下村的部分农民来自更西方的伊久克地区。河流将这些社区同平坦西西伯利亚平原上的额尔齐斯河大流域连接起来。

english: Kolpashevo stands on the right bank of the Ob, near the mouth of the Ket, in the forested lowlands of western Siberia. The settlement began as a small village in the seventeenth century, associated with the Kolpashnikov family of Russian servicemen. The Ob and Ket formed part of the water route eastward across Siberia; Russian embassies bound for China and the Kamchatka expeditions used that route during the seventeenth and eighteenth centuries.
simp_chinese: 科尔帕舍沃位于鄂毕河右岸、凯季河口附近，坐落在西西伯利亚的森林低地上。这里起初是十七世纪出现的小村庄，与俄国军役人员科尔帕什尼科夫家族有关。鄂毕河与凯季河构成横穿西伯利亚向东的水路一部分；十七至十八世纪，前往中国的俄国使团和堪察加探险队都曾利用这条路线。

english: Kolpny lies near the meeting of the Kolpenka and the Sosna, in the frontier country south-east of Oryol. In 1571 mounted watchmen from Mtsensk and Novosil were stationed at the mouth of the Kolpna to guard against raids. A newly settled village is recorded here in 1678. By the reign of Catherine II the small settlement had a stone church dedicated to Cosmas and Damian, with a chapel of Saints Peter and Paul.
simp_chinese: 科尔普内位于科尔片卡河与索斯纳河汇合处附近，是奥廖尔东南方的边境地区。1571年，来自姆岑斯克和诺沃西利的骑马哨兵驻扎在科尔普纳河口，防备袭击。1678年的记录提到了新定居的村庄。叶卡捷琳娜二世时期，这个小聚落已有一座供奉科斯马和达弥盎的石教堂，附设圣彼得与圣保罗小堂。

english: On northern Tierra del Fuego, Bahía Lomas opens into the eastern Strait of Magellan. The tide uncovers broad flats of mud and sand, where red knots and other shorebirds feed after their long migrations. Inland, the Selk'nam hunted guanacos across the island's grasslands. Northern families made windbreaks from wooden poles and guanaco skins, or built conical shelters from branches and grass.
simp_chinese: 火地岛北部的洛马斯湾通向麦哲伦海峡东段。退潮露出宽阔的泥沙滩，红腹滨鹬等岸鸟长途迁徙后在此觅食。内陆的塞尔克南人在岛上草原猎捕原驼。北方家庭用木杆与原驼皮搭建挡风棚，也用树枝和草建造圆锥形居所。

english: Kolumba is a hill in the Balandete country near the western coast of southeastern Sulawesi. Tolaki traditions associate it with the early centre of Mekongga, a kingdom of the Kolaka region. In accounts passed down through generations, figures connected with the kingdom’s origins arrived at this hill. The surrounding country slopes towards the Gulf of Bone, with forested mountains rising behind the coast.
simp_chinese: 科伦巴是苏拉威西东南部西岸附近巴兰代特地区的一座山丘。托拉基人的传统将它与科拉卡地区梅孔加王国的早期中心联系起来。在世代相传的故事中，与王国起源有关的人物曾来到这座山丘。周围土地向波尼湾倾斜，海岸后方升起森林山地。

english:
The Kolyma Highlands occupy a remote part of northeastern Siberia, where mountain ranges divide river systems flowing toward the Arctic and the Sea of Okhotsk. Long winters, permafrost, and sparse produce limit cultivation and favor mobile livelihoods. Indigenous communities use hunting, fishing, and reindeer tradition records local conditions, linking seasonal camps across valleys and passes.

Knowledge of snow, river ice, and animal movements is essential to navigating this immense landscape. During the seventeenth century, Russian expansion approached the wider region through river routes and the search for valuable furs. Tribute collection and trading posts introduced new demands, but mountain terrain made continuous direct control difficult. Even, Evenki, Yukaghir, and neighboring peoples maintained different relationships with outsiders, combining exchange, cooperation, resistance, and movement.

Routes between inland basins and the Okhotsk coast later gained importance for imperial communication, yet supplies remained hard to obtain. The highlands' early modern history therefore centers on environmental adaptation and the limits of state power. Imperial ambitions could assign distant territories to an administration, but practical movement still depended on local guides, transport animals, and the seasonal knowledge of people already living there.
simp_chinese:
科雷马高地位于西伯利亚东北部偏远地区，山脉分隔流向北冰洋和鄂霍次克海的河流系统。漫长冬季、永久冻土及稀疏资源限制耕作，有利于流动生计。原住民按地方条件利用狩猎、捕鱼和驯鹿，连接谷地、山口之间的季节营地。积雪、河冰与动物活动知识，是穿行辽阔景观的重要基础。

严寒要求居民谨慎安排供应和出行。十七世纪，俄罗斯扩张通过河流及寻找珍贵毛皮的活动接近更广阔地区。贡赋征收和交易站带来新要求，山地却使持续直接控制相当困难。

埃文、鄂温克、尤卡吉尔及邻近人群，同外来者维持不同关系，结合交换、合作、抵抗与迁移。内陆盆地通向鄂霍次克海岸的路线，后来对帝国通信更重要，补给仍然难以取得。高地近代早期历史因此关注环境适应与国家权力限制。行政可以划定遥远领土，实际移动却依赖地方向导、运输动物及原有居民的季节知识。

english:
The Kolyma River drains a vast part of northeastern Siberia toward the Arctic Ocean. Its long freezing season and short period of open water set the rhythm of travel and produce use. River channels offered routes through country where overland movement could be extremely difficult, while fishing supported communities along the banks.

Reindeer herding, hunting, and other livelihoods connected the river with tundra and woodland beyond it. Russian expansion reached the Kolyma basin during the seventeenth century, bringing forts, tribute demands, and commercial interest in furs. Indigenous peoples, including Yukaghir and neighbouring communities, faced new political pressures and disease, while their knowledge remained essential to movement and survival. Distances and severe climate limited the reach of officials and traders.

Boats, winter routes, and local provisioning were all necessary to sustain settlements. During the early modern centuries, the river's significance lay in these Arctic livelihoods and frontier connections. Its later association with large-scale mining and forced labour belongs to a different historical period, beyond the world of the early Russian advance.
simp_chinese:
科雷马河汇集东西伯利亚东北部广大区域的水，向北冰洋流去。漫长封冻期和短暂开放水季，决定交通及资源利用节律。在陆上行进十分艰难的地方，河道提供穿行路线，捕鱼则支持沿岸社群。

驯鹿放牧、狩猎和其他生计，把河流与更远的苔原及森林连接起来，形成跨越不同环境的年度活动。十七世纪俄国扩张抵达科雷马流域，带来堡垒、贡赋要求和毛皮商业兴趣。尤卡吉尔人及邻近原住民社群面对新的政治压力与疾病，其知识却仍是移动和生存的必要条件。

遥远距离与严寒限制官员和商人的影响范围，舟船、冬季路线和地方补给共同维持聚落。近代早期，这条河的重要性主要在于北极生计及边疆联系。后来大规模采矿与强迫劳动的历史属于另一时代，不应取代理解早期俄国进入和原住民生活的背景。

english:
The Kolyma corridor linked the rivers and Arctic shores of northeastern Siberia. In the early 1640s, Russian expeditions moved east from the Indigirka, using river journeys and coastal sailing rather than a single continuous road. The parties associated with Mikhail Stadukhin, Dmitry Zyryan and Semyon Dezhnev reached the Kolyma and established wintering places in an already inhabited northern landscape.

These journeys pursued furs, tribute and knowledge of further routes. A century later, the Great Northern Expedition again examined the Arctic coast, often without fully using the experience of seventeenth-century travellers. Kolyma’s early route history therefore joins improvised movements between watersheds and coastal stretches to later attempts at systematic mapping. The practical corridor remained a chain of seasonal journeys.
simp_chinese:
科雷马通道连接西伯利亚东北部河流与北冰洋沿岸。十七世纪四十年代初，俄国考察队从因迪吉尔卡向东推进，依靠内河旅行与沿海航行，而非一条连续道路。与米哈伊尔·斯塔杜欣、德米特里·兹里安和谢苗·杰日尼奥夫相关的队伍抵达科雷马，在已有北方居民生活的土地上建立越冬据点。

这些行程追求毛皮、贡赋以及通往更远地区的道路知识。一个世纪后，大北方考察队再次调查北极海岸，却往往未能充分利用十七世纪旅行者的经验。科雷马的早期路线史由此把流域间、海岸间的探索与后来的系统制图相连；实际交通仍由一段段随季节变化的旅程组成。

english:
The Kolyma uplands belong to northeastern Siberia's severe landscape of mountains, valleys, and long winters. Indigenous communities used hunting, fishing, and, in suitable settings, reindeer pastoralism to support life across widely separated produce areas. Seasonal movement required knowledge of snow, ice, river conditions, and the distribution of animals.

A route useful in one season might be dangerous or impassable in another, making experience and cooperation essential to travel. The wider region was inhabited by peoples including Yukaghir and Even communities, whose social connections linked camps and families across broad territories. Russian expansion reached the Kolyma country during the seventeenth century, bringing tribute demands, trading posts, and commercial interest in furs.

These contacts could involve negotiation and conflict, while outsiders remained dependent on Indigenous guides and supplies. Imported goods entered local exchanges without replacing the need for detailed environmental knowledge. The uplands' historical setting therefore combines enduring northern livelihoods with the gradual extension of imperial authority, where political claims from distant centers were mediated by terrain and by the practical ability of local people to sustain journeys through a demanding country.
simp_chinese:
科雷马高地属于西伯利亚东北部严酷的山地、谷地与漫长冬季景观。原住民社群利用狩猎、捕鱼，以及适宜环境中的驯鹿牧业，在相隔遥远的资源地区之间维持生活。季节移动需要认识雪、冰、河流条件和动物分布。

某一季节实用的路线，在另一季节可能危险或无法通行，使经验和合作成为旅行的重要条件，地方知识支撑着居民的长期活动。更广阔地区生活着尤卡吉尔、埃文等人群，社会联系跨越广大领土连接营地和家庭。十七世纪俄罗斯扩张抵达科雷马地区，带来贡赋要求、贸易据点及对兽皮的商业兴趣。

接触可能涉及协商和冲突，外来者仍依靠原住民向导及补给。进口货物进入地方交换，细致环境知识仍不可替代。高地的历史环境，因而结合持久北方生计与帝国权威逐渐扩展，远方中心的政治主张受到地形影响，也依赖地方居民实际维持艰苦旅程的能力。

english: This part of the Kolyma Uplands belongs to the Yukaghir Highlands, a region of tableland and mountain ranges between the Kolyma and Omolon basins. The Chubukulakh and Siversky ranges rise above broad intermontane depressions. Sparse larch forests cover the lower slopes, with dwarf pine and tundra above.
simp_chinese: 这片科雷马高地属于尤卡吉尔高地，位于科雷马河与奥莫隆河流域之间，由台地和山脉组成。丘布库拉赫与锡韦尔斯基山脉耸立于宽阔山间盆地之上；低坡有稀疏落叶松林，更高处是偃松灌丛与苔原。

english: Kolymskoie lies on the left bank of the Kolyma opposite the mouth of the Omolon. Before the settlement took its present form, the site was a summer camping place for Yukaghir families moving through the lower Kolyma country. The great river and its tributary meet amid a northern landscape of channels, lakes and low ground, where fishing and seasonal movement have long shaped local life.
simp_chinese: 科雷姆斯科耶位于科雷马河左岸，正对奥莫隆河河口。在现有聚落形成之前，这里是活动于科雷马下游地区的尤卡吉尔家庭的夏季营地。大河与支流在北方的河汊、湖泊和低地之间交汇，捕鱼与季节性迁徙长久以来塑造着当地生活。

english: Kom Ombo stands on a bend of the Nile north of Aswan, above a fertile stretch of the valley. Its Ptolemaic temple is unusual in being dedicated to two groups of gods. One side honours Sobek, the crocodile god, with Hathor and Khons; the other honours the falcon god Haroeris, or Horus the Elder, with Tasenetnofret and Panebtawy. The temple's paired arrangement reflects the importance of both cults in this ancient river town.
simp_chinese: 科姆翁布位于阿斯旺以北的尼罗河弯道，俯瞰一片肥沃河谷。这里的托勒密时期神庙颇为独特，同时供奉两组神祇：一侧是鳄神索贝克、哈托尔和孔斯，另一侧是隼神哈罗里斯，即「老荷鲁斯」，以及塔塞特诺弗雷特和帕内布塔维。神庙成对的布局反映了这座古老河畔城镇中两种崇拜的重要地位。

english: Koma was a district of Kai whose riverine settlements depended on managing the Kamanashi and Midai rivers on the western side of the Kofu basin. The flood-control works associated with Takeda Shingen provide a concrete sixteenth-century landmark. The works began after the great floods of 1542, and a document granting exemption from household taxation dates their completion to around 1560. The system was not simply one embankment: stone projections, divided flows and defences at the river junction helped protect settlements and cultivated land. During the Edo period these works were regarded as models of the Koshu approach to river management. A surviving plan was drawn in 1824 to record the embankment’s extent. It preserves evidence of the late Edo arrangement before later reconstruction changed its shape.
simp_chinese: 巨摩是甲斐国的地域，其甲府盆地西侧沿河聚落，需要应对釜无川与御敕使川的水患。与武田信玄相关的治水工程，提供了十六世纪的具体历史线索。工程始于1542年的大洪水之后，依据一份免除房屋税的文书，完成时间约在1560年前后。这一体系并非只有一道堤坝：石筑导流设施、分流安排和汇流处防御，共同保护聚落与耕地。江户时代，这些工程被视为甲州流治水的范例。现存一幅1824年绘图，专为记录当时堤防规模而作，保存了后世改建之前江户后期的布局。

english: Koman lies in the mountains of northern Albania, above the valley of the Drin. On nearby Dalmacë hill stood a fortified settlement with churches and an extensive burial ground. Its graves, dating chiefly from the sixth to the eighth centuries, contain ornaments and other objects characteristic of the Komani-Kruja culture. Related cemeteries across northern and central Albania bear witness to communities that lived here between late antiquity and the Middle Ages.
simp_chinese: 科曼位于阿尔巴尼亚北部山区，俯瞰德林河谷。附近的达尔马策山上曾有一处设防聚落，内有教堂和大片墓地。墓葬主要属于六至八世纪，其中的饰物和其他随葬品具有科曼—克鲁亚文化的特征。阿尔巴尼亚北部和中部还有类似的墓地，留下了当地居民从古代晚期进入中世纪的痕迹。

english: Komango lies on the northern edge of the Bangweulu wetlands, near the swampy estuaries of the Luena and Lukuto rivers. Channels, lagoons and islands break up the flooded country around Chilubi. The Chambeshi feeds the greater wetland system, whose waters leave by the Luapula, while the extent of the flood changes markedly with the seasons.
simp_chinese: 科曼戈位于班韦乌卢湿地北缘，靠近卢埃纳河与卢库托河沼泽般的入湖口。琼比卢岛周围的水道、泻湖和岛屿将水乡分割开来。尚贝希河为这片广大的湿地供水，水流经卢阿普拉河流出，而洪水的范围随季节显著变化。

english:
Komárom occupies a strategic position where the Váh joins the Danube. Its castle guarded the meeting of the rivers and the routes toward Vienna and the Hungarian interior. King Matthias Corvinus used the medieval castle as a residence, but the advance of the Ottomans gave the site a new military importance.

Ferdinand I ordered a modern bastioned fortress begun in 1546. It withstood an Ottoman siege in 1594, protecting a crucial crossing even as nearby strongholds fell. After the capture of Nové Zámky by the Ottomans in 1663, the Habsburgs added a new fortress to strengthen the position. Komárom became the seat of the captaincy of Lower Hungary. Earthquakes in the eighteenth century damaged town and fortifications, yet the junction of the two rivers remained an important defensive site.
simp_chinese:
科马罗姆扼守瓦赫河与多瑙河汇合处，其城堡控制着两河交会和通往维也纳及匈牙利腹地的道路。马加什·科尔温国王曾以中世纪城堡为居所，但奥斯曼军队的推进赋予此地新的军事意义。

1546年，斐迪南一世下令修建棱堡式新要塞。1594年，它抵御了奥斯曼围攻，在附近据点陷落时保护着这一关键渡口。1663年，奥斯曼攻占新扎姆基后，哈布斯堡当局增建新要塞以加强防御。科马罗姆成为下匈牙利总司令部的驻地。十八世纪地震损坏了城镇和工事，但两河交汇处仍是重要的防御地点。

english: Kombai communities live in the rainforests of southern New Guinea, in the inland country of the Digul basin. Their language belongs to the Awyu family. Sago palms grow in the forest and provide starch, while hunting and fishing draw on the varied life of the surrounding rivers and woodland.
simp_chinese: 孔拜社群生活在新几内亚南部雨林中，位于迪古尔河流域内陆。他们的语言属于阿维尤语族。森林中的西米棕榈提供淀粉，狩猎与捕鱼则利用周围河流和林地丰富的生物资源。

english: Kombolcha lies in the highland country of Wello, near the source of the Borkana River. Archaeologists have found remains of Christian settlements in its vicinity dating to the late first millennium. Together with the old churches and monasteries around Lake Hayq, these traces bear witness to the spread of Christianity through the region known as Beta Amhara, where older local beliefs and rituals also endured.
simp_chinese: 孔博勒恰位于沃洛高地，靠近博尔卡纳河的源头。考古学家在附近发现了公元第一千纪晚期的基督教聚落遗迹。这些遗迹与海克湖周围古老的教堂、修道院一起，见证了基督教在贝塔阿姆哈拉地区的传播；当地更早的信仰与仪式也在这一地区延续。

english: Kombomba lies in the Luwumbu basin, east of the Luangwa River. Traditions of the northern Senga recall Kambombo among the chiefs who crossed the Luangwa and settled in the country watered by the Luwumbu. From about 1780, Bisa-speaking migrants also entered the valley, where they encountered Tumbuka communities and contributed to the formation of new chiefdoms.
simp_chinese: 孔邦巴位于卢安瓜河以东的卢翁布河流域。北部森加人的传说记述，坎邦博是渡过卢安瓜河的首领之一，后来定居在卢翁布河灌溉的地区。约1780年起，讲比萨语的移民也进入河谷，在此遇到通布卡社群，并参与形成新的首领领地。

english: The Komering is one of the great tributaries of the Musi in southern Sumatra. Its upper basin lies in the Barisan Mountains near Lake Ranau; the river then crosses the lowlands towards Palembang, where it joins the Musi. Along its course, mountain valleys give way to a broad floodplain. Together with the Ogan and Lematang, the Komering carries water from the inland hills into the river system that reaches the Bangka Strait.
simp_chinese: 科梅灵河是苏门答腊南部穆西河的重要支流之一。上游流域位于拉瑙湖附近的巴里桑山脉，河水随后穿越低地流向巨港，在那里汇入穆西河。沿途山谷逐渐变为宽广的泛滥平原。科梅灵河与奥甘河、勒马唐河一道，将内陆山地的水送入通向邦加海峡的河流系统。

english:
The Komo, also called Kumu, inhabit the forest country of eastern Congo. Their language is spoken across a broad region extending eastwards toward the rivers near Walikale, with the Lega to the south and Nyanga to the east. Cultivation and the resources of the forest support their communities. Among their ritual traditions, the Nkunda association uses carved masks in initiation and divination; the mask known as nsembu represents the spirit of a diviner.

The later city of Bukavu lies here.
simp_chinese:
戈莫人又称库穆人，生活在刚果东部的森林地区。他们的语言分布广阔，向东延伸至瓦利卡莱附近的河流一带；莱加人居于南方，尼扬加人居于东方。耕作和森林物产支撑着各地社群。在他们的仪式传统中，恩昆达结社于入会仪式和占卜时使用雕刻面具；一种称为恩森布的面具代表占卜者的灵。

后来的布卡武即位于此地。

english:
Komotiní lies on the Thracian plain below the Rhodope Mountains, along the old Via Egnatia. A late Roman fortress formed the nucleus of the town, which became known under Ottoman rule as Gümülcine. Beyond its walls, the buildings endowed by the frontier commander Gazi Evrenos helped shape an expanding settlement on the road westwards.

During the Byzantine civil war of the 1340s, Komotiní and several neighbouring forts supported John Kantakouzenos. The Ottoman conquest followed in the second half of the fourteenth century. Evrenos used the town as a frontier base before transferring his headquarters to Serres in 1383. He endowed a mosque, bathhouse and imaret, a charitable institution that offered food and shelter. In the sixteenth century the growth of its foundation accompanied the physical expansion of Gümülcine.
simp_chinese:
科莫蒂尼坐落在罗多彼山脚下的色雷斯平原，古老的埃格纳提亚大道从这里经过。一座晚期罗马堡垒构成城镇的核心，奥斯曼统治时期它被称为居米尔吉内。城墙之外，边疆将领加齐·埃夫雷诺斯捐建的建筑帮助这座西行道路上的聚落不断扩展。

十四世纪四十年代的拜占庭内战中，科莫蒂尼及附近数座堡垒支持约翰·坎塔库泽努斯。十四世纪后半叶，奥斯曼人征服了此地。埃夫雷诺斯以城镇为边疆基地，直到1383年将总部迁往塞雷斯。他捐建了清真寺、浴场和为人提供食宿的公益设施。十六世纪，相关基金的发展伴随着居米尔吉内城镇范围的扩大。

english: Komsa stands on the left bank of the Yenisei, opposite an island of the same name and downstream from the mouth of the Podkamennaya Tunguska. It was known in the eighteenth century as the Komsa winter station; a local account dates it to 1764 and names the Cossacks Andrey Krasnopeyev and Yakov Yarkov as its founders. The settlement took its name from the Komsa, a forest river flowing into the Yenisei.
simp_chinese: 科姆萨位于叶尼塞河左岸，隔河与同名岛屿相望，处在石下通古斯卡河口的下游。十八世纪这里已作为科姆萨冬营地为人所知；地方记载将其建立时间定为1764年，并称创建者是哥萨克安德烈·克拉斯诺佩耶夫和雅科夫·亚尔科夫。聚落得名于流入叶尼塞河的森林河流科姆萨河。

english: Komshecheh lies on the Borkhar plain northeast of Isfahan, in a landscape of cultivated settlements and dry ground. Its older buildings include a mosque, a bath and the castle of Aliabad Shahvazi, alongside remains attributed to the pre-Islamic period. On the plain, underground qanats carried water to fields and gardens, their wells tracing lines across the surface. These small settlements formed part of the agricultural country around Isfahan, beyond the city's walls and markets.
simp_chinese: 科姆谢切位于伊斯法罕东北的博尔哈尔平原，周围是耕作聚落与干旱土地相间的景观。当地古建筑包括清真寺、浴室和阿里阿巴德沙赫瓦齐堡，另有被认为属于伊斯兰时代以前的遗存。平原上的坎儿井将地下水引向田地与园圃，竖井在地面排列成线。这些小聚落构成伊斯法罕城墙和市场之外的农业腹地。

english: Kon Klor is a Bahnar village on the Đăk Bla River in the central highlands of Vietnam. Its name is said to mean the village of cotton trees. Stilt houses and a communal house, or nhà rông, belong to a tradition of building with timber, bamboo and thatch. The steep roof of the communal house rises above the dwellings, providing a place where villagers gather for meetings and ceremonies. The river flows west through the highlands towards the Mekong basin.
simp_chinese: 孔洛是越南中部高地得布拉河畔的一座巴拿族村落，其名字据说意为“木棉树村”。高脚屋与称为“容屋”的公共建筑，都属于使用木材、竹子和茅草的建筑传统。容屋的陡峭屋顶高出周围住宅，是村民集会和举行仪式的场所。得布拉河向西流经高地，汇入湄公河流域。

english: The Kon flows through the central Kazakh uplands towards the Kulanotpes, a river of the Tengiz basin. Its valley crosses the open steppe south of the great lake, where flowing water varies with the seasons. The Kulanotpes and Nura feed a complex of salt and freshwater lakes and marshes, a striking wetland amid the dry grasslands of the interior.
simp_chinese: 孔河流经中央哈萨克高地，汇入田吉兹盆地的库拉诺特佩斯河。河谷穿过大湖南面的开阔草原，流水随季节变化。库拉诺特佩斯河与努拉河共同补给一组咸水湖、淡水湖和沼泽，在内陆干燥草原之间形成一片醒目的湿地。

english: Kon Tum lies in a basin of the central highlands, near the Đăk Bla River and the mountains of the Annamese Range. Its name comes from the Bahnar language and means a village by a lake. Bahnar villages in this region have long been marked by stilt houses and communal buildings, whose tall roofs rise above the surrounding dwellings. The highland basin belongs to the river system that flows westwards towards the Mekong rather than east to the nearby coast.
simp_chinese: 昆嵩位于中部高地的一处盆地，靠近得布拉河与安南山脉。它的名字源自巴拿语，意为湖畔村落。这一地区的巴拿村庄以高脚住宅和公共建筑为特色，公共建筑高耸的屋顶高出周围民居。高地盆地属于向西流入湄公河的水系，而非流向较近的东部海岸。

english:
Kona stretches along the western coast of Hawaiʻi Island, where volcanic slopes meet sheltered bays. Its coastal communities cultivated the land and fished the adjoining sea. At Hōnaunau a sacred place of refuge offered protection to those who reached it after breaking the kapu, the religious rules governing Hawaiian society.

Its walls enclosed temple platforms and royal grounds beside the place of refuge, on the shores of Hōnaunau Bay. In 1779 James Cook’s expedition anchored at Kealakekua Bay, where Cook was killed during a confrontation with Hawaiians. Three years later the battle of Mokuʻōhai in Kona helped Kamehameha establish his claim to power. He later completed the unification of the islands, and in 1819 his successor Liholiho abandoned the kapu system.
simp_chinese:
科纳沿夏威夷岛西岸延伸，火山坡地与避风海湾相接。沿海社群耕种土地，并在近海捕鱼。霍瑙瑙的神圣避难所为违反卡普禁制后能够抵达的人提供庇护；这套宗教规则曾支配夏威夷社会。

霍瑙瑙湾畔，避难所旁的围墙之内还有神庙台基与王室用地。1779年，詹姆斯·库克的探险队在凯阿拉凯夸湾下锚，库克在与夏威夷人的冲突中丧生。三年后，科纳的莫库欧海之战帮助卡美哈美哈确立了权力。此后他完成群岛统一，1819年其继承人利霍利霍废除了卡普制度。

english: The forested hills of the Konai region lie south of New Guinea’s central ranges, within the country drained toward the Fly River. Streams descend through humid forest to the broad southern lowlands. Communities speaking Papuan languages inhabit the valleys and river country on both sides of the mountains.
simp_chinese: 科奈地区的森林丘陵位于新几内亚中央山脉以南，属于流向弗莱河的地区。溪流穿过湿润森林流向广阔南部低地。使用巴布亚语言的社群生活在山脉两侧的山谷与河流地区。

english: Konbudj is a name associated with an Aboriginal language of western Arnhem Land. The wider region includes sandstone escarpments, tropical woodlands and rivers draining northward. Neighboring peoples have distinct languages and ties to the floodplains, rock country and waterways of northern Australia.
simp_chinese: 孔布吉是与阿纳姆地西部一种原住民语言有关的名称。广大地区有砂岩断崖、热带林地和向北流动的河流。邻近人群有各自的语言，与澳大利亚北部的洪泛平原、岩石地带及水道保持联系。

english:
Konch, also written Kunch, stood in Bundelkhand in the district later called Jalaun. Under Akbar it was the headquarters of a mahal, or revenue district. This administrative role places the town within the Mughal organisation of the region. A large tank in the eastern quarter was constructed in the eighteenth century, leaving a substantial addition to the town's built landscape before British authority spread through Bundelkhand.

In 1804 a British commander sent troops against the fort of Amanta Malaya, about five miles from Konch. Amir Khan's Pindaris relieved the garrison, and the British force withdrew to Konch after suffering heavy losses. The Pindaris then overwhelmed a small reinforcement sent from Kalpi before British troops dispersed them a month later. Konch consequently appears in the record both as an earlier administrative centre and as a place of retreat during a contested military advance. Its history at this moment was tied to nearby forts and mobile armed forces operating across Bundelkhand.
simp_chinese:
孔奇又写作Kunch，位于本德尔肯德、后来称作贾劳恩的地区。阿克巴统治时期，它是一个mahal，即赋税辖区的治所，纳入莫卧儿帝国的地方行政组织。十八世纪，镇东部建起一座大水池，为英国势力进入本德尔肯德以前的城镇景观留下重要建筑。

1804年，一名英军指挥官派兵进攻距孔奇约五英里的阿曼塔马拉亚堡。阿米尔汗率平达里武装解围，英军损失惨重，退回孔奇。平达里人随后击溃从卡尔皮派出的一小支增援，一个月后才被英军驱散。孔奇因此既见于较早的行政记载，也成为一次受挫军事推进中的退守地点。此时当地的历史紧密联系着邻近堡垒，以及穿行本德尔肯德的流动武装。

english:
Konchalyt is a name recorded for sedentary Chukchi people of the Kanchalan River country, north of the Anadyr estuary. Their name was later applied to the river itself. The Kanchalan crosses a low landscape of lakes and shrubs before reaching the broad tidal waters of the Anadyr basin. On seventeenth- and eighteenth-century maps the river appeared under the Russian name Nerpichya, a reminder of the different names carried by this northern waterway.

The later city of Anadyr lies nearby.
simp_chinese:
孔恰雷特是阿纳德尔河口以北、坎恰兰河地区定居楚科奇人的一个记载名称，后来这一名称也被用于河流。坎恰兰河穿过湖泊和灌木遍布的低地，流入阿纳德尔流域宽阔的潮汐水域。十七至十八世纪的地图上，这条河以俄语名称涅尔皮恰亚出现，显示出这条北方水道曾拥有不同的名称。

后来的阿纳德尔位于此地附近。

english:
Konda was a Mansi principality in western Siberia, associated with the wider Pelym political world. Greater and Lesser Konda formed its two territorial divisions, with a ruling centre known as Kartauzh or Konda town. Its rulers controlled important sources of fur tribute. Russian conquest in 1594, supported by Khanty allies from Koda, brought the capture of Prince Agai and members of his family.

Conquest did not immediately erase the ruling lineage. In the early seventeenth century, local leaders attempted to recover independence, while baptised Konda princes lived at Pelym. A royal charter of 1624 prohibited them from travelling to Konda, leaving members of their wider family to administer it as murzas. Prince Vasily nevertheless visited Greater Konda and collected tribute, provoking disputes with Pelym's governor. The contested right to collect yasak became a central issue in relations between hereditary rulers and Russian officials. Konda's incorporation thus proceeded through restrictions and struggles over revenue, as local princely authority was gradually narrowed.
simp_chinese:
孔达是西西伯利亚的曼西人领地，与较大的佩雷姆政治体系相联系，分大孔达、小孔达两部，统治中心称卡尔陶日或孔达城。领主控制重要的毛皮贡赋来源。1594年，俄军在科达汉特盟军协助下征服此地，俘获阿盖王公及其家属。

征服并未立即消除统治世系。十七世纪初，地方首领尝试恢复独立，受洗的孔达王公则居于佩雷姆。1624年沙皇诏书禁止他们前往孔达，由其家族中的穆尔扎管理当地。瓦西里王公仍进入大孔达收贡，引起与佩雷姆督军的争执。征收牙萨克的权利，成为世袭领主和俄国官员关系中的核心问题。孔达的并入因而经历限制措施与收入争夺，地方王权逐步受到压缩。

english: Kondagaon lies in the northern part of the Bastar country, among the wooded hills and plateaus of central India. Its name is also remembered as Kondanar, a Gondi expression explained locally as the village of horses. The surrounding region was part of the old kingdom of Bastar, whose ruling family traced its origins to Warangal and honoured Danteshwari as its guardian goddess. To the north, the Kesakal hills mark an approach between the Bastar plateau and the Chhattisgarh plain.
simp_chinese: 孔达冈位于巴斯塔尔北部，坐落在印度中部林木覆盖的丘陵与高原之间。这里也称孔达纳尔，当地将这个贡德语名称解释为“马的村庄”。周围地区曾属巴斯塔尔王国，其统治家族将自己的起源追溯至瓦朗加尔，并尊丹特什瓦里为守护女神。北面的凯萨卡尔山地，是巴斯塔尔高原通往恰蒂斯加尔平原的一处入口。

english:
Kondapalli stands below a hill fort overlooking the Krishna country near Vijayawada. The fortress is associated with the Reddi kings of Kondavidu, who built strongholds across the region in the fourteenth century. Its walls and gateways occupy a ridge above the plain, making it a valuable prize for the powers competing for the eastern Deccan.

The fort passed through several hands after the decline of Reddi rule. In the early sixteenth century Krishnadevaraya of Vijayanagara captured Kondapalli during his campaign against the rulers of Odisha. It was later restored to the Odisha king under a settlement that made the Krishna River a boundary between the two realms. The sultans of Golconda subsequently expanded into the region, adding another chapter to the history of this contested hill stronghold.
simp_chinese:
孔达帕利位于一座山堡之下，俯瞰维杰亚瓦达附近的克里希纳地区。堡垒与孔达维杜的雷迪诸王有关，他们于十四世纪在这一带修筑多处据点。城墙和门楼占据平原上方的山脊，使它成为争夺德干东部的势力垂涎的目标。

雷迪统治衰落后，堡垒数次易手。十六世纪初，毗奢耶那伽罗的克里希纳德瓦拉亚在对奥里萨统治者的战役中夺取孔达帕利。后来的和约以克里希纳河为两国边界，堡垒归还奥里萨国王。戈尔孔达苏丹随后向这一带扩张，为这座备受争夺的山地要塞历史增添了新篇章。

english:
Kondavidu, or Kondaveedu, rose above the Andhra plain as a major stronghold of the Reddi rulers after the collapse of Kakatiya power in 1323. Successive powers sought the hill fortress because control of its walls could secure a foothold in the surrounding country. Its inhabitants relied on reservoirs including Mutyalamma Cheruvu, Puttalamma Cheruvu and Vedulla Cheruvu, maintaining water supplies above the plain.

The fortress later passed into the contests between the Gajapati rulers of Odisha and Vijayanagara. Krishnadevaraya captured it on 23 June 1515 after a prolonged siege. The prisoners included the Gajapati prince Virabhadra and other commanders; a pillar inscription at Mangalagiri records the victory. Krishnadevaraya then visited Amaravati and continued toward further conquests. Kondavidu's story joins the practical demands of a hilltop garrison with the campaigns through which rival kingdoms tried to command the fertile lowlands of coastal Andhra.
simp_chinese:
孔达维杜，即孔达韦杜，耸立于安得拉平原之上。1323年卡卡提亚王朝崩溃后，这里成为雷迪统治者的重要堡垒。历代势力争夺山城，试图以城墙为依托控制周边地区。居民依靠穆蒂亚拉马、普塔拉马、韦杜拉等蓄水池，在高于平原的地势上维持供水。

后来，堡垒卷入奥迪沙加贾帕蒂王朝与毗奢耶那伽罗的争夺。克里希纳德瓦拉亚长期围攻后，于1515年6月23日攻克山城，俘获加贾帕蒂王子维拉巴德拉及其他将领。曼加拉吉里的柱铭记载了这次胜利。国王随后到访阿马拉瓦蒂，继续向其他据点进军。山顶驻军的实际需求，与各王国争夺沿海安得拉肥沃低地的战争，共同构成孔达维杜的历史。

english: The Konde were among the communities of the Maputaland country between the coast and the inland rivers. They belonged to a wider region of Ronga-speaking peoples, including the Maputa and Tembe. Before the rise of larger powers, Maputaland contained numerous small chiefdoms of differing size and allegiance. By the eighteenth century the Mabudu-Tembe kingdom was an important power in the area, with ties of trade reaching the coast and the markets of Delagoa Bay.
simp_chinese: 孔德人是马普塔兰沿海与内陆河流之间的社群之一。这里生活着使用龙加语的不同人群，包括马普塔人和滕贝人。在较大势力兴起以前，马普塔兰有许多大小和效忠关系各异的酋邦。到18世纪，马布杜—滕贝王国已是当地的重要力量，其贸易联系延伸至海岸和德拉戈阿湾的市场。

sources.title: 263225802 Sounding place in the western Maputaland borderlands

english:
Kondpoga stood beside Lake Onega, where the parish church and its burial ground occupied a rocky promontory. The Dormition Church is recorded in a survey of 1563, serving a community far from the parish centre at Shuya. Warfare repeatedly interrupted its life: Swedish forces burned an early church in the 1580s, a replacement stood by 1585, and another destruction followed in the early seventeenth century. A further church appears in descriptions of 1616–1619.

In 1774 local parishioners built the tall wooden Dormition Church that dominated the lakeside settlement. Its square log structure rose into an octagon and a tent-shaped roof, reaching about forty-two metres. Beneath the church site, burials spanning the medieval and early modern centuries preserve another continuity. Fifteenth- and sixteenth-century graves contained devotional objects, while later burials used birch-bark wrappings, hollowed logs and plank coffins. The promontory remained a focus of worship and remembrance through successive buildings, wars and generations.
simp_chinese:
孔德波加位于奥涅加湖畔，教堂与墓地占据一处岩石岬角。1563年的调查簿已记载圣母安息教堂，为远离舒亚教区中心的居民服务。战争多次中断当地宗教生活：十六世纪八十年代，瑞典军队焚毁早期教堂，1585年已有替代建筑；十七世纪初又遭破坏，1616至1619年的记述中则出现再次重建的教堂。

1774年，本地教民建起高大的木结构圣母安息教堂，俯临湖岸聚落。方形原木主体向上转为八角形，顶覆帐篷式尖顶，总高约四十二米。教堂下方跨越中世纪至近世的墓葬，保存了另一种延续：十五、十六世纪墓中有宗教物件，稍晚葬制则使用桦树皮包裹、独木棺和板棺。建筑屡次更替，战争与世代相继，这处岬角始终承载礼拜与追思。

english:
Konduga lies on the northern bank of the Ngadda, a seasonal river in the Lake Chad basin. The surrounding country has a long history of settlement: pottery found at Konduga reaches back to a time when Lake Chad covered a far greater area. In later centuries the region belonged to Bornu, whose rulers established their capital at Ngazargamu to the west and maintained connections across the Sahara.
